namespace {

// The runtime tensor representation caps rank at `kMaxRank`
// (Support/ML/TensorShape.h); `MGP::TensorSpecType::get` asserts above it.
static bool hasLowerableRank(Operation *op) {
  auto rankOk = [](Type t) {
    MO::TensorType tt = MO::dynCastFromTensorLike(t);
    return !tt || !tt.hasRank() ||
           tt.getRank() <= static_cast<int64_t>(kMaxRank);
  };
  return llvm::all_of(op->getOperandTypes(), rankOk) &&
         llvm::all_of(op->getResultTypes(), rankOk);
}

bool shouldLower(Operation *op) {
  if (isa<MO::PreservedDuringKernelLowering>(op))
    return false;
  // No MAP form: returns by value. Lowered by MAPToMOGG.
  if (isa<MO::InvokeShapeFuncOp>(op))
    return false;
  Dialect *dialect = op->getDialect();
  if (!dialect || !isa<MO::MODialect>(dialect))
    return false;
  return hasLowerableRank(op);
}

MAP::IterEpilogueOp buildStoreEpilogue(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                       BlockArgument out) {
  auto outType = cast<MO::TensorType>(out.getType());
  auto indexType = MAP::IndexType::get(builder.getContext(), outType.getRank());

  // Pass a null `$intermediateTensor` explicitly; omitting it picks the
  // generic builder, which does not set `operandSegmentSizes`.
  // `AllocateAccumulatingBuffers` fills it in after fusion.
  auto epilogue =
      MAP::IterEpilogueOp::create(builder, loc, out.getType(), ValueRange{out},
                                  /*intermediateTensor=*/Value());

  OpBuilder::InsertionGuard guard(builder);
  Block *body = builder.createBlock(&epilogue.getBody());
  BlockArgument val = body->addArgument(outType.getElementType(), loc);
  BlockArgument idx = body->addArgument(indexType, loc);
  BlockArgument cap = body->addArgument(out.getType(), loc);
  builder.setInsertionPointToStart(body);
  MAP::StoreOp::create(builder, loc, /*tensor=*/cap, /*index=*/idx,
                       /*value=*/val);
  return epilogue;
}

MAP::IterPrologueOp buildLoadPrologue(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                      Value in) {
  auto inType = cast<MO::TensorType>(in.getType());
  auto indexType = MAP::IndexType::get(builder.getContext(), inType.getRank());

  auto prologue =
      MAP::IterPrologueOp::create(builder, loc, in.getType(), ValueRange{in});

  OpBuilder::InsertionGuard guard(builder);
  Block *body = builder.createBlock(&prologue.getBody());
  BlockArgument idx = body->addArgument(indexType, loc);
  BlockArgument cap = body->addArgument(in.getType(), loc);
  builder.setInsertionPointToStart(body);
  Value loaded = MAP::LoadOp::create(builder, loc, inType.getElementType(),
                                     /*tensor=*/cap, /*index=*/idx);
  MAP::YieldOp::create(builder, loc, loaded);
  return prologue;
}

// Effects for the replacing kernel to carry, instead of the conservative
// "unknown" default.
std::pair<bool, bool> getReadWriteEffects(Operation *op) {
  auto memEffectOp = dyn_cast<MemoryEffectOpInterface>(op);
  if (!memEffectOp)
    return {false, false};
  return {memEffectOp.hasEffect<MemoryEffects::Read>(),
          memEffectOp.hasEffect<MemoryEffects::Write>()};
}

template <typename OpT>
void stampAsyncLaunch(OpT iterOp, Operation *srcOp) {
  iterOp.setDispatch(MO::kernelRequiresSyncLaunch(srcOp)
                         ? MOGG::DispatchKind::Immediate
                         : MOGG::DispatchKind::Deferred);
}

FailureOr<Operation *>
lowerToOpaque(Operation *op, const MOGG::KernelDeclAdaptor &adaptor,
              const MOGG::KernelDeclOperandMapping &mapping) {
  llvm::DenseMap<uint64_t, bool> inputFusible;
  for (const auto &[idx, arg] : mapping.operandMapping)
    inputFusible[idx] = arg.isFusedTensorType();

  llvm::DenseMap<uint64_t, bool> outputFusible;
  for (const auto &[idx, arg] : mapping.resultMapping)
    outputFusible[idx] = arg.isFusedTensorType();

  OpBuilder builder(op);
  Location loc = op->getLoc();

  // A mutating op's chain is its last operand and last result.
  // `map.iter.opaque` threads it through `$inputChain` and a trailing result,
  // and keeps it out of the body: no kernel's `execute` reads it.
  ValueRange operands = op->getOperands();
  bool hasInputChain =
      !operands.empty() && isa<MO::ChainType>(operands.back().getType());
  Value inputChain = hasInputChain ? operands.back() : Value();
  ValueRange nonChainOperands = hasInputChain ? operands.drop_back() : operands;

  TypeRange resultTypes = op->getResultTypes();

  auto opaque = MAP::IterOpaqueOp::create(builder, loc, resultTypes,
                                          nonChainOperands, inputChain,
                                          /*fusionInfo=*/Attribute());
  // A collective executes on several devices, on which getDeviceOrDefaultAny
  // asserts. Take the first; the label only picks host or GPU codegen.
  // TODO(GEX-2278): carry all of them.
  DeviceRefAttr device;
  if (auto hasDevice = dyn_cast<MO::MOHasDeviceInterface>(op)) {
    SmallVector<DeviceRefAttr> devices = hasDevice.getExecutionDevices();
    if (!devices.empty())
      device = devices.front();
  }
  opaque.setDeviceRef(device ? device : MO::getDeviceOrDefaultAny(op));
  opaque.setFusionInfoAttr(
      MOGG::FusionInfoAttr::get(op->getContext(), MOGG::createFusionLeaf(op)));
  auto [hasReadEffect, hasWriteEffect] = getReadWriteEffects(op);
  opaque.setHasReadEffect(hasReadEffect);
  opaque.setHasWriteEffect(hasWriteEffect);
  stampAsyncLaunch(opaque, op);

  // Body block args shadow the non-chain inputs then the non-chain outputs.
  Block *body = builder.createBlock(&opaque.getBody());
  SmallVector<BlockArgument> ins;
  for (Value operand : nonChainOperands)
    ins.push_back(body->addArgument(operand.getType(), loc));
  SmallVector<BlockArgument> outs;
  Type opaqueResultType;
  for (Type resultType : resultTypes) {
    if (isa<MO::ChainType>(resultType))
      continue;
    // A `!mo.opaque` result is returned by value and carried out by
    // `map.yield`, so it has no block argument.
    if (isa<MO::OpaqueType>(resultType)) {
      opaqueResultType = resultType;
      continue;
    }
    outs.push_back(body->addArgument(resultType, loc));
  }

  builder.setInsertionPointToStart(body);
  SmallVector<Value> callInputs;
  for (auto [idx, operand] : llvm::enumerate(ins)) {
    if (!inputFusible.lookup(idx)) {
      callInputs.push_back(operand);
      continue;
    }
    if (!isa<MO::TensorType>(operand.getType())) {
      op->emitOpError(
          "MOToMAP: input fusion is only supported for tensor operands");
      return failure();
    }
    callInputs.push_back(buildLoadPrologue(builder, loc, operand).getResult());
  }

  SmallVector<Value> callOutputs;
  for (auto [idx, out] : llvm::enumerate(outs)) {
    if (!outputFusible.lookup(idx)) {
      callOutputs.push_back(out);
      continue;
    }
    if (!isa<MO::TensorType>(out.getType())) {
      op->emitOpError(
          "MOToMAP: output fusion is only supported for tensor results");
      return failure();
    }
    callOutputs.push_back(buildStoreEpilogue(builder, loc, out).getResult());
  }

  // Parameters named only by opaque types (e.g.
  // `MakeSimdPair.execute[P0, P1]() -> SIMDPair[P0, P1]`).
  DictionaryAttr params = inferParameters(op, builder);
  if (adaptor.executeFunction && adaptor.executeFunction->attr) {
    SmallVector<NamedAttribute> withOpaque(params.begin(), params.end());
    MOGG::inferOpaqueParameters(withOpaque, op, *adaptor.executeFunction,
                                adaptor.executeFunction->attr.getParams());
    params = builder.getDictionaryAttr(withOpaque);
  }

  builder.setInsertionPointToEnd(body);
  auto callOp = MAP::CallOpaqueOp::create(
      builder, loc,
      opaqueResultType ? TypeRange{opaqueResultType} : TypeRange{},
      FlatSymbolRefAttr::get(op->getContext(),
                             adaptor.fullyResolvedName.strref()),
      adaptor.registeredOpName, params,
      /*inputs=*/callInputs,
      /*outputs=*/callOutputs);
  // Needed later to split the flat operands back into equal-length variadic
  // groups (e.g. a bundled collective's N peers and N signal buffers).
  callOp.setHasSameVariadicOperandSize(
      isa<MO::SameVariadicOperandSizeInterface>(op));

  // Only a by-value opaque result needs a terminator.
  if (opaqueResultType)
    MAP::YieldOp::create(builder, loc, callOp.getOpaqueResult());

  op->replaceAllUsesWith(opaque.getResults());
  op->erase();
  return opaque.getOperation();
}

// Lowers an elementwise MO op to a `map.iter.elementwise` expressing its loop
// body explicitly: one `map.load` per input, a `map.call.elementwise` call
// to the kernel's scalar function, and a `map.store` into the output, all
// indexed by the op's `map.index<N>` block argument.
LogicalResult
lowerElementwiseToForeach(Operation *op,
                          const MOGG::KernelDeclAdaptor &adaptor) {
  if (op->getNumResults() != 1)
    return op->emitOpError(
        "MOToMAP: elementwise op must have exactly one result");

  auto resultTensorTy = dyn_cast<MO::TensorType>(op->getResult(0).getType());
  if (!resultTensorTy)
    return op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: elementwise op result must be !mo.tensor");

  MLIRContext *ctx = op->getContext();
  Location loc = op->getLoc();
  OpBuilder builder(op);

  MOSH::ShapeAttr shapeAttr = resultTensorTy.getShape();
  unsigned rank = static_cast<unsigned>(shapeAttr.getRank());
  Type elemTy = resultTensorTy.getElementType();

  auto foreachOp = MAP::IterElementwiseOp::create(
      builder, loc,
      /*resultTypes=*/SmallVector<Type>{resultTensorTy},
      /*shape=*/shapeAttr,
      /*inputs=*/op->getOperands(),
      /*chain=*/Value(),
      /*fusionInfo=*/
      MOGG::FusionInfoAttr::get(ctx, MOGG::createFusionLeaf(op)));
  stampAsyncLaunch(foreachOp, op);

  // Body block args: [input tensors..., output tensor, map.index<rank>].
  Block *body = &foreachOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
  for (Value operand : op->getOperands())
    body->addArgument(operand.getType(), loc);
  body->addArgument(resultTensorTy, loc);
  body->addArgument(MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, rank), loc);

  OpBuilder bodyBuilder = OpBuilder::atBlockEnd(body);
  BlockArgument idxArg = body->getArguments().back();

  SmallVector<Value> scalarLoads;
  for (auto [i, operand] : llvm::enumerate(op->getOperands())) {
    BlockArgument inputArg = body->getArgument(i);
    auto inputTensorTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(operand.getType());
    Value loaded = MAP::LoadOp::create(
        bodyBuilder, loc, inputTensorTy.getElementType(), inputArg, idxArg);
    scalarLoads.push_back(loaded);
  }

  auto kernelSymbol =
      FlatSymbolRefAttr::get(ctx, adaptor.fullyResolvedName.strref());
  DictionaryAttr params = inferParameters(op, builder);
  if (params.empty())
    params = nullptr;
  Value scalar = MAP::CallElementwiseOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, elemTy, kernelSymbol, params, idxArg, scalarLoads);

  BlockArgument outputArg =
      body->getArgument(static_cast<unsigned>(op->getNumOperands()));
  MAP::StoreOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, outputArg, idxArg, scalar);

  op->replaceAllUsesWith(foreachOp.getResults());
  op->erase();
  return success();
}

// Lowers mo.mutable.store to a map.iter.elementwise that `map.store`s directly
// into its buffer input and threads a chain in and out. Its elementwise
// function is a scalar identity (gather_scatter.mojo's MutableStore).
// Special-cased by identity, as there is no generic mechanism (GEX-2360).
LogicalResult
lowerMutableStoreToForeach(MO::MutableStoreOp op,
                           const MOGG::KernelDeclAdaptor &adaptor) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = op->getContext();
  Location loc = op->getLoc();
  OpBuilder builder(op);

  MO::TensorType bufferAsTensorTy = op.getInBuffer().getType().toTensorType();
  MOSH::ShapeAttr shapeAttr = bufferAsTensorTy.getShape();
  unsigned rank = static_cast<unsigned>(shapeAttr.getRank());
  Type elemTy = bufferAsTensorTy.getElementType();

  auto [hasReadEffect, hasWriteEffect] = getReadWriteEffects(op);

  auto foreachOp = MAP::IterElementwiseOp::create(
      builder, loc,
      /*resultTypes=*/SmallVector<Type>{MO::ChainType::get(ctx)},
      /*shape=*/shapeAttr,
      /*inputs=*/ValueRange{op.getInTensor(), op.getInBuffer()},
      /*chain=*/op.getInChain(),
      /*fusionInfo=*/
      MOGG::FusionInfoAttr::get(ctx, MOGG::createFusionLeaf(op)),
      /*hasReadEffect=*/hasReadEffect,
      /*hasWriteEffect=*/hasWriteEffect);
  stampAsyncLaunch(foreachOp, op);

  // Body block args: [tensor value, buffer, map.index<rank>]; the buffer is
  // the store target.
  Block *body = &foreachOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
  BlockArgument valueArg = body->addArgument(op.getInTensor().getType(), loc);
  BlockArgument bufferArg = body->addArgument(op.getInBuffer().getType(), loc);
  BlockArgument idxArg = body->addArgument(MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, rank), loc);

  OpBuilder bodyBuilder = OpBuilder::atBlockEnd(body);
  Value loaded =
      MAP::LoadOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, elemTy, valueArg, idxArg);

  auto kernelSymbol =
      FlatSymbolRefAttr::get(ctx, adaptor.fullyResolvedName.strref());
  DictionaryAttr params = inferParameters(op, builder);
  if (params.empty())
    params = nullptr;
  Value scalar =
      MAP::CallElementwiseOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, elemTy, kernelSymbol,
                                     params, idxArg, ValueRange{loaded});

  MAP::StoreOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, bufferArg, idxArg, scalar);

  op->replaceAllUsesWith(foreachOp.getResults());
  op->erase();
  return success();
}

// Lowers mo.slice to a map.iter.elementwise over the *output* shape (the "pull"
// model): the body computes the input index via map.index.slice, loads, and
// stores unchanged.
LogicalResult lowerSliceToForeach(MO::SliceOp op) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = op->getContext();
  Location loc = op->getLoc();
  OpBuilder builder(op);

  auto inputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(op.getInput().getType());
  auto outputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(op.getResult().getType());
  MOSH::ShapeAttr inShape = inputTy.getShape();
  MOSH::ShapeAttr outShape = outputTy.getShape();
  if (inShape.getRank() != outShape.getRank())
    return op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: slice must preserve rank");
  int64_t rank = outShape.getRank();

  // MO tracks constness per tensor, not per dimension.
  auto boundsOrDynamic = [&](Value v) {
    if (auto constVec = MO::tryGetConstantIntVector(cast<MO::TensorValue>(v)))
      return mlir::DenseI64ArrayAttr::get(ctx, *constVec);
    return mlir::DenseI64ArrayAttr::get(
        ctx, SmallVector<int64_t>(rank, ShapedType::kDynamic));
  };

  SmallVector<int64_t> inDims = inShape.getIntDims();
  SmallVector<int64_t> starts(boundsOrDynamic(op.getStart()).asArrayRef());
  SmallVector<int64_t> stops(boundsOrDynamic(op.getStop()).asArrayRef());
  SmallVector<int64_t> steps(boundsOrDynamic(op.getStep()).asArrayRef());

  // Normalize Python-style negative and out-of-range bounds, matching
  // materializeSliceShape's clamp.
  for (int64_t i = 0; i < rank; ++i) {
    if (ShapedType::isDynamic(inDims[i]) || ShapedType::isDynamic(steps[i]) ||
        steps[i] == 0)
      continue;
    int64_t dim = inDims[i];
    // A reverse slice walks down to -1, so it clamps one below the forward
    // range.
    int64_t lo = steps[i] > 0 ? 0 : -1;
    int64_t hi = steps[i] > 0 ? dim : dim - 1;
    auto normalize = [&](int64_t v) {
      if (ShapedType::isDynamic(v))
        return v;
      return std::clamp<int64_t>(v < 0 ? v + dim : v, lo, hi);
    };
    starts[i] = normalize(starts[i]);
    stops[i] = normalize(stops[i]);
  }

  // Verify first: `get` asserts on a rejected spec.
  auto emitSliceError = [&] { return op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: "); };
  if (failed(MAP::SliceSpecAttr::verify(
          emitSliceError, MAP::ViewSignatureAttr::get(ctx, inShape, outShape),
          mlir::DenseI64ArrayAttr::get(ctx, starts),
          mlir::DenseI64ArrayAttr::get(ctx, stops),
          mlir::DenseI64ArrayAttr::get(ctx, steps))))
    return failure();

  auto spec =
      MAP::SliceSpecAttr::get(ctx, inShape, outShape, starts, stops, steps);

  auto foreachOp = MAP::IterElementwiseOp::create(
      builder, loc,
      /*resultTypes=*/SmallVector<Type>{outputTy},
      /*shape=*/outShape,
      /*inputs=*/op->getOperands(),
      /*chain=*/Value(),
      /*fusionInfo=*/
      MOGG::FusionInfoAttr::get(ctx, MOGG::createFusionLeaf(op)));
  stampAsyncLaunch(foreachOp, op);

  // Body block args: [input, start, stop, step, output, map.index<rank>].
  Block *body = &foreachOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
  for (Value operand : op->getOperands())
    body->addArgument(operand.getType(), loc);
  body->addArgument(outputTy, loc);
  BlockArgument idxArg = body->addArgument(MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, rank), loc);

  OpBuilder bodyBuilder = OpBuilder::atBlockEnd(body);
  BlockArgument inputArg = body->getArgument(0);
  BlockArgument startsArg = body->getArgument(1);
  BlockArgument stopsArg = body->getArgument(2);
  BlockArgument stepsArg = body->getArgument(3);
  BlockArgument outputArg = body->getArgument(4);

  Value innerIdx = MAP::SliceIndexOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, rank), spec, idxArg, startsArg,
      stopsArg, stepsArg);
  Value loaded = MAP::LoadOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, outputTy.getElementType(), inputArg, innerIdx);
  MAP::StoreOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, outputArg, idxArg, loaded);

  op->replaceAllUsesWith(foreachOp.getResults());
  op->erase();
  return success();
}

// Lowers mo.static.broadcast_to like lowerSliceToForeach, via
// map.index.broadcast. Broadcast can add rank, so the load index rank may
// differ from the loop's.
LogicalResult lowerBroadcastToForeach(Static::BroadcastToOp op) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = op->getContext();
  Location loc = op->getLoc();
  OpBuilder builder(op);

  auto inputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(op.getInput().getType());
  auto outputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(op.getResult().getType());
  MOSH::ShapeAttr inShape = inputTy.getShape();
  MOSH::ShapeAttr outShape = outputTy.getShape();
  if (inShape.getRank() > outShape.getRank())
    return op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: broadcast cannot reduce rank");
  int64_t inRank = inShape.getRank();
  int64_t outRank = outShape.getRank();

  auto spec = MAP::BroadcastSpecAttr::get(
      ctx, MAP::ViewSignatureAttr::get(ctx, inShape, outShape));

  auto foreachOp = MAP::IterElementwiseOp::create(
      builder, loc,
      /*resultTypes=*/SmallVector<Type>{outputTy},
      /*shape=*/outShape,
      /*inputs=*/op->getOperands(),
      /*chain=*/Value(),
      /*fusionInfo=*/
      MOGG::FusionInfoAttr::get(ctx, MOGG::createFusionLeaf(op)));
  stampAsyncLaunch(foreachOp, op);

  // Body block args: [input, output, map.index<outRank>].
  Block *body = &foreachOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
  for (Value operand : op->getOperands())
    body->addArgument(operand.getType(), loc);
  body->addArgument(outputTy, loc);
  BlockArgument idxArg =
      body->addArgument(MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, outRank), loc);

  OpBuilder bodyBuilder = OpBuilder::atBlockEnd(body);
  BlockArgument inputArg = body->getArgument(0);
  BlockArgument outputArg = body->getArgument(1);

  Value innerIdx = MAP::BroadcastIndexOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, inRank), spec, idxArg);
  Value loaded = MAP::LoadOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, outputTy.getElementType(), inputArg, innerIdx);
  MAP::StoreOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, outputArg, idxArg, loaded);

  op->replaceAllUsesWith(foreachOp.getResults());
  op->erase();
  return success();
}

// Lowers mo.static.reshape like lowerSliceToForeach, via map.index.reshape.
// Rank may change in either direction.
LogicalResult lowerReshapeToForeach(MO::Static::ReshapeOp op) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = op->getContext();
  Location loc = op->getLoc();
  OpBuilder builder(op);

  auto inputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(op.getInput().getType());
  auto outputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(op.getResult().getType());
  MOSH::ShapeAttr inShape = inputTy.getShape();
  MOSH::ShapeAttr outShape = outputTy.getShape();
  int64_t inRank = inShape.getRank();
  int64_t outRank = outShape.getRank();

  auto spec = MAP::ReshapeSpecAttr::get(
      ctx, MAP::ViewSignatureAttr::get(ctx, inShape, outShape));

  auto foreachOp = MAP::IterElementwiseOp::create(
      builder, loc,
      /*resultTypes=*/SmallVector<Type>{outputTy},
      /*shape=*/outShape,
      /*inputs=*/op->getOperands(),
      /*chain=*/Value(),
      /*fusionInfo=*/
      MOGG::FusionInfoAttr::get(ctx, MOGG::createFusionLeaf(op)));
  stampAsyncLaunch(foreachOp, op);

  // Body block args: [input, output, map.index<outRank>].
  Block *body = &foreachOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
  for (Value operand : op->getOperands())
    body->addArgument(operand.getType(), loc);
  body->addArgument(outputTy, loc);
  BlockArgument idxArg =
      body->addArgument(MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, outRank), loc);

  OpBuilder bodyBuilder = OpBuilder::atBlockEnd(body);
  BlockArgument inputArg = body->getArgument(0);
  BlockArgument outputArg = body->getArgument(1);

  Value innerIdx = MAP::ReshapeIndexOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, inRank), spec, idxArg);
  Value loaded = MAP::LoadOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, outputTy.getElementType(), inputArg, innerIdx);
  MAP::StoreOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, outputArg, idxArg, loaded);

  op->replaceAllUsesWith(foreachOp.getResults());
  op->erase();
  return success();
}

// Lowers mo.transpose like lowerSliceToForeach, via map.index.transpose. The
// perm is a runtime operand, also baked into `spec` when constant; otherwise
// (the eager interpreter's one-graph-per-op transpose) `spec` is all-dynamic.
LogicalResult lowerTransposeToForeach(MO::TransposeOp op) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = op->getContext();
  Location loc = op->getLoc();
  OpBuilder builder(op);

  auto inputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(op.getInput().getType());
  auto outputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(op.getResult().getType());
  MOSH::ShapeAttr inShape = inputTy.getShape();
  MOSH::ShapeAttr outShape = outputTy.getShape();
  if (inShape.getRank() != outShape.getRank())
    return op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: transpose must preserve rank");
  int64_t rank = outShape.getRank();

  auto permAttr = mlir::DenseI64ArrayAttr::get(
      ctx, SmallVector<int64_t>(rank, ShapedType::kDynamic));
  if (auto permVec =
          MO::tryGetConstantIntVector(cast<MO::TensorValue>(op.getPerm())))
    permAttr = mlir::DenseI64ArrayAttr::get(ctx, *permVec);

  auto spec = MAP::TransposeSpecAttr::get(
      ctx, MAP::ViewSignatureAttr::get(ctx, inShape, outShape), permAttr);

  auto foreachOp = MAP::IterElementwiseOp::create(
      builder, loc,
      /*resultTypes=*/SmallVector<Type>{outputTy},
      /*shape=*/outShape,
      /*inputs=*/op->getOperands(),
      /*chain=*/Value(),
      /*fusionInfo=*/
      MOGG::FusionInfoAttr::get(ctx, MOGG::createFusionLeaf(op)));
  stampAsyncLaunch(foreachOp, op);

  // Body block args: [input, perm, output, map.index<rank>].
  Block *body = &foreachOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
  for (Value operand : op->getOperands())
    body->addArgument(operand.getType(), loc);
  body->addArgument(outputTy, loc);
  BlockArgument idxArg = body->addArgument(MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, rank), loc);

  OpBuilder bodyBuilder = OpBuilder::atBlockEnd(body);
  BlockArgument inputArg = body->getArgument(0);
  BlockArgument permArg = body->getArgument(1);
  BlockArgument outputArg = body->getArgument(2);

  Value innerIdx = MAP::TransposeIndexOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, rank), spec, idxArg, permArg);
  Value loaded = MAP::LoadOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, outputTy.getElementType(), inputArg, innerIdx);
  MAP::StoreOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, outputArg, idxArg, loaded);

  op->replaceAllUsesWith(foreachOp.getResults());
  op->erase();
  return success();
}

// Lowers a reduction monoid to a `map.iter.rowwise`: one fold over the input,
// then a per-row store of each output field. Expects a verified reduction.
LogicalResult lowerReductionToRowwise(Operation *op,
                                      const MOGG::KernelDeclAdaptor &adaptor) {
  ErrorOr<int64_t> axis =
      MO::getReductionAxis(op->getOperand(0), op->getResultTypes());
  if (axis.isError())
    return op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: reduction ") << axis.getError();

  MLIRContext *ctx = op->getContext();
  Location loc = op->getLoc();
  OpBuilder builder(op);

  Value input = op->getOperand(0);
  auto inputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(input.getType());
  MOSH::ShapeAttr shapeAttr = inputTy.getShape();
  auto indexTy = MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, shapeAttr.getRank());

  auto rowwiseOp = MAP::IterRowwiseOp::create(
      builder, loc, op->getResultTypes(), shapeAttr,
      builder.getI64IntegerAttr(*axis), ValueRange{input},
      /*chain=*/Value(),
      MOGG::FusionInfoAttr::get(ctx, MOGG::createFusionLeaf(op)));
  stampAsyncLaunch(rowwiseOp, op);

  // Body block args: [input, outputs..., row].
  Block *body = &rowwiseOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
  BlockArgument inputArg = body->addArgument(inputTy, loc);
  SmallVector<BlockArgument> outputArgs;
  for (Type resultTy : op->getResultTypes())
    outputArgs.push_back(body->addArgument(resultTy, loc));
  BlockArgument rowArg = body->addArgument(indexTy, loc);

  SmallVector<Type> foldTypes;
  for (Type resultTy : op->getResultTypes())
    foldTypes.push_back(cast<MO::TensorType>(resultTy).getElementType());

  OpBuilder bodyBuilder = OpBuilder::atBlockEnd(body);
  auto reduceOp = MAP::IterReduceOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, foldTypes,
      FlatSymbolRefAttr::get(ctx, adaptor.fullyResolvedName.strref()));
  {
    OpBuilder::InsertionGuard guard(bodyBuilder);
    Block *foldBody = &reduceOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
    BlockArgument idxArg = foldBody->addArgument(indexTy, loc);
    bodyBuilder.setInsertionPointToEnd(foldBody);
    Value loaded = MAP::LoadOp::create(
        bodyBuilder, loc, inputTy.getElementType(), inputArg, idxArg);
    MAP::YieldOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, loaded);
  }

  for (auto [outputArg, field] :
       llvm::zip_equal(outputArgs, reduceOp.getResults()))
    MAP::StoreOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, outputArg, rowArg, field);

  op->replaceAllUsesWith(rowwiseOp.getResults());
  op->erase();
  return success();
}

// See `lowerMOOpToMAP`.
FailureOr<Operation *> lowerOp(Operation *op, MOGG::MojoRegistry &registry) {
  ErrorOr<MOGG::KernelDeclAdaptor> adaptor =
      MOGG::getMojoKernelAdaptor(registry, op);
  if (adaptor.isError())
    return nullptr;

  if (auto mutableStoreOp = dyn_cast<MO::MutableStoreOp>(op)) {
    if (failed(lowerMutableStoreToForeach(mutableStoreOp, *adaptor)))
      return failure();
    return nullptr;
  }

  // Reductions have no executeFunction either.
  if (adaptor->isReduction()) {
    if (failed(lowerReductionToRowwise(op, *adaptor)))
      return failure();
    return nullptr;
  }

  // Elementwise kernels have no executeFunction.
  if (adaptor->isElementwise()) {
    if (failed(lowerElementwiseToForeach(op, *adaptor)))
      return failure();
    return nullptr;
  }

  if (!adaptor->executeFunction) {
    op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: kernel has no execute function");
    return failure();
  }

  ErrorOr<MOGG::KernelDeclOperandMapping> mapping =
      MOGG::mapMOOpToKernelImplementation(op, *adaptor->executeFunction);
  if (mapping.isError()) {
    op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: failed to map operands to kernel");
    return failure();
  }

  LogicalResult foreachResult = success();
  if (isa<MO::InvokeShapeFuncOp>(op)) {
    op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: shape-function kernels are not yet supported");
    return failure();
  } else if (auto sliceOp = dyn_cast<MO::SliceOp>(op)) {
    foreachResult = lowerSliceToForeach(sliceOp);
  } else if (auto broadcastOp = dyn_cast<MO::Static::BroadcastToOp>(op)) {
    foreachResult = lowerBroadcastToForeach(broadcastOp);
  } else if (auto reshapeOp = dyn_cast<MO::Static::ReshapeOp>(op)) {
    foreachResult = lowerReshapeToForeach(reshapeOp);
  } else if (auto transposeOp = dyn_cast<MO::TransposeOp>(op)) {
    foreachResult = lowerTransposeToForeach(transposeOp);
  } else {
    return lowerToOpaque(op, *adaptor, *mapping);
  }

  if (failed(foreachResult))
    return failure();
  return nullptr;
}

struct MOToMAPPass : public M::MO::impl::MOToMAPBase<MOToMAPPass> {
  using Base::Base;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    MOGG::MojoRegistry registry(getOperation());

    SmallVector<Operation *> worklist;
    WalkResult walkResult = getOperation()->walk([&](Operation *op) {
      Dialect *dialect = op->getDialect();
      if (dialect && isa<MO::MODialect>(dialect) && !hasLowerableRank(op)) {
        op->emitError() << "'" << op->getName().getStringRef()
                        << "' op has a tensor whose rank exceeds the maximum "
                           "supported rank of "
                        << kMaxRank << "; the graph cannot be lowered";
        return WalkResult::interrupt();
      }
      if (shouldLower(op))
        worklist.push_back(op);
      return WalkResult::advance();
    });
    if (walkResult.wasInterrupted())
      return signalPassFailure();

    for (Operation *op : worklist)
      if (failed(lowerOp(op, registry)))
        return signalPassFailure();
  }
};

} // namespace

FailureOr<Operation *> lowerMOOpToMAP(Operation *op,
                                      MOGG::MojoRegistry &registry) {
  return lowerOp(op, registry);
}

} // namespace M::MO

#include "GraphCompiler/Conversion/OperandInference.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MODevices.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOOps.h"

namespace M::MOGG {

static bool opHasExtraOutputShapeArgument(Operation *op) {
  return isa<MO::Static::ReshapeOp, MO::Static::BroadcastToOp>(op);
}

static StringRef moOperationName(Operation *op) {
  if (auto customOp = dyn_cast<MO::CustomOp>(op))
    return customOp.getSymbol();

  return op->getName().getStringRef();
}

static std::optional<KernelDeclOperandVariant>
MOTypeToKernelDeclOperand(Type type) {
  auto iface = dyn_cast<MO::MOKernelOperandTypeInterface>(type);
  if (!iface)
    return std::nullopt;
  switch (iface.getKernelOperandKind()) {
  case MO::KernelOperandKind::Tensor:
    return KernelDeclTensorAdaptor{MOGG::IOSpec::InputTensor};
  case MO::KernelOperandKind::Buffer:
    return KernelDeclTensorAdaptor{MOGG::IOSpec::MutableInputTensor};
  case MO::KernelOperandKind::Scalar:
    return KernelDeclScalarAdaptor{};
  case MO::KernelOperandKind::Opaque:
    return KernelDeclOpaqueAdaptor{iface.getKernelOperandOpaqueName()};
  }
  return std::nullopt;
}

static ErrorOrSuccess
matchConvertedMOTypeToKernelDeclType(const KernelDeclOperandVariant &moType,
                                     const KernelDeclOperandVariant &kernelType,
                                     Type originalMOType,
                                     bool allowMutToImmut) {
  if (moType == kernelType)
    return success();

  // Reading mutable storage as an immutable snapshot is sound (the converse
  // is not); see `allowMutToImmut`.
  if (allowMutToImmut) {
    if (const auto *kernelTensor =
            std::get_if<KernelDeclTensorAdaptor>(&kernelType)) {
      const auto *moTensor = std::get_if<KernelDeclTensorAdaptor>(&moType);
      if (moTensor && moTensor->mut && !kernelTensor->mut)
        return success();
    }
  }

  if (std::holds_alternative<KernelDeclVariadicTensorAdaptor>(kernelType)) {
    const auto *tensorType = std::get_if<KernelDeclTensorAdaptor>(&moType);
    if (!tensorType)
      return Error("MO type is not a tensor type");

    const auto &kernelTensor =
        std::get<KernelDeclVariadicTensorAdaptor>(kernelType);
    if (kernelTensor.mut != tensorType->mut)
      return Error("Tensor type mismatch");

    return success();
  }

  if (std::holds_alternative<KernelDeclScalarAdaptor>(kernelType)) {
    const auto *tensorType = std::get_if<KernelDeclTensorAdaptor>(&moType);
    if (!tensorType)
      return Error("MO type is not a tensor type");

    if (tensorType->mut)
      return Error("Expected an immutable tensor type");

    // Opaque codegen handles (`!mogg.tensor`) carry no rank/device and were
    // validated upstream.
    if (auto shaped = dyn_cast<MO::MOShapedTypeInterface>(originalMOType))
      if (shaped.getRank() != 0)
        return Error("MO tensor type should have a rank of 0");

    if (isa<MO::MOHasDeviceTypeInterface>(originalMOType) &&
        !MO::isOnHost(originalMOType))
      return Error("Scalars should always be on the host CPU");

    return success();
  }

  return Error("Mismatched types");
}

template <bool matchOperands>
static ErrorOr<KernelDeclIndexToOperandAdaptorMapping>
matchOperandsOrResultsKernelDecl(ValueRange values,
                                 const KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor &adaptor,
                                 StringRef opName,
                                 bool hasSameVariadicOperandSize,
                                 bool hasExtraOutputShapeArgument,
                                 bool resultLeavesByValue,
                                 bool allowMutToImmut) {
  static const char *argumentKind = matchOperands ? "input" : "output";

  // Launch arguments (the `execute` device context, the `build_graph` graph
  // builder) have no MO operand; skipping them by kind lets one mapping serve
  // every function variant of a kernel.
  auto skipLaunchArgument =
      [](const llvm::SmallVector<KernelDeclOperandAdaptor> &operands,
         uint64_t &idx) -> std::optional<KernelDeclOperandAdaptor> {
    while (idx < operands.size()) {
      if (!operands[idx].isLaunchArgument())
        return operands[idx];
      ++idx;
    }
    return std::nullopt;
  };

  auto skipChainType = [](auto range, uint64_t &idx) -> std::optional<Type> {
    while (idx < range.size()) {
      if (!isa<MO::ChainType>(range[idx]))
        return range[idx];
      ++idx;
    }
    return std::nullopt;
  };

  const llvm::SmallVector<KernelDeclOperandAdaptor> &kernelOperands =
      matchOperands ? adaptor.inputArguments : adaptor.outputArguments;

  uint64_t mojoVariadicsCount = 0;
  uint64_t mojoNonVariadicsCount = 0;
  uint64_t moOperandsCount = 0;
  uint64_t moOpIndex = 0, kernelIndex = 0;

  while (true) {
    auto moType = skipChainType(values.getTypes(), moOpIndex);
    if (!moType.has_value())
      break;
    ++moOpIndex;
    ++moOperandsCount;
  }

  while (true) {
    auto kernelType = skipLaunchArgument(kernelOperands, kernelIndex);
    if (!kernelType.has_value())
      break;
    if (kernelType->isVariadicTensorType())
      ++mojoVariadicsCount;
    else
      ++mojoNonVariadicsCount;
    ++kernelIndex;
  }

  uint64_t variadicSize = 0;
  if (mojoVariadicsCount > 0) {
    if (mojoVariadicsCount > 1 && !hasSameVariadicOperandSize) {
      return Error(llvm::formatv(
          "Op '{}' binds {} variadic {} tensor arguments, but an op's flat "
          "operand list carries no group boundaries, so it can bind at most "
          "one per operand list. Several equal-sized groups require a "
          "dedicated op that implements SameVariadicOperandSize",
          opName, mojoVariadicsCount, argumentKind));
    }
    uint64_t totalVariadicOperands =
        moOperandsCount < mojoNonVariadicsCount
            ? 0
            : moOperandsCount - mojoNonVariadicsCount;
    if (totalVariadicOperands % mojoVariadicsCount != 0) {
      return Error(llvm::formatv(
          "Op '{}' has a total {} variadic operands divided "
          "between {} variadic kernel operands. They are expected "
          "to divide evenly",
          opName, totalVariadicOperands, mojoVariadicsCount));
    }
    variadicSize = totalVariadicOperands / mojoVariadicsCount;
  }

  KernelDeclIndexToOperandAdaptorMapping mapping;
  moOpIndex = 0, kernelIndex = 0;
  uint64_t currVariadicSize = 0;
  bool matchingVariadicTensor = false;

  while (true) {
    auto moType = skipChainType(values.getTypes(), moOpIndex);
    auto kernelType = skipLaunchArgument(kernelOperands, kernelIndex);

    if (!moType.has_value() || !kernelType.has_value())
      break;

    auto moTypeToKernelDeclOperand = MOTypeToKernelDeclOperand(*moType);
    if (!moTypeToKernelDeclOperand.has_value()) {
      return Error(
          llvm::formatv("Unsupported op argument type at index {}", moOpIndex));
    }

    auto errorOnMatch = matchConvertedMOTypeToKernelDeclType(
        *moTypeToKernelDeclOperand, kernelType->underlyingType, *moType,
        allowMutToImmut);

    if (errorOnMatch.isError()) {
      return Error(llvm::formatv(
          "Op '{}' {} at position {} does not match registered kernel operand "
          "at position {}: {} vs {}. Detail: {}",
          opName, argumentKind, moOpIndex,
          kernelType->sourceDescriptor->position, *moTypeToKernelDeclOperand,
          *kernelType, errorOnMatch.getError()));
    }

    mapping[moOpIndex] = *kernelType;

    if (kernelType->isVariadicTensorType()) {
      matchingVariadicTensor = true;
      if (++currVariadicSize == variadicSize) {
        matchingVariadicTensor = false;
        currVariadicSize = 0;
      }
    }

    ++moOpIndex;
    kernelIndex += !matchingVariadicTensor;
  }

  if (matchingVariadicTensor)
    skipLaunchArgument(kernelOperands, ++kernelIndex);

  bool moOpEnd = moOpIndex == values.size();
  bool kernelEnd = kernelIndex == kernelOperands.size();

  if (hasExtraOutputShapeArgument)
    return mapping;

  if (!kernelEnd) {
    return Error(llvm::formatv(
        "Could not provide all {} arguments to op '{}': missing operands "
        "starting from argument named '{}'",
        argumentKind, opName,
        kernelOperands[kernelIndex].sourceDescriptor->sourceName.str()));
  }

  if constexpr (matchOperands) {
    if (!moOpEnd) {
      return Error(
          llvm::formatv("Op '{}' has too many operands: operands starting "
                        "at position {} has no equivalent in kernel",
                        opName, moOpIndex));
    }
    return mapping;
  }

  auto moType = skipChainType(values.getTypes(), moOpIndex);

  // A by-ref result of unrecognized type (KernelDeclUnsupported) is treated as
  // absent. A by-value result has no entry in `values` to match.
  bool hasValidOutputResult =
      !resultLeavesByValue && adaptor.outputResult.has_value() &&
      !std::holds_alternative<KernelDeclUnsupportedAdaptor>(
          adaptor.outputResult->underlyingType);

  if (!moType.has_value() && !hasValidOutputResult)
    return mapping;

  if (moType.has_value() && !hasValidOutputResult) {
    return Error(llvm::formatv(
        "Op '{}' has too many results: results starting at position {} have no "
        "equivalent output argument or function result in kernel",
        opName, moOpIndex));
  }

  if (!moType.has_value() && hasValidOutputResult) {
    return Error(llvm::formatv(
        "Op '{}' is missing a result for kernel function result of type {}",
        opName, *adaptor.outputResult));
  }

  auto moTypeToKernelDeclOperand = MOTypeToKernelDeclOperand(*moType);
  if (!moTypeToKernelDeclOperand.has_value()) {
    return Error(
        llvm::formatv("Op '{}': Unsupported op result type at position {}",
                      opName, moOpIndex));
  }

  auto errorOnMatch = matchConvertedMOTypeToKernelDeclType(
      *moTypeToKernelDeclOperand, adaptor.outputResult->underlyingType, *moType,
      /*allowMutToImmut=*/false);
  if (errorOnMatch.isError()) {
    return Error(llvm::formatv(
        "Op '{}' output at position {} does not match kernel function result; "
        "op has {} but kernel has {}. Detail: {}",
        opName, moOpIndex, *moTypeToKernelDeclOperand, *adaptor.outputResult,
        errorOnMatch.getError()));
  }
  mapping[moOpIndex] = *adaptor.outputResult;

  return mapping;
}

ErrorOr<KernelDeclOperandMapping>
mapToKernelImplementation(ValueRange operands, ValueRange results,
                          const KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor &adaptor,
                          StringRef opName, bool hasSameVariadicOperandSize,
                          bool hasExtraOutputShapeArgument,
                          bool resultLeavesByValue, bool allowMutToImmut) {
  auto matchedInputsOrError = matchOperandsOrResultsKernelDecl<true>(
      operands, adaptor, opName, hasSameVariadicOperandSize,
      hasExtraOutputShapeArgument, /*resultLeavesByValue=*/false,
      allowMutToImmut);
  if (matchedInputsOrError.isError())
    return matchedInputsOrError.takeError();

  // Outputs are destination-passing (mutable); the mut->immut widening only
  // applies to read-only inputs.
  auto matchedOutputsOrError = matchOperandsOrResultsKernelDecl<false>(
      results, adaptor, opName, hasSameVariadicOperandSize,
      hasExtraOutputShapeArgument, resultLeavesByValue,
      /*allowMutToImmut=*/false);
  if (matchedOutputsOrError.isError())
    return matchedOutputsOrError.takeError();

  return KernelDeclOperandMapping{matchedInputsOrError.takeValue(),
                                  matchedOutputsOrError.takeValue()};
}

ErrorOr<KernelDeclOperandMapping>
mapMOOpToKernelImplementation(Operation *op,
                              const KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor &adaptor) {
  return mapToKernelImplementation(
      op->getOperands(), op->getResults(), adaptor, moOperationName(op),
      isa<MO::SameVariadicOperandSizeInterface>(op),
      opHasExtraOutputShapeArgument(op), /*resultLeavesByValue=*/false);
}

namespace {

class MOFDriverOptions : public DriverOptions,
                         public MO::GraphCompilerOptions {};

/// Union of configuration gathered from MOFContext::setConfigs().
struct MOFConfig {
  SmallVector<std::string> kernelLibraryPaths;
  std::optional<std::string> defaultDeviceLabel;
  std::optional<size_t> deviceID;
  std::optional<DeviceSpec> deviceSpec;
  bool tileBasedFusion = false;

  void overrideLoweringOptions(MO::GCPipelineOptions &gcPipelineOptions) const {
    gcPipelineOptions.compiledFrameworkLabel =
        CompiledFrameworkLabel::asLabelString(
            CompiledFrameworkLabel::kModularModel);
    gcPipelineOptions.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
    if (defaultDeviceLabel) {
      gcPipelineOptions.defaultDeviceLabel = *defaultDeviceLabel;
      if (deviceID)
        gcPipelineOptions.defaultDeviceId = *deviceID;
    }
    gcPipelineOptions.defaultDeviceTargetTriple =
        deviceSpec ? deviceSpec.value().target.triple.str() : "";
    gcPipelineOptions.defaultDeviceTargetArch =
        deviceSpec ? deviceSpec.value().target.arch : "";
  }
};

} // namespace

struct MOFContext::Impl final {
  ContextRef maxContext;
  std::unique_ptr<MOFDriverOptions> clOptions;
  const DriverOptions *driverOptions{nullptr};
  std::unique_ptr<MO::GraphCompilerCLOptions> graphCompilerParser;
  std::unique_ptr<MOFConfig> mofConfig;
  bool optionsParsed{false};

  const CommonOptions *getCommonCLOptions() const {
    return driverOptions ? static_cast<const CommonOptions *>(driverOptions)
                         : clOptions.get();
  }

  bool getEnableMEFMetadata() const {
    return driverOptions ? driverOptions->enableMEFMetadata
                         : (clOptions ? clOptions->enableMEFMetadata : true);
  }
};

/// Constructor when invoking from command line.
MOFContext::MOFContext(ContextRef maxContext, int &argc, char **&argv)
    : impl(std::make_unique<Impl>()) {
  impl->maxContext = std::move(maxContext);
  impl->clOptions = std::make_unique<MOFDriverOptions>();
  impl->driverOptions = impl->clOptions.get();
  impl->clOptions->programName = argv[0];
  (void)argc;
  impl->graphCompilerParser =
      std::make_unique<MO::GraphCompilerCLOptions>(*impl->clOptions);
}

/// Constructor when invoking via API.
MOFContext::MOFContext(ContextRef maxContext) : impl(std::make_unique<Impl>()) {
  impl->maxContext = std::move(maxContext);
}

MOFContext::~MOFContext() = default;

const ExecutorDriverOptions *MOFContext::getExecutorDriverOptions() const {
  return impl->driverOptions
             ? static_cast<const ExecutorDriverOptions *>(impl->driverOptions)
             : impl->clOptions.get();
}

void MOFContext::setDriverOptions(const DriverOptions &options) {
  impl->driverOptions = &options;
}

ErrorOrSuccess MOFContext::setOptions(ArrayRef<std::string> opts) {
  if (opts.empty())
    return success();

  if (!impl->clOptions)
    return Error("CL Options parser is not initialized");

  if (impl->optionsParsed)
    return success();

  for (StringRef opt : opts) {
    const char *optChars[] = {impl->clOptions->getProgramName().data(),
                              opt.data()};
    if (!llvm::cl::ParseCommandLineOptions(std::size(optChars), optChars))
      return Error("unable to parse argument: " + opt);
  }

  impl->optionsParsed = true;
  return success();
}

ErrorOrSuccess
MOFContext::setConfigs(ArrayRef<std::unique_ptr<DriverConfig>> configs) {
  auto &mofConfig = impl->mofConfig;
  if (!mofConfig)
    mofConfig = std::make_unique<MOFConfig>();

  for (auto &driverConfig : configs) {
    if (auto kernelLibraryConfig =
            dyn_cast<KernelLibraryDriverConfig>(driverConfig.get())) {
      mofConfig->kernelLibraryPaths.push_back(
          kernelLibraryConfig->getPath().string());
    } else if (auto deviceConfig = dyn_cast<DeviceConfig>(driverConfig.get())) {
      mofConfig->defaultDeviceLabel = deviceConfig->getDeviceLabel();
      mofConfig->deviceID = deviceConfig->getDeviceID();
      mofConfig->deviceSpec = deviceConfig->deviceSpec;
    } else if (auto tileBasedFusionConfig =
                   dyn_cast<TileBasedFusionDriverConfig>(driverConfig.get())) {
      mofConfig->tileBasedFusion = tileBasedFusionConfig->getTileBasedFusion();
    }
  }
  return success();
}

void MOFContext::overrideLoweringOptions(
    MO::GCPipelineOptions &gcPipelineOptions) {
  if (impl->driverOptions)
    gcPipelineOptions.minimumCpuAlignment =
        impl->driverOptions->minimumCpuAlignment;
  if (impl->clOptions)
    static_cast<const MO::GraphCompilerOptions &>(*impl->clOptions)
        .overrideLoweringOptions(gcPipelineOptions);
  gcPipelineOptions.compiledFrameworkLabel =
      CompiledFrameworkLabel::asLabelString(
          CompiledFrameworkLabel::kModularModel);
  if (impl->mofConfig)
    impl->mofConfig->overrideLoweringOptions(gcPipelineOptions);

  if (auto configOr = M::Config::open(); !configOr.isError()) {
    if (configOr->getValueAsBool("max-debug.nan-check", false))
      gcPipelineOptions.nanCheck = true;
    StringRef strideStr = configOr->getValue("max-debug.nan-check-stride");
    if (!strideStr.empty()) {
      uint64_t stride = 0;
      if (!strideStr.getAsInteger(/*radix=*/10, stride) && stride > 0)
        gcPipelineOptions.nanCheckStride = static_cast<size_t>(stride);
    }

    if (configOr->getValueAsBool("max-debug.profile-scope-tracing", false))
      gcPipelineOptions.enableProfileScopeTracing = true;
    if (configOr->getValueAsBool(
            "max-debug.profile-scope-tracing-trace-unlabelled", false))
      gcPipelineOptions.profileScopeTracingTraceUnlabelled = true;

    if (configOr->getValueAsBool("max-debug.pre-jit", false))
      gcPipelineOptions.preJit = true;

    // mo-opt's flag doesn't reach the in-process Python compile path.
    StringRef timingOutDir =
        configOr->getValue("max-debug.mlir-timing-out-dir");
    if (!timingOutDir.empty())
      gcPipelineOptions.mlirTimingOutDir = timingOutDir.str();
  }
}

/// Prints the first error diagnostic (like the first Python exception) with a
/// Python stacktrace from the graph api location, else falls back to
/// FormatScopedDiagnosticHandler.
class GraphApiDiagnosticHandler : public mlir::ScopedDiagnosticHandler {
public:
  GraphApiDiagnosticHandler(MLIRContext *ctx)
      : ScopedDiagnosticHandler(ctx, [&](Diagnostic &diag) {
          diagnostics.push_back(std::move(diag));
        }) {}

  std::string formatMessage() const {
    std::string message;
    llvm::raw_string_ostream messageStream(message);
    emitDiagnosticToStream(messageStream);
    return message;
  }

private:
  std::vector<mlir::Diagnostic> diagnostics;

  void emitDiagnosticToStream(raw_ostream &os) const {
    auto errorDiagnostics =
        llvm::make_filter_range(diagnostics, [](const Diagnostic &diag) {
          return diag.getSeverity() == mlir::DiagnosticSeverity::Error;
        });
    if (errorDiagnostics.empty()) {
      // Still use fallback diagnostics when there are no errors.
      emitFallbackDiagnosticsToStream(os);
      return;
    }

    for (const Diagnostic &diag : errorDiagnostics) {
      // Python op creation attaches the user call stack to the location
      // (graph.py `_location()` -> `_graph.frame_loc()`).
      if (auto attr = RMO::PythonFrameAttr::fromLocation(diag.getLocation())) {
        os << "\nSource Traceback:\n"
           // Formatted via Python's traceback.format_list.
           << attr.stack_trace() << '\n';
      }
      FormatScopedDiagnosticHandler::emitDiagnosticSeverityToStream(os, diag);

      for (const Diagnostic &note : diag.getNotes()) {
        // Skip notes that would dump the op's IR, judged by the first
        // argument (typically the message).
        if (note.getArguments().empty() ||
            note.getArguments().front().getKind() !=
                mlir::DiagnosticArgument::DiagnosticArgumentKind::String ||
            !note.getArguments().front().getAsString().starts_with(
                "see current operation")) {
          FormatScopedDiagnosticHandler::emitDiagnosticToStream(os, note);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  void emitFallbackDiagnosticsToStream(raw_ostream &os) const {
    int pid = llvm::sys::Process::getProcessId();
    std::string fileName = "max-full-diagnostics-" + Twine(pid).str();

    auto diagFile = TempFile::create(fileName);
    if (diagFile.isError()) {
      os << "Error creating file for full diagnostics (" << fileName
         << "): " << diagFile.takeError() << "\n"
         << "All diagnostics will be emitted to the console.\n";
      for (auto &diag : diagnostics)
        FormatScopedDiagnosticHandler::emitDiagnosticToStream(os, diag);
      return;
    }

    // Minimal console output; everything goes to a file.
    diagFile->keep();
    std::error_code unused;
    llvm::raw_fd_ostream fullOutputStream(diagFile->getPath().c_str(), unused);

    std::string previousDiagnostic;
    for (auto &diag : diagnostics) {
      std::string currentDiagnostic;
      llvm::raw_string_ostream currentDiagnosticStream(currentDiagnostic);
      FormatScopedDiagnosticHandler::emitDiagnosticToStream(
          currentDiagnosticStream, fullOutputStream, diag);

      if (currentDiagnostic == previousDiagnostic)
        continue;
      previousDiagnostic = currentDiagnostic;
      os << currentDiagnostic << "\n";
    }

    os << "================================================\n";
    os << "Elided diagnostics have been emitted to "
       << diagFile->getPath().c_str() << "\n";
    os << "================================================\n";
  }
};

/// Sinks the `tile_based_fusion` compile option into every
/// `mo.device_info_mapping` entry, CPU included, so SIMD can later become a
/// subset of TileTensor.
static void enableTileBasedFusion(ModuleOp moduleOp) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = moduleOp.getContext();
  auto dict =
      moduleOp->getAttrOfType<DictionaryAttr>(MO::DeviceInfoMapping::kAttrName);
  if (!dict)
    return;

  SmallVector<NamedAttribute> entries;
  entries.reserve(dict.size());
  bool changed = false;
  for (NamedAttribute entry : dict) {
    auto info = dyn_cast<DeviceInfoAttr>(entry.getValue());
    if (info && !info.getTileBasedFusion()) {
      entries.emplace_back(entry.getName(),
                           DeviceInfoAttr::get(ctx, info.getLabel(),
                                               info.getApi(), info.getArch(),
                                               info.getModel(),
                                               /*tile_based_fusion=*/true));
      changed = true;
    } else {
      entries.push_back(entry);
    }
  }

  if (changed)
    moduleOp->setAttr(MO::DeviceInfoMapping::kAttrName,
                      DictionaryAttr::get(ctx, entries));
}

/// Lowers a module op to MGP then exports to MEF.
static ErrorOr<BufferRef> convertMOToMEF(ModuleOp moduleOp,
                                         const MO::GCPipelineOptions &options,
                                         bool enableMEFMetadata) {
  bool const dumpStages = !getMaxIRDumpDir().empty();
  GraphApiDiagnosticHandler diagnostics(moduleOp.getContext());
  if (failed(MO::runGCPipeline(moduleOp, options, dumpStages)))
    return Error(Twine("Graph compilation failed:\n") +
                 diagnostics.formatMessage());

  // Nothing to export without the JIT; erroring also keeps the half-lowered
  // result out of the MEF cache. emit-mojo already wrote the Mojo.
  if (options.preJit)
    return Error("compilation stopped after emitting Mojo, as requested by "
                 "pre-jit; the emitted Mojo is in ir-output-dir");

  auto bufOr = MO::convertMGPToMEF(moduleOp, enableMEFMetadata);
  if (bufOr)
    return bufOr.takeError();
  return bufOr.takeValue();
}

M::ErrorOr<M::BufferRef> MOFContext::compileToBinary(void *source,
                                                     FileFormat format) {
  // Cheap: weights are dense_resource attributes owned by the MLIRContext.
  OwningOpRef<ModuleOp> moduleOp =
      ModuleOp::getFromOpaquePointer(source).clone();

  auto &maxContext = impl->maxContext;
  MLIRContext *mlirCtx = moduleOp->getContext();
  registerContext(*mlirCtx, maxContext);

  auto telemetryContext = maxContext->get<GML::MaxEngineTelemetryContext>();

  // Must precede the telemetry diagnostic handler.
  llvm::SourceMgr sourceMgr;
  mlir::SourceMgrDiagnosticHandler diagHandler(sourceMgr, mlirCtx);

  GML::MaxEngineTelemetryScope<GML::MaxEngineErrorCode::GraphLoweringError>
      loweringDiagScope(mlirCtx, telemetryContext);

  // Gather all the options from all the sources.
  MO::GCPipelineOptions gcPipelineOptions;
  overrideLoweringOptions(gcPipelineOptions);

  // Set iff Python `Analysis::seed_kernel_decls` already seeded kernel decls,
  // so mogg-import-packages can be skipped.
  if ((*moduleOp)->hasAttr(MOGG::kOpaqueTypeMappingAttrName))
    gcPipelineOptions.kernelDeclsPrePopulated = true;

  // Before the cache key, so tile and non-tile compiles never collide.
  if (impl->mofConfig && impl->mofConfig->tileBasedFusion)
    enableTileBasedFusion(*moduleOp);

  bool enableMEFMetadata = impl->getEnableMEFMetadata();

  auto baseCacheDirOr = M::getMaxCacheDir();

  if (!isModelIRCacheEnabled() || !baseCacheDirOr)
    return convertMOToMEF(*moduleOp, gcPipelineOptions, enableMEFMetadata);

  const std::filesystem::path &baseCacheDir = *baseCacheDirOr;
  auto mefBackendOr = Cache::getLocalDefaultBackendChain(
      (baseCacheDir / "mof" / "mef").string(),
      std::string(M::getModularVersionString()));

  if (mefBackendOr.isError()) {
    return convertMOToMEF(*moduleOp, gcPipelineOptions, enableMEFMetadata);
  }

  auto keyHashOr = computeMEFCacheKey(*moduleOp, gcPipelineOptions, maxContext);
  if (keyHashOr.isError())
    return keyHashOr.takeError();
  std::string keyHash = keyHashOr.takeValue();

  auto mefCache = RCRef<Cache::TransformCache>::create(*mefBackendOr);
  auto maybeMefOr = mefCache->findKeyedSync(keyHash);
  if (maybeMefOr.isError())
    return maybeMefOr.takeError();
  std::optional<BufferRef> maybeMef = maybeMefOr.takeValue();
  if (maybeMef) {
    auto onHitLambda = Cache::CacheTelemetryContext::getTelemetryOnHitLambda(
        "mof::M_compileToBinaryFromSource");
    onHitLambda(*moduleOp);

    return std::move(*maybeMef);
  }

  auto onMissLambda = Cache::CacheTelemetryContext::getTelemetryOnMissLambda(
      "mof::M_compileToBinaryFromSource",
      "mof.compiletobinaryfromsource.cache.miss.time",
      {{"pipeline", "mof::M_compileToBinaryFromSource"}});
  onMissLambda(*moduleOp);

  auto outBufOr =
      convertMOToMEF(*moduleOp, gcPipelineOptions, enableMEFMetadata);
  if (outBufOr.isError())
    return outBufOr.takeError();
  BufferRef outputBuffer = outBufOr.takeValue();

  // Insertion failure is ignored.
  (void)mefCache->insertKeyedSync(keyHash, outputBuffer.copy());

  return outputBuffer;
}

ErrorOr<M::BufferRef> MOFContext::compileToBinary(M::BufferRef file,
                                                  FileFormat format) {
  CompileToBinaryCtx compileCtx(impl->maxContext.copy());
  auto telemetryContext =
      impl->maxContext->get<GML::MaxEngineTelemetryContext>();
  // Gather all the options from all the sources.
  MO::GCPipelineOptions gcPipelineOptions;
  overrideLoweringOptions(gcPipelineOptions);

  MOGG::GraphCompilerCacheKey graphCompilerOptions{&compileCtx.mlirCtx};

  auto loweringTransform =
      [&, file = file.copy()]() mutable -> ErrorOr<BufferRef> {
    switch (format) {
    case FileFormat::kMODialect:
      [[fallthrough]];
    case FileFormat::kMGPDialect:
      compileCtx.module = parseMODialect(file.copy(), &compileCtx.mlirCtx);
      break;

    default: {
      auto identityOr = getFileContentIdentity(file.copy(), format);
      if (identityOr.isError())
        return identityOr.takeError();
      return Error("cannot compile input with format " + *identityOr);
    }
    }

    GML::MaxEngineTelemetryScope<GML::MaxEngineErrorCode::GraphLoweringError>
        loweringDiagScope(&compileCtx.mlirCtx, telemetryContext);

    switch (format) {
    case FileFormat::kMODialect: {
      GraphApiDiagnosticHandler diagnostics(&compileCtx.mlirCtx);
      if (failed(runGcPipeline(compileCtx.module.get(), gcPipelineOptions)))
        return Error(Twine("Graph compilation failed") +
                     diagnostics.formatMessage());
      format = FileFormat::kMGPDialect;
      break;
    }
    case FileFormat::kMGPDialect: {
      break;
    }
    default:
      auto identityOr = getFileContentIdentity(file.copy(), format);
      if (identityOr.isError())
        return identityOr.takeError();
      auto identity = std::move(*identityOr);
      return Error("cannot lower to MEF data of format " + identity);
    }

    return MO::convertMGPToMEF(compileCtx.module.get(),
                               impl->getEnableMEFMetadata());
  };

  // Custom kernels would have to be inspected for the key; don't cache.
  if (!gcPipelineOptions.kernelLibraryPaths.empty() ||
      !isModelIRCacheEnabled()) {
    return loweringTransform();
  }

  WriteableBufferRef keyBuffer =
      makeCacheKey(std::move(file), gcPipelineOptions, graphCompilerOptions);

  // Mojo defines (LOGGING_LEVEL, ASSERT_LEVEL, etc.) must invalidate the cache.
  if (auto *compCtx = impl->maxContext->get<KGEN::CompilationContext>())
    compCtx->print(*keyBuffer);

  return M::cacheMEFTransform("mof", loweringTransform, std::move(keyBuffer));
}

void M::MO::loadDialects(mlir::DialectRegistry &registry) {
  registry.insert<MO::MODialect, MOSH::MOSHDialect, MOGG::MOGGDialect,
                  MGP::MGPDialect, GRT::GRTDialect, RMO::RMODialect,
                  MAP::MAPDialect>();
  M::registerAllKGENDialects(registry);
  M::registerKGENToLLVMTranslation(registry);
}

void M::MO::registerShapeInferencePipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<>(
      "mo-shape-inference", "Run the end-to-end shape inference pipeline.",
      buildShapeInferencePipeline);
}

void M::MO::buildJitPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm) {
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createLowerCompiledRoutines());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createInlineMGPCallsPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createFixupOverhangsPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyChainsPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createOutlineModelsToCallables());
}

namespace {
static void gcPipelineImpl(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                           const GCPipelineOptions &opts, bool skipJit,
                           bool dumpIntermediates = false);
} // namespace

void M::MO::registerGCPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<GCPipelineOptions>(
      "gc-pipeline", "Full graph-compiler pipeline (MO → MGP → JIT).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const GCPipelineOptions &opts) {
        // Enable dumps here so buildGCPipeline stays dump-free for cache keys.
        gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/false,
                       /*dumpIntermediates=*/!getMaxIRDumpDir().empty());
      });
}

void M::MO::registerGCPipelineThroughEmitMojo() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<GCPipelineOptions>(
      "gc-pipeline-pre-jit",
      "Graph compiler through emit-mojo (MO → MGP → emit-mojo; no JIT).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const GCPipelineOptions &opts) {
        gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/true,
                       /*dumpIntermediates=*/!getMaxIRDumpDir().empty());
      });
}

void M::MO::registerMoPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<MoPipelineOptions>(
      "mo-pipeline",
      "Passes from graph input up to (but not including) mo-to-mogg.",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const MoPipelineOptions &opts) {
        buildMoPipeline(pm, opts);
      });
}

void M::MO::registerMapPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<MapPipelineOptions>(
      "map-pipeline",
      "Passes between mo-to-map and mogg-to-mgp (both excluded).",

        buildMapPipeline(pm, opts);

}

void M::MO::registerMoggPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<MoggPipelineOptions>(

      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const MoggPipelineOptions &opts) {
        buildMoggPipeline(pm, opts);

}

void M::MO::registerMgpPipeline() {

      "mgp-pipeline", "Passes between mogg-to-mgp and jit (both excluded).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const MgpPipelineOptions &opts) {
        buildMgpPipeline(pm, opts);

}

void M::MO::registerJitPipeline() {
