ErrorOr<TypedAttr> NotOp::tryStaticize(ArrayRef<TypedAttr> inputs,
                                       ParamExprBuilder &b) {
  return tryStaticizeElemWiseOp<NotOp>(getType(), inputs, b, [&](auto adaptor) {
    auto attr = KGEN::ParamOperatorAttr::getNot(adaptor.getInput());
    return b.wrapNonTrivialAttrWithDecl(attr, "not");
  });
}

ErrorOr<TypedAttr> RangeOp::tryStaticize(ArrayRef<TypedAttr> inputs,
                                         ParamExprBuilder &b) {
  StaticizeAdaptor<RangeOp> adaptor(inputs);

  std::optional<int64_t> startOr = tryGetConstantInt(adaptor.getStart());
  std::optional<int64_t> limitOr = tryGetConstantInt(adaptor.getLimit());
  std::optional<int64_t> stepOr = tryGetConstantInt(adaptor.getStep());
  if (!startOr.has_value() || !limitOr.has_value() || !stepOr.has_value())
    return TypedAttr{};
  int64_t start = startOr.value();
  int64_t limit = limitOr.value();
  int64_t step = stepOr.value();

  ErrorOr<int64_t> numOutElemsOr = getRangeNumElements(start, limit, step);
  if (numOutElemsOr.isError())
    return numOutElemsOr.takeError();
  int64_t numOutElems = numOutElemsOr.get();

  SmallVector<TypedAttr> outElems;
  int64_t elem = start;
  for (int64_t i = 0; i < numOutElems; ++i) {
    outElems.push_back(b.createVar(elem).getAttr());
    elem += step;
  }
  auto resAttr = b.getShapeAttr(outElems);
  return resAttr;
}

ErrorOr<TypedAttr> RebindOp::tryStaticize(ArrayRef<TypedAttr> inputs,
                                          ParamExprBuilder &b) {
  return StaticizeAdaptor<RebindOp>(inputs).getInput();
}

ErrorOr<TypedAttr> TransferOp::tryStaticize(ArrayRef<TypedAttr> inputs,
                                            ParamExprBuilder &b) {
  return StaticizeAdaptor<TransferOp>(inputs).getInput();
}

ErrorOr<TypedAttr> ReduceMulOp::tryStaticize(ArrayRef<TypedAttr> inputs,
                                             ParamExprBuilder &b) {
  StaticizeAdaptor<ReduceMulOp> adaptor(inputs);

  // We only staticize over 1D tensors for now, so axis must be 0.
  if (getAxisAttr().getInt() != 0)
    return TypedAttr{};

  auto inputElems = dyn_cast<ShapeAttr>(adaptor.getInput());
  if (!inputElems)
    return TypedAttr{};

  TypedAttr productAttr =
      b.createKgenExpr(KGEN::POC::MulNoWrap, inputElems.getValues());
  return b.getShapeAttr({productAttr});
}

ErrorOr<TypedAttr> ReshapeOp::tryStaticize(ArrayRef<TypedAttr> inputs,
                                           ParamExprBuilder &b) {
  StaticizeAdaptor<ReshapeOp> adaptor(inputs);
  return tryStaticizeReshapeLikeOp(getInput().getType(), getType(),
                                   adaptor.getInput(), b);
}

ErrorOr<TypedAttr> SelectOp::tryStaticize(ArrayRef<TypedAttr> inputs,
                                          ParamExprBuilder &b) {
  return tryStaticizeElemWiseOp<SelectOp>(
      getType(), inputs, b, [&](auto adaptor) {
        Var condVar = b.createVar(adaptor.getCond());
        Var thenVar = b.createVar(adaptor.getX());
        Var elseVar = b.createVar(adaptor.getY());
        Var res = b.createCond(condVar, thenVar, elseVar);
        return res.getAttr();
      });
}

ErrorOr<TypedAttr> SliceOp::tryStaticize(ArrayRef<TypedAttr> inputs,
                                         ParamExprBuilder &b) {
  StaticizeAdaptor<SliceOp> adaptor(inputs);

  auto inputElems = dyn_cast<ShapeAttr>(adaptor.getInput());
  if (!inputElems)
    return TypedAttr{};

  std::optional<SmallVector<int64_t>> startOr =
      tryGetConstantIntVector(adaptor.getStart());
  std::optional<SmallVector<int64_t>> stopOr =
      tryGetConstantIntVector(adaptor.getStop());
  std::optional<SmallVector<int64_t>> stepOr =
      tryGetConstantIntVector(adaptor.getStep());
  if (!(startOr.has_value() && startOr->size() == 1 && stopOr.has_value() &&
        stopOr->size() == 1 && stepOr.has_value() && stepOr->size() == 1))
    return TypedAttr{};

  // Only support step = 1 for now.
  if (stepOr->front() != 1)
    return TypedAttr{};

  int64_t inputSize = inputElems.getSize();
  int64_t normalizedStart = clampAxis(startOr->front(), inputSize);
  int64_t normalizedStop = clampAxis(stopOr->front(), inputSize);
  if (normalizedStop < normalizedStart) {
    std::stringstream ss;
    ss << "[slice] clamped stop (" << normalizedStop
       << ") cannot be smaller than clamped start (" << normalizedStart << ")";
    return Error(ss.str());
  }

  ArrayRef<TypedAttr> slicedInputElems = inputElems.getValues().slice(
      normalizedStart, normalizedStop - normalizedStart);
  auto resultAttr = b.getShapeAttr(slicedInputElems);
  return resultAttr;
}

ErrorOr<TypedAttr> SqueezeShapeOp::tryStaticize(ArrayRef<TypedAttr> inputs,
                                                ParamExprBuilder &b) {
  StaticizeAdaptor<SqueezeShapeOp> adaptor(inputs);

  auto inputShapeAttr = dyn_cast<ShapeAttr>(adaptor.getInputShape());
  auto squeezeAxesOr = tryGetConstantIntVector(adaptor.getRemoveIndices());
  if (!inputShapeAttr || !squeezeAxesOr.has_value())
    return TypedAttr{};

  SmallVector<int64_t> &squeezeAxes = squeezeAxesOr.value();
  DenseSet<int64_t> normalizedSqueezeAxisSet;
  int64_t inputShapeLen = inputShapeAttr.getValues().size();
  for (auto &squeezeAxis : squeezeAxes) {
    if (squeezeAxis < -inputShapeLen || squeezeAxis >= inputShapeLen)
      return Error("Squeeze axis not in [-in_rank, in_rank).");

    if (squeezeAxis < 0)
      squeezeAxis += inputShapeLen;
    normalizedSqueezeAxisSet.insert(squeezeAxis);
  }

  SmallVector<TypedAttr> finalShape;
  for (auto [axis, dimAttr] : llvm::enumerate(inputShapeAttr.getValues())) {
    if (normalizedSqueezeAxisSet.contains(axis)) {
      b.createAssert(b.createVar(dimAttr) == 1,
                     "Attempting to unsqueeze a dimension that is not 1.");
      continue;
    }
    finalShape.push_back(dimAttr);
  }
  auto squeezedShapeAttr = b.getShapeAttr(finalShape);

  return squeezedShapeAttr;
}

ErrorOr<TypedAttr> Static::ReshapeOp::tryStaticize(ArrayRef<TypedAttr> inputs,
                                                   ParamExprBuilder &b) {
  StaticizeAdaptor<Static::ReshapeOp> adaptor(inputs);
  return tryStaticizeReshapeLikeOp(getInput().getType(), getType(),
                                   adaptor.getInput(), b);
}

ErrorOr<TypedAttr> SubOp::tryStaticize(ArrayRef<TypedAttr> inputs,
                                       ParamExprBuilder &b) {
  return tryStaticizeElemWiseOp<SubOp>(getType(), inputs, b, [&](auto adaptor) {
    Var lhs = b.createVar(adaptor.getInputX());
    Var rhs = b.createVar(adaptor.getInputY());
    Var res = lhs - rhs;
    return res.getAttr();
  });
}

ErrorOr<TypedAttr> UnsqueezeShapeOp::tryStaticize(ArrayRef<TypedAttr> inputs,
                                                  ParamExprBuilder &b) {
  StaticizeAdaptor<UnsqueezeShapeOp> adaptor(inputs);

  auto inputShapeAttr = dyn_cast<ShapeAttr>(adaptor.getInputShape());
  auto unsqueezeAxesOr = tryGetConstantIntVector(adaptor.getPaddingIndices());
  if (!inputShapeAttr || !unsqueezeAxesOr.has_value())
    return TypedAttr{};

  const SmallVector<int64_t> &unsqueezeAxes = unsqueezeAxesOr.value();
  DenseSet<int64_t> unsqueezeAxesSet;
  int64_t outputShapeLen =
      inputShapeAttr.getValues().size() + unsqueezeAxes.size();
  for (auto unsqueezeAxis : unsqueezeAxes) {
    if (unsqueezeAxis < -outputShapeLen || unsqueezeAxis >= outputShapeLen)
      return Error("Unsqueeze axis not in [-out_rank, out_rank).");

    if (unsqueezeAxis < 0)
      unsqueezeAxis += outputShapeLen;
    unsqueezeAxesSet.insert(unsqueezeAxis);
  }

  SmallVector<TypedAttr> unsqueezedDims;
  TypedAttr intOneAttr = b.createVar(1).getAttr();
  for (int64_t idx = 0, nextDimAttrIdx = 0; idx < outputShapeLen; ++idx) {
    if (unsqueezeAxesSet.contains(idx))
      unsqueezedDims.push_back(intOneAttr);
    else
      unsqueezedDims.push_back(inputShapeAttr[nextDimAttrIdx++]);
  }
  auto unsqueezedShapeAttr =
      ShapeAttr::get(unsqueezedDims, inputShapeAttr.getType());

  return unsqueezedShapeAttr;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Fallback guard creation (to ensure all MO ops have one or error)
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

// C++ workaround so `false` depends on `T`
template <class>
[[maybe_unused]] constexpr bool FALSE = false;

// Once every MO op is instantiated from the generated headers, an op without a
// fallback or NEEDS_NO_FALLBACK entry becomes a compile-time error.
template <typename T>
struct Fallback {
  static_assert(
      FALSE<T>,
      "All MO operations must have registered fallback shape "
      "functions but no function found for this MO op. (see template error)");
};

#define HAS_FALLBACK(MOOp)                                                     \
  template <>                                                                  \
  struct Fallback<MOOp> {                                                      \
    ErrorOrSuccess build(GraphOp &graph, OpBuilder &builder, MOOp op);         \
  };

#define NEEDS_NO_FALLBACK(MOOp)                                                \
  template <>                                                                  \
  struct Fallback<MOOp> {};

HAS_FALLBACK(MO::ArgMinOp)

HAS_FALLBACK(MO::AvgPoolCeilOp)

HAS_FALLBACK(MO::BottomKOp)

HAS_FALLBACK(MO::Composite::RMSNormResidualAddOp)

HAS_FALLBACK(MO::ResizeLinearOp)
HAS_FALLBACK(MO::ResizeNearestOp)
HAS_FALLBACK(MO::ScatterOp)
HAS_FALLBACK(MO::ScatterAddOp)
HAS_FALLBACK(MO::ScatterMaxOp)
HAS_FALLBACK(MO::ScatterMinOp)
HAS_FALLBACK(MO::ScatterMulOp)
HAS_FALLBACK(MO::ScatterNdOp)

template <>
struct Fallback<MO::CustomOp> {
  ErrorOrSuccess build(GraphOp &graph, OpBuilder &builder, MO::CustomOp op,
                       MOGG::ShapeFunctionDeclOp shapeDecl,
                       StringSet<> &inputParamsNeeded);
};

NEEDS_NO_FALLBACK(MO::MatmulOp)
NEEDS_NO_FALLBACK(MO::Static::BroadcastToOp)

// Creates the fallback for this op if it has parameters still needing decls.
#define CALL_FALLBACK(MOOp)                                                    \
  if (auto asOp = dyn_cast<MOOp>(op.getOperation())) {                         \
    auto result = Fallback<MOOp>{}.build(graph, builder, asOp);                \
    if (result.isError()) {                                                    \
      asOp.emitError() << "Failed to fallback shape function with error: "     \
                       << result.takeError();                                  \
      return mlir::WalkResult::interrupt();                                    \
    } else {                                                                   \
      op.setOutputParamDecls({});                                              \
    }                                                                          \
    return mlir::WalkResult::advance();                                        \
  }

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Fallback creation pass.
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

struct AddFallbackShapeFunctions
    : public impl::AddFallbackShapeFunctionsBase<AddFallbackShapeFunctions> {
  using Base::Base;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    MO::GraphOp graph = getOperation();
    MLIRContext *ctx = graph.getContext();
    OpBuilder builder{ctx};
    MOGG::MojoRegistry registry(graph->getParentOfType<mlir::ModuleOp>());

    WalkResult result = graph.walk([&](ParamDeclarationInterface op) {
      // Shape function was already materialized or never needed.
      if (op.getOutputParamDecls().empty())
        return mlir::WalkResult::advance();

      builder.setInsertionPoint(op);
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ArgMaxOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ArgMinOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::AvgPoolOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::AvgPoolCeilOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::BatchMatmulOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::BottomKOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::BroadcastToOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::BroadcastShapeOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ConcatOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ConvOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ConvTransposeOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::GatherOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::GatherNdOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ReduceGroupNormOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::LayerNormOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ReduceMinAndMaxOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ReduceRMSNormOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::Composite::ReduceRMSNormRoPEOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::Composite::ReduceRMSNormFusedResidualAddOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::Composite::RMSNormResidualAddOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::MaxPoolOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::MaxPoolCeilOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::NonMaximumSuppressionOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::PadConstantOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::PadReflectOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::PadRepeatOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::RandomNormalOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::RandomUniformOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::RangeOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ReduceMulOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ReshapeOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::RoiAlignOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ResizeBicubicOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ResizeLinearOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ResizeNearestOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ScatterOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ScatterAddOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ScatterMaxOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ScatterMinOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ScatterMulOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ScatterNdOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ScatterNdAddOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ScatterNdMaxOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ScatterNdMinOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ScatterNdMulOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::SliceOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::SplitOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::SqueezeShapeOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::TopKOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::TransposeOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::UnsqueezeShapeOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::ArgNonzeroOp)
      CALL_FALLBACK(MO::TileOp)

      if (auto asOp = dyn_cast<MO::CustomOp>(op.getOperation())) {
        if (!registry.containsKernel(asOp.getSymbol())) {
          asOp.emitError() << "Could not find registered mojo kernel named '"
                           << asOp.getSymbol() << "'";
          return mlir::WalkResult::interrupt();
        }

        // We only get here if the op declares its own output dims, and a shape
        // function is the only thing that can compute them.
        if (!registry.containsShapeFunction(asOp.getSymbol())) {
          asOp.emitError()
              << "custom op '" << asOp.getSymbol()
              << "' with data-dependent output dimensions requires a "
                 "registered shape function; add "
                 "'@extensibility.register_shape_function(\""
              << asOp.getSymbol() << "\")' to the kernel";
          return mlir::WalkResult::interrupt();
        }

        // Forward custom-op attributes matching the shape fn's own params,
        // which may differ from execute's (e.g. no `target`/`_trace_name`).
        StringSet<> inputParams;
        MOGG::ShapeFunctionDeclOp shapeDecl =
            registry.lookupShapeFunction(asOp.getSymbol());
        for (mlir::Attribute attr : shapeDecl.getFunction().getParams())
          inputParams.insert(mlir::cast<KGEN::ParamDeclAttr>(attr).getName());

        auto result = Fallback<MO::CustomOp>{}.build(graph, builder, asOp,
                                                     shapeDecl, inputParams);
        if (result.isError()) {
          asOp.emitError() << "Failed to fallback shape function with error: "
                           << result.takeError();
          return mlir::WalkResult::interrupt();

        } else {
          op.setOutputParamDecls({});
        }
      }

      return mlir::WalkResult::advance();
    });

    if (result.wasInterrupted())
      return signalPassFailure();
  }
};

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Fallback helpers
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

// Fallbacks produce a parameter for every output dim, even static ones, so the
// lowering needn't know how many there are or which dims they refer to.
KGEN::ParamDeclArrayAttr
getNewParameterMapping(GraphOp &graph, TensorType outTy,
                       ArrayRef<ParamDeclAttr> outputParamDecls) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = graph.getContext();
  if (auto rankedParamDeclRef =
          dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr>(outTy.getShape())) {
    auto paramDecl = KGEN::ParamDeclAttr::get(rankedParamDeclRef);
    return KGEN::ParamDeclArrayAttr::get(ctx, {paramDecl});
  }

  llvm::SmallSetVector<ParamDeclAttr, 10> outputParamDeclSet(
      outputParamDecls.begin(), outputParamDecls.end());

  SmallVector<KGEN::ParamDeclAttr> params;

  // The op's declared parameters move to the shape func invocation. Other dims
  // (static, or defined elsewhere) get a placeholder "F"allback param to keep
  // the shape func contract.
  auto getShapeFuncSymbol = [&](TypedAttr dim) -> KGEN::ParamDeclAttr {
    auto asSymbolic = dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr>(dim);

    if (!asSymbolic)
      return graph.getNewDimParam("F");

    auto asParamDeclAttr = KGEN::ParamDeclAttr::get(asSymbolic);
    if (!outputParamDeclSet.contains(asParamDeclAttr))
      return graph.getNewDimParam("F");

    return asParamDeclAttr;
  };

  // Parameters are positional, one per dim.
  for (auto dim : outTy.getShape().getValues()) {
    params.push_back(getShapeFuncSymbol(dim));
  }
  return KGEN::ParamDeclArrayAttr::get(graph.getContext(), params);
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Helpers for fallback implementations
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static ErrorOrSuccess buildForReductionOp(GraphOp &graph, OpBuilder &builder,
                                          MO::Reduction op) {
  KGEN::ParamDeclArrayAttr shapeParams = getNewParameterMapping(
      graph, op.getResult().getType(), op.getOutputParamDecls());

  MO::InvokeShapeFuncOp::create(
      builder, op.getLoc(), op->getOperands(), op->getName().getStringRef(),
      shapeParams,
      /*kgenAttrs*/ DictionaryAttr{},
      /*Data dependent input indices*/ builder.getI32ArrayAttr({1}));

  return success();
}

static ErrorOrSuccess buildForScatterLikeOp(GraphOp &graph, OpBuilder &builder,
                                            MO::ScatterLike op) {
  KGEN::ParamDeclArrayAttr shapeParams = getNewParameterMapping(
      graph, op.getResult().getType(), op.getOutputParamDecls());

  MO::InvokeShapeFuncOp::create(
      builder, op.getLoc(), op->getOperands(),
      op.getOperation()->getName().getStringRef(), shapeParams,
      /*kgenAttrs*/ DictionaryAttr{},
      /*Data dependent input indices*/ builder.getI32ArrayAttr({3}));

  return success();
}

void buildForOpResult(GraphOp &graph, OpBuilder &builder, TensorValue res,
                      StringRef shapeFuncName, ValueRange operands,
                      ArrayRef<ParamDeclAttr> outputParamDecls,
                      ArrayRef<std::pair<StringRef, Attribute>> kgenParams,
                      ArrayRef<int32_t> dataDepInputIdxs) {
  KGEN::ParamDeclArrayAttr shapeParams =
      getNewParameterMapping(graph, res.getType(), outputParamDecls);

  // TODO we can't deduce parameter from types of variadic inputs
  DictionaryAttr kgenParamAttrs;
  if (!kgenParams.empty()) {
    SmallVector<mlir::NamedAttribute> namedAttrs;
    for (auto [name, attr] : kgenParams)
      namedAttrs.push_back(builder.getNamedAttr(name, attr));
    kgenParamAttrs = builder.getDictionaryAttr(namedAttrs);
  }

  Location loc = res.getLoc();

  // Shape functions execute on the host and read data-dependent operands
  // through their raw storage pointers. An off-host operand would hand the
  // host a device address, so copy it to the host first. The transfer is a
  // real runtime D2H: data-dependent output shapes need current input data
  // on every execution.
  DeviceRefAttr hostDevice = getHostDevice(builder.getContext());
  SmallVector<Value> invokeOperands(operands.begin(), operands.end());
  Value chain;
  for (int32_t inputIdx : dataDepInputIdxs) {
    if (static_cast<size_t>(inputIdx) >= invokeOperands.size())
      continue;
    auto tensorTy =
        dyn_cast<MO::TensorType>(invokeOperands[inputIdx].getType());
    if (!tensorTy)
      continue;
    DeviceRefAttr operandDevice = tensorTy.getDeviceRef();
    if (!operandDevice || operandDevice == hostDevice)
      continue;
    if (!chain)
      chain = MO::ChainCreateOp::create(builder, loc, ValueRange{}).getResult();
    auto transfer = MO::TransferOp::create(
        builder, loc, cast<TensorValue>(invokeOperands[inputIdx]), hostDevice,
        cast<ChainValue>(chain),
        /*alwaysElideSameDeviceCopy=*/false);
    invokeOperands[inputIdx] = transfer.getResult();
    chain = transfer.getOutChain();
  }

  MO::InvokeShapeFuncOp::create(builder, loc, invokeOperands, shapeFuncName,
                                shapeParams, kgenParamAttrs,
                                builder.getI32ArrayAttr(dataDepInputIdxs));
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Actual fallback implementations
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

template <typename OpT>
static ErrorOrSuccess buildForScatterNdLikeOp(GraphOp &graph,
                                              OpBuilder &builder, OpT op) {

  KGEN::ParamDeclArrayAttr shapeParams = getNewParameterMapping(
      graph, op.getResult().getType(), op.getOutputParamDecls());
  buildForOpResult(graph, builder, op, OpT::getOperationName(),
                   op.getOperands(), shapeParams,
                   /*kgenParams=*/{},
                   /*dataDepInputIdxs=*/op.getDataDependentInputIndices());

  return success();
}

ErrorOrSuccess Fallback<MO::ConcatOp>::build(GraphOp &graph, OpBuilder &builder,
                                             MO::ConcatOp op) {
  // TODO we can't deduce parameter from types of variadic inputs
  auto inputTensorTy = cast<TensorType>(op.getInputs().front().getType());
  auto inputDTypeAttr = mlir::TypeAttr::get(inputTensorTy.getElementType());
  auto inputRankAttr = builder.getIndexAttr(inputTensorTy.getRank());

  buildForOpResult(graph, builder, op, MO::ConcatOp::getOperationName(),
                   op.getOperands(), op.getOutputParamDecls(),
                   /*kgenParams=*/
                   {{"input_type", inputDTypeAttr},
                    {"input_rank", inputRankAttr},
                    {"axis", op.getAxisAttr()}},
                   op.getDataDependentInputIndices());
  return success();
}

// A shape-function argument bound to a bare `Tensor` can't read element
// values (see `_MoggShapeTensorArg`), so only other operands need the host
// copy. Operands map to arguments as ConformCallOperands maps the shape call.
static ErrorOr<SmallVector<int32_t>> getCustomOpDataDepInputIdxs(
    MO::CustomOp op, MOGG::ShapeFunctionDeclOp shapeDecl, ValueRange operands) {
  MOGG::KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor shapeFn(shapeDecl);
  auto mapping = MOGG::mapToKernelImplementation(
      operands, /*results=*/{}, shapeFn, op.getSymbol(),
      /*hasSameVariadicOperandSize=*/false,
      /*hasExtraOutputShapeArgument=*/false, /*resultLeavesByValue=*/true);
  if (mapping.isError())
    return mapping.takeError();

  SmallVector<int32_t> dataDepInputIdxs;
  for (const auto &[idx, arg] : mapping->operandMapping) {
    std::optional<MOGG::TensorArgContract> contract = arg.getTraitContract();
    if (!contract || contract->bound != MOGG::TensorArgBound::tensor)
      dataDepInputIdxs.push_back(static_cast<int32_t>(idx));
  }
  return dataDepInputIdxs;
}

ErrorOrSuccess Fallback<MO::CustomOp>::build(
    GraphOp &graph, OpBuilder &builder, MO::CustomOp op,
    MOGG::ShapeFunctionDeclOp shapeDecl, StringSet<> &inputParamsNeeded) {
  SmallVector<Value> operands{op.getOperands().begin(), op.getOperands().end()};

  // Buffer operands are loaded, threading the chain.
  Value currentChain = nullptr;
  MO::MutableLoadOp firstLoadOp = nullptr;
  if (!operands.empty() && isa<MO::ChainType>(operands.back().getType())) {
    currentChain = operands.back();
    operands.pop_back();
  }

  for (Value &operand : operands) {
    auto bufferTy = dyn_cast<MO::BufferType>(operand.getType());
    if (!bufferTy)
      continue;

    auto bufferLoadOp = MO::MutableLoadOp::create(
        builder, op.getLoc(), bufferTy.toTensorType(), currentChain.getType(),
        operand, currentChain);
    if (!firstLoadOp)
      firstLoadOp = bufferLoadOp;
    operand = bufferLoadOp.getOutTensor();
    currentChain = bufferLoadOp.getOutChain();
  }

  ErrorOr<SmallVector<int32_t>> dataDepInputIdxs =
      getCustomOpDataDepInputIdxs(op, shapeDecl, operands);
  if (dataDepInputIdxs.isError())
    return dataDepInputIdxs.takeError();

  for (auto [idx, res] : llvm::enumerate(op.getResults())) {
    SmallVector<std::pair<StringRef, Attribute>> kgenParams;
    kgenParams.emplace_back("output_idx", builder.getIndexAttr(idx));

    if (!isa<MO::TensorType>(res.getType()))
      continue;

    for (const NamedAttribute &namedAttr : op.getParameters())
      if (inputParamsNeeded.contains(namedAttr.getName()))
        kgenParams.emplace_back(namedAttr.getName(), namedAttr.getValue());

    buildForOpResult(graph, builder, cast<TensorValue>(res), op.getSymbol(),
                     operands, op.getOutputParamDecls(),
                     /*kgenParams=*/kgenParams,
                     /*dataDepInputIdxs=*/*dataDepInputIdxs);
  }

  // The custom op consumes the chain after all buffer loads.
  if (currentChain)
    op->getOperands().back().replaceAllUsesExcept(currentChain, firstLoadOp);

  return success();
}

ErrorOrSuccess Fallback<MO::GatherOp>::build(GraphOp &graph, OpBuilder &builder,
                                             MO::GatherOp op) {
  // `axis` is a compile-time `index` attribute threaded to the shape function.
  buildForOpResult(graph, builder, op, MO::GatherOp::getOperationName(),
                   op.getOperands(), op.getOutputParamDecls(),
                   /*kgenParams=*/{{"axis", op.getAxisAttr()}},
                   /*dataDepInputIdxs=*/op.getDataDependentInputIndices());
  return success();
}

ErrorOrSuccess Fallback<MO::SplitOp>::build(GraphOp &graph, OpBuilder &builder,
                                            MO::SplitOp op) {
  Location loc = op->getLoc();
  // `split_ith_output_shape` takes `split_axis` and `output_idx` as runtime
  // scalar operands, so materialize the axis attribute as a constant.
  SmallVector<Value> operands(op->getOperands());
  operands.push_back(
      MO::ConstantOp::create(builder, loc, op.getAxisAttr().getInt()));
  operands.push_back(nullptr); // placeholder for output_idx
  for (auto [idx, res] : llvm::enumerate(op.getResults())) {
    operands.back() =
        MO::ConstantOp::create(builder, loc, static_cast<int64_t>(idx));
    buildForOpResult(graph, builder, cast<TensorValue>(res),
                     "split_ith_output_shape", operands,
                     op.getOutputParamDecls(),
                     /*kgenParams=*/{},
                     /*dataDepInputIdxs=*/{1, 2, 3});
  }
  return success();
}

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_CANONICALIZECHAINSEQUENCES
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/Transforms/MOTransforms.h.inc"

using namespace M;
using namespace M::MO;

static bool hasSingleChain(MOMutableOpInterface mutOp) {
  return mutOp.getInChains().size() == 1 && mutOp.getOutChains().size() == 1;
}

/// Collects operands with write effects for a mutable op. When effects are
/// unknown, treats all mutable operands as written so chain relaxation is
/// blocked.
static llvm::SmallDenseSet<Value>
collectWriteEffectOperands(MOMutableOpInterface mutOp) {
  std::optional<llvm::SmallVector<mlir::MemoryEffects::EffectInstance>>
      effects = mlir::getEffectsRecursively(mutOp);

  if (!effects) {
    auto range =
        llvm::make_filter_range(mutOp->getOperands(), isMutableOperand);
    return {range.begin(), range.end()};
  }

  llvm::SmallDenseSet<Value> result;

  for (auto &effect : *effects) {
    if (isa<mlir::MemoryEffects::Write>(effect.getEffect())) {
      Value val = effect.getValue();
      ASSERT_STREAM(val, "Needs to have attached value!");
      result.insert(val);
    }
  }

  return result;
}

/// Returns true if the chain linking mutOp1 and mutOp2 can be relaxed without a
/// data race, i.e. neither writes an operand the other uses.
static bool canSafelyReorderMutableOps(MOMutableOpInterface mutOp1,
                                       MOMutableOpInterface mutOp2) {
  // A multi-device op is a rendezvous. Relaxing its chain is race-free but
  // changes when the collective becomes resident on the device, which can
  // leave the other ranks spinning.
  if (mutOp1->hasTrait<MOMultiDevice>() || mutOp2->hasTrait<MOMultiDevice>())
    return false;

  auto r1 = llvm::make_filter_range(mutOp1->getOperands(), isMutableOperand);
  auto r2 = llvm::make_filter_range(mutOp2->getOperands(), isMutableOperand);

  auto mutableOperands1 = llvm::SmallDenseSet<Value>{r1.begin(), r1.end()};
  auto mutableOperands2 = llvm::SmallDenseSet<Value>{r2.begin(), r2.end()};

  auto writeEffectOperands1 = collectWriteEffectOperands(mutOp1);
  auto writeEffectOperands2 = collectWriteEffectOperands(mutOp2);

  if (llvm::set_intersects(mutableOperands1, writeEffectOperands2) ||
      llvm::set_intersects(mutableOperands2, writeEffectOperands1))
    return false;

  // A kernel may return a ref to an input opaque value. Lacking alias
  // analysis, reject ops whose opaque operands name the same type.
  llvm::SmallDenseSet<StringAttr> symbolSet;
  for (Value v : r1) {
    if (auto opaqueType = dyn_cast<MO::OpaqueType>(v.getType()))
      symbolSet.insert(opaqueType.getSymbol());
  }

  bool hasSameOpaqueType = llvm::any_of(r2, [&](Value v) {
    if (auto opaqueType = dyn_cast<MO::OpaqueType>(v.getType()))
      return symbolSet.contains(opaqueType.getSymbol());
    return false;
  });

  return !hasSameOpaqueType;
}

namespace {

struct CanonicalizeBufferOpSequences
    : public mlir::OpInterfaceRewritePattern<MOMutableOpInterface> {
  using OpInterfaceRewritePattern::OpInterfaceRewritePattern;

  LogicalResult
  matchAndRewrite(MOMutableOpInterface mutOp,
                  mlir::PatternRewriter &origRewriter) const override {
    DeviceAwareRewriter rewriter(mutOp, origRewriter);

    std::optional<ChainValue> inChain = mutOp.getUniqueInChain();
    std::optional<ChainValue> outChain = mutOp.getUniqueOutChain();
    if (!inChain || !outChain)
      return rewriter.notifyMatchFailure(
          mutOp,
          "Mutable op has multiple chains; canonicalization not supported");

    rewriter.setInsertionPointAfter(mutOp);

    auto rawParent = inChain->getDefiningOp();

    // An op in a region body (e.g. mo.parallel) may capture an outer-scope
    // chain; bypassing it would break sequencing.
    if (rawParent && rawParent->getParentRegion() != mutOp->getParentRegion())
      return rewriter.notifyMatchFailure(mutOp,
                                         "chain crosses a region boundary");

    auto parent = dyn_cast_if_present<MOMutableOpInterface>(rawParent);

    if (parent && hasSingleChain(parent) &&
        canSafelyReorderMutableOps(mutOp, parent)) {
      auto parentInChain = parent.getInChains()[0];

      rewriter.modifyOpInPlace(mutOp.getOperation(), [&]() {
        mutOp.getUniqueInChainMutable()->set(parentInChain);
      });

      Value parentOutChain = parent.getOutChains()[0];

      auto merge = rewriter.create<ChainCreateOp>(
          mutOp->getLoc(), ValueRange({*outChain, parentOutChain}));

      rewriter.replaceAllUsesExcept(*outChain, merge.getResult(), merge);

      return success();
    } else if (auto chainCreateOp =
                   dyn_cast_if_present<ChainCreateOp>(rawParent)) {
      mlir::BitVector eraseIdxs(chainCreateOp->getNumOperands());

      SmallVector<Value> newCreateOperands;
      SmallVector<Value> residualOperands;

      for (auto &&[idx, operand] :
           llvm::enumerate(chainCreateOp->getOperands())) {
        if (!isa<ChainType>(operand.getType())) {
          residualOperands.push_back(operand);
          continue;
        }

        auto upstreamOp = operand.getDefiningOp<MOMutableOpInterface>();
        if (upstreamOp && hasSingleChain(upstreamOp) &&
            canSafelyReorderMutableOps(mutOp, upstreamOp)) {
          eraseIdxs[idx] = true;
          newCreateOperands.push_back(operand);
          llvm::append_range(residualOperands, upstreamOp.getInChains());
          continue;
        }

        residualOperands.push_back(operand);
      }

      if (newCreateOperands.empty())
        return rewriter.notifyMatchFailure(
            mutOp,
            "Upstream mo.chain.create has no chain operands derived from "
            "other in-place operations on non-aliased buffers");

      newCreateOperands.push_back(*outChain);

      auto merge =
          rewriter.create<ChainCreateOp>(mutOp->getLoc(), newCreateOperands);

      rewriter.replaceAllUsesExcept(*outChain, merge.getResult(), merge);

      auto newInChain =
          rewriter.create<ChainCreateOp>(mutOp->getLoc(), residualOperands);
      mutOp.getInChainsMutable()[0]->set(newInChain);
      return success();
    } else {
      return rewriter.notifyMatchFailure(
          mutOp, "The op upstream is not a chain.create or buffer mutating "
                 "operation.");
    }
  }
};

struct CanonicalizeChainSequencesPass
    : public impl::CanonicalizeChainSequencesBase<
          CanonicalizeChainSequencesPass> {
  using CanonicalizeChainSequencesBase::CanonicalizeChainSequencesBase;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    MLIRContext *ctx = &getContext();

    RewritePatternSet patterns{ctx};

    patterns.add<CanonicalizeBufferOpSequences>(ctx);
    ChainCreateOp::getCanonicalizationPatterns(patterns, ctx);

    // Chains can be long.
    mlir::GreedyRewriteConfig config;
    config.setMaxIterations(750).setUseTopDownTraversal();

    if (failed(applyPatternsGreedily(getOperation(), std::move(patterns),
                                     config))) {
      mlir::emitError(getOperation()->getLoc(),
                      "maximum number of iterations reached in "
                      "canonicalize-chain-sequences");
      return signalPassFailure();
    }
  }
};

// Holds all the information necessary to execute and replace all constant
// subgraphs in a single graph op.
struct SubgraphsInfo {
  GraphOp orig;
  std::string constantSubgraphName;
  // Need the subgraph for its output values.
  SmallVector<Subgraph> subgraphs;
};

using RuntimeTensor = std::pair<ElementsAttr, TensorShape>;

struct ModelResult {
  /// Subgraph output op to its replacement constants, with runtime shapes so
  /// unknown dims can be resolved.
  llvm::DenseMap<Operation *, SmallVector<RuntimeTensor>> constants;
  /// Subgraph parameter name to its folded value.
  llvm::DenseMap<StringAttr, int64_t> parameters;
};

// Models need to ensure that their backing buffer lives as long as they do.
struct ModelsWithBuffer {
  ModelList models;
  BufferRef buffer;
};

} // namespace

static const Model *findModelByName(const ModelList &models, StringRef name) {
  for (const std::unique_ptr<const Model> &model : models) {
    if (model && model->getName() == name)
      return model.get();
  }
  return nullptr;
}

llvm::SetVector<StringAttr> M::MO::Subgraph::paramDeclarations() const {
  llvm::SetVector<StringAttr> params;
  for (auto op : ops) {
    op->walk([&](KGEN::ParamOpInterface paramOp) {
      paramOp.walkDeclarations(
          [&](KGEN::ParamDeclAttr decl) { params.insert(decl.getName()); });
      paramOp.walkDefinitions(
          [&](KGEN::ParamDeclAttr decl, const KGEN::ParamDefValue &val) {
            params.insert(decl.getName());
          });
    });
  }
  return params;
}

/// Topologically sort parameters in a list of ops.
static llvm::SmallVector<Operation *>
sortParams(llvm::ArrayRef<Operation *> ops) {
  // ParameterUseDefGraph doesn't map from parameter to operations using it, so
  // we have to construct our own.
  llvm::DenseMap<StringAttr, llvm::SetVector<StringAttr>> uses;
  llvm::DenseMap<StringAttr, Operation *> defs;
  for (auto op : ops) {
    op->walk([&](KGEN::ParamOpInterface paramOp) {
      paramOp.walkDeclarations([&](KGEN::ParamDeclAttr decl) {
        defs[decl.getName()] = op;
        uses[decl.getName()] = {};
      });
      paramOp.walkDefinitions(
          [&](KGEN::ParamDeclAttr decl, const KGEN::ParamDefValue &val) {
            llvm::SetVector<StringAttr> params;
            for (auto expr : val.exprs) {
              expr.walk([&](KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr ref) {
                params.insert(ref.getName());
              });
            }
            defs[decl.getName()] = op;
            uses[decl.getName()] = params;
          });
    });
  }

  llvm::SetVector<Operation *> sorted;
  llvm::SetVector<StringAttr> inserted;
  llvm::SmallVector<StringAttr> workQueue;
  for (auto [k, _] : uses)
    workQueue.push_back(k);
  while (!workQueue.empty()) {
    StringAttr param = workQueue.back();
    workQueue.pop_back();

    if (inserted.contains(param))
      continue;
    auto notHandled =
        llvm::make_filter_range(uses.at(param), [&](StringAttr param) {
          return !inserted.contains(param);
        });
    if (notHandled.empty()) {
      inserted.insert(param);
      sorted.insert(defs[param]);
      continue;
    }

    workQueue.push_back(param);
    for (auto dependentParam : notHandled)
      workQueue.push_back(dependentParam);
  }

  for (auto op : ops)
    sorted.insert(op);
  return sorted.takeVector();
}

/// Returns false if `op` (an MO or KGEN param op) is definitely not constant
/// foldable.
static bool isMaybeConstantFoldable(Operation *op) {
  if (op->getNumRegions() != 0)
    return false;

  if (isa<MO::TransferOp>(op))
    return false;

  if (isa<MO::ConstantExternalOp>(op))
    return false;

  // Skip ops with parameterized shapes.
  auto findParamDeclRefAttr = [](KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr paramRef) {
    return WalkResult::interrupt();
  };

  for (auto operandTy : op->getOperandTypes()) {
    if (operandTy.walk(findParamDeclRefAttr).wasInterrupted()) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  for (auto resultTy : op->getResultTypes()) {
    if (resultTy.walk(findParamDeclRefAttr).wasInterrupted()) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  for (auto attr : op->getAttrs()) {
    if (attr.getValue().walk(findParamDeclRefAttr).wasInterrupted()) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Skip ops which declare/define parameters (NOTE: they may not use them)
  auto paramOpInterface = dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamOpInterface>(op);
  if (paramOpInterface) {
    bool definesOrDeclaresParams = false;
    paramOpInterface.walkDefinitions(
        [&](KGEN::ParamDeclAttr param, const ParamDefValue &val) {
          definesOrDeclaresParams = true;
        });
    paramOpInterface.walkDeclarations(
        [&](KGEN::ParamDeclAttr param) { definesOrDeclaresParams = true; });
    if (definesOrDeclaresParams)
      return false;
  }

  bool isMOOrMOGG =
      isa_and_nonnull<MO::MODialect, MOGG::MOGGDialect>(op->getDialect());

  bool isSupportedMOOrMOGG =
      isMOOrMOGG &&
      // TODO (#29484): Graphs with mo.list outputs can't be lowered to
      // MGP.
      llvm::all_of(op->getResultTypes(), [](Type ty) {
        return isa<MO::TensorType, MOSH::ShapeType, MO::ListType>(ty);
      });

  bool isNonMOOrMOGGParamOp =
      isa<KGEN::ParamOpInterface, MOSH::ParamToValueOp, KGEN::ParamDeclareOp>(
          op) &&
      !isMOOrMOGG;

  return (isSupportedMOOrMOGG || isNonMOOrMOGGParamOp) &&
         !isa<MOControlOpInterface>(op);
}

/// Wraps a `dense_resource` as a tensor that owns the blob when all of the
/// constant's users are in `subgraph`, and borrows it otherwise.
static Tensor denseResourceAsTensor(AsyncRT::CPUDevice &cpuDevice,
                                    ConstantOp constant,
                                    DenseResourceElementsAttr denseResource,
                                    const Subgraph &subgraph) {
  mlir::AsmResourceBlob *blob = denseResource.getRawHandle().getBlob();
  TensorType ttype = dyn_cast<TensorType>(constant.getType());
  TensorSpec spec(ttype.getShape().getIntDims(), ttype.getDtype());

  llvm::SetVector<Operation *> constantUsers;
  for (Operation *user : constant->getUsers())
    constantUsers.insert(user);

  llvm::SetVector<Operation *> usersOutsideSubgraph(constantUsers);
  usersOutsideSubgraph.set_subtract(subgraph.ops);

  // Frees the blob when the buffer dies instead of with the MLIRContext.
  if (usersOutsideSubgraph.empty() && blob->getDeleter()) {
    auto async = AsyncValue::createReady<GML::BlobLifetimeManager>(
        cpuDevice.getCompactPtr(), std::move(blob->getDeleter()),
        blob->getData(), blob->getDataAlignment());
    blob->getDeleter() = nullptr;
    auto ref = AnyAsyncValueRef::take(async);

    TensorBufferRef blobBuffer = TensorBufferRef::create(
        reinterpret_cast<void *>(const_cast<char *>(blob->getData().data())),
        blob->getData().size(), std::move(ref), blob->getDataAlignment());
    return Tensor(std::move(blobBuffer), std::move(spec));
  }

  return Tensor::createBorrowed(blob->getData().data(), spec,
                                blob->getDataAlignment());
}

/// Creates an `ElementsAttr` with the same data as the tensor in `ref`.
static ElementsAttr elementsAttrFromTensor(const AnyAsyncValueRef &ref,
                                           MLIRContext *ctx) {
  // The size is only known at runtime.
  Tensor &tensor = ref.get<Tensor>();
  TensorShape shape = tensor.getShape();
  size_t numElements = shape.getNumElements();
  ArrayType arrayType = ArrayType::get(
      ctx, numElements, toMLIRType(ctx, tensor.getEltType()).get());
  ArrayRef<char> tensorData(tensor.getBuffer<char>(), tensor.getSizeInBytes());
  size_t elementByteAlign = llvm::PowerOf2Ceil(
      llvm::divideCeil(arrayType.getElementTypeBitWidth(), CHAR_BIT));
  if (!shouldUseOutOfLineAttrStorage(arrayType.getNumElements()))
    return getInlineAttrForTensorDataCopy(arrayType, tensorData);

  auto resourceManager = DenseResourceElementsHandle::getManagerInterface(ctx);
  TensorBufferRef &bufferRef = tensor.getBufferRef();

  // Reuses the data within the BufferRef and extends the lifetime of it.
  mlir::AsmResourceBlob blob =
      mlir::UnmanagedAsmResourceBlob::allocateWithAlign(
          tensorData, elementByteAlign,
          [storage = bufferRef.getMemStorageHandle().copy()](void *, size_t,
                                                             size_t) {
            // No-op that drops the `bufferRef` when the closure is
            // destroyed.
          });

  return DenseResourceElementsAttr::get(
      arrayType, resourceManager.insert("folded_const", std::move(blob)));
}

static RuntimeTensor extractRuntimeOutput(
    const AnyAsyncValueRef &ref, MLIRContext *ctx,
    llvm::DenseMap<M::AsyncRT::AsyncValue *, ElementsAttr> &cachedConstants) {
  if (M::MLRT::Tensor *tensor = dyn_cast<Tensor>(ref)) {
    ElementsAttr constantsArr;

    auto [it, inserted] =
        cachedConstants.try_emplace(ref.getPointer(), nullptr);
    if (!inserted) {
      // Reuse the attribute for a value returned more than once, avoiding
      // duplicate dense_resources. For example, folding:
      //  mo.if(...) {
      //     %1 = some_op(%cst0)
      //  } else {
      //     %1 = some_op(%cst0)
      // }
      // would otherwise generate:
      // mo.if(...) {
      //   %1 = constant { value=<folded_constant_1> }
      // } else {
      //   %1 = constant { value=<folded_constant_2> }
      // }
      constantsArr = it->second;
    } else {
      constantsArr = elementsAttrFromTensor(ref, ctx);
      it->second = constantsArr;
    }
    return RuntimeTensor(constantsArr, tensor->getShape());
  } else {
    ASSERT_STREAM(false, << "Unexpected GML type");
    llvm_unreachable("Unexpected GML type");
  }
}

/// Executes `model` and returns the folded constants and parameters of its
/// subgraphs.
static AsyncRT::ErrorDiagnosticOr<ModelResult>
executeModel(MLIRContext *ctx, const Model *model,
             const SubgraphsInfo &subgraphsInfo) {
  AsyncRT::CPUDevice &cpuDevice = *loadContext(ctx)->get<AsyncRT::CPUDevice>();
  auto executableModelOr = model->setup(cpuDevice);
  if (executableModelOr.isError())
    return executableModelOr.takeError();

  auto executableModel = executableModelOr.takeValue();
  auto setupErrorOrSuccess = executableModel->waitForModelSetup();
  if (setupErrorOrSuccess.isError()) {
    Error error("Model setup failed, not ready for execution"
                ".  Modular internal detail: " +
                Twine(setupErrorOrSuccess.getError()));
    return AsyncRT::EncodedDiagnostic(std::move(error),
                                      model->getLocation().copy());
  }

  SmallVector<AnyAsyncValueRef> inputTensorsInMEFIndexOrder;
  for (const Subgraph &subgraph : subgraphsInfo.subgraphs) {
    for (ConstantOp constant : subgraph.constants()) {
      if (auto denseResource =
              dyn_cast<DenseResourceElementsAttr>(constant.getValueAttr())) {
        inputTensorsInMEFIndexOrder.push_back(
            AsyncValueRef<Tensor>::createReady(
                cpuDevice, denseResourceAsTensor(cpuDevice, constant,
                                                 denseResource, subgraph)));
      }
    }
  }
  auto results = executableModel->execute(inputTensorsInMEFIndexOrder);

  if (results.empty())
    return AsyncRT::EncodedDiagnostic("Failed to execute model",
                                      model->getLocation().copy());

  AsyncRT::await(results);
  for (auto &result : results)
    if (result.isError())
      return AsyncRT::EncodedDiagnostic(result.takeDiagnostic());

  MutableArrayRef<AnyAsyncValueRef> resultCopy(results.data(), results.size());

  [[maybe_unused]] const AnyAsyncValueRef &ch = resultCopy.front();
  ASSERT_STREAM(ch.isReady() && isa<Chain>(ch),
                << "first result must be a ready chain");
  resultCopy = resultCopy.drop_front();

  llvm::DenseMap<M::AsyncRT::AsyncValue *, ElementsAttr> cachedConstants;
  llvm::DenseMap<Operation *, SmallVector<RuntimeTensor>> opToTensors;
  auto resourceManager = DenseResourceElementsHandle::getManagerInterface(ctx);
  size_t outIdx = 0;
  for (const Subgraph &subgraph : subgraphsInfo.subgraphs) {
    for (auto op : subgraph.outputs) {
      SmallVector<RuntimeTensor> opTensors;
      for (size_t i = 0; i < op->getNumResults(); ++i) {
        AnyAsyncValueRef &tensorRef = resultCopy[outIdx];
        if (tensorRef.isError())
          return AsyncRT::EncodedDiagnostic(tensorRef.takeDiagnostic());

        ASSERT_STREAM(tensorRef.isReady(),
                      << "We already awaited, tensor should be ready");
        opTensors.push_back(
            extractRuntimeOutput(tensorRef, ctx, cachedConstants));
        ++outIdx;
      }
      opToTensors[op] = opTensors;
    }
  }

  // Parameters follow the constants.
  llvm::DenseMap<StringAttr, int64_t> params;
  for (const Subgraph &subgraph : subgraphsInfo.subgraphs) {
    for (auto paramName : subgraph.paramDeclarations()) {
      auto &tensor = resultCopy[outIdx];
      if (tensor.isError())
        return AsyncRT::EncodedDiagnostic(tensor.takeDiagnostic());
      ASSERT_STREAM(tensor.isReady(),
                    << "We already awaited, tensor should be ready");
      ASSERT_STREAM(tensor.isType<Tensor>(),
                    << "Subgraph shape output should be a tensor");
      Tensor &t = tensor.get<Tensor>();
      params[paramName] = t.getBuffer<const int64_t>()[0];
      ++outIdx;
    }
  }
  return ModelResult{opToTensors, params};
}

SmallVector<Subgraph>
M::MO::constantSubgraphs(MO::GraphOp graph,
                         KGEN::ParameterCollector::Analysis &paramCache) {
  // Grows constant subgraphs from mo.constant users: an op is constant when
  // all its inputs are, resolving unvisited inputs first. Tracks ops rather
  // than values so parameters are covered too.

  llvm::DenseSet<Operation *> nonConst;

  // Constant ops (mo.constant, or all inputs constant); each class is a
  // connected DAG.
  llvm::EquivalenceClasses<Operation *> constSubgraphs;
  // An op is re-pushed until its operands are resolved.
  llvm::SmallVector<Operation *> workQueue;
  graph.walk([&](ConstantOp op) {
    auto dense = dyn_cast<DenseResourceElementsAttr>(op.getValueAttr());
    // Skip a dense_resource with no blob behind it.
    if (dense && !(dense.getRawHandle().getBlob())) {
      nonConst.insert(op);
      return;
    }
    constSubgraphs.insert(op);
    for (auto user : op.getResult().getUsers())
      workQueue.push_back(user);
  });

  // Bounded to catch unexpected infinite recursion.
  size_t iter = 0;
  size_t boundForMaximumIterations = 1000000;
  for (; iter < boundForMaximumIterations; ++iter) {
    if (workQueue.empty())
      break;

    Operation *op = workQueue.back();
    workQueue.pop_back();

    if (constSubgraphs.contains(op))
      continue;

    if (nonConst.contains(op))
      continue;

    if (!isMaybeConstantFoldable(op)) {
      nonConst.insert(op);
      continue;
    }

    llvm::DenseSet<Operation *> unvisitedOperands;
    bool foundNonConst = false;
    for (auto operand : op->getOperands()) {
      Operation *definition = operand.getDefiningOp();
      if (!definition || nonConst.contains(definition)) {
        foundNonConst = true;
        break;
      }
      if (!constSubgraphs.contains(definition)) {
        unvisitedOperands.insert(definition);
      }
    }
    if (foundNonConst) {
      nonConst.insert(op);
      continue;
    }

    // Revisit this op after its unvisited operands.
    if (!unvisitedOperands.empty()) {
      workQueue.push_back(op);
      for (auto definition : unvisitedOperands)
        workQueue.push_back(definition);
      continue;
    }

    constSubgraphs.insert(op);
    for (auto operand : op->getOperands())
      constSubgraphs.unionSets(op, operand.getDefiningOp());

    for (auto result : op->getResults())
      for (auto user : result.getUsers())
        workQueue.push_back(user);
  }
  ASSERT_STREAM(
      iter < boundForMaximumIterations,
      << "Hit bound on maximum number of iterations for detecting constant "
         "subgraphs. Either this graph op is VERY large (in which case this "
         "bound should be increased), or else somehow there is infinite "
         "recursion (which is a bug)");

  SmallVector<Subgraph> subgraphs;
  for (auto it = constSubgraphs.begin(), end = constSubgraphs.end(); it != end;
       ++it) {
    if (!(*it)->isLeader())
      continue;

    llvm::SetVector<Operation *> members(constSubgraphs.member_begin(*(*it)),
                                         constSubgraphs.member_end());
    Subgraph subgraph(members);

    // Ignore subgraphs that only contain constant ops.
    if (llvm::all_of(subgraph.ops, [](Operation *op) {
          return isa<ConstantOp>(op) || isa<KGEN::ParamDeclareOp>(op);
        }))
      continue;

    subgraphs.push_back(subgraph);
  }

  return subgraphs;
}

/// Clones `subgraphs` into a new GraphOp in `module` that outputs their
/// results. Large constants become inputs of the new graph.
static SubgraphsInfo cloneSubgraphs(OpBuilder builder, GraphOp orig,
                                    ModuleOp module,
                                    const SmallVector<Subgraph> &subgraphs,
                                    int64_t &name_counter) {
  llvm::SmallVector<Type> argTypes;
  for (const Subgraph &subgraph : subgraphs) {
    for (ConstantOp constant : subgraph.constants()) {
      auto dense = dyn_cast<DenseResourceElementsAttr>(constant.getValueAttr());
      if (dense)
        argTypes.push_back(constant.getType());
    }
  }
  llvm::SmallVector<Type> resultTypes;
  for (const Subgraph &subgraph : subgraphs) {
    for (auto op : subgraph.outputs) {
      for (auto result : op->getResults()) {
        resultTypes.push_back(result.getType());
      }
    }
  }

  // This name cannot be too long otherwise something breaks :(.
  auto graphop = GraphOp::create(builder, module.getLoc(),
                                 (orig.getName() + "_constant_subgraphs").str(),
                                 argTypes, resultTypes);
  builder.setInsertionPointToEnd(graphop.getBodyBlock());

  llvm::MapVector<ConstantOp, BlockArgument> inputConstants;
  int64_t idx = 0;
  for (const Subgraph &subgraph : subgraphs) {
    for (ConstantOp constant : subgraph.constants()) {
      auto dense = dyn_cast<DenseResourceElementsAttr>(constant.getValueAttr());
      if (dense) {
        inputConstants[constant] = graphop.getBody().getArgument(idx);
        ++idx;
      }
    }
  }

  SmallVector<Operation *, 8> opsSorted;
  for (const Subgraph &subgraph : subgraphs)
    for (auto op : subgraph.ops)
      opsSorted.push_back(op);
  // Param sorting alone doesn't keep definitions before uses.
  MLIRContext *ctx = module.getContext();
  Location loc = module.getLoc();
  opsSorted = sortParams(opsSorted);
  mlir::computeTopologicalSorting(opsSorted);
  IRMapping oldToNew;
  for (auto oldOp : opsSorted) {
    ConstantOp oldConst = dyn_cast<ConstantOp>(oldOp);
    if (oldConst) {
      auto it = inputConstants.find(oldConst);
      if (it != inputConstants.end()) {
        oldToNew.map(oldOp->getResult(0), it->second);
        continue;
      }
    }
    builder.clone(*oldOp, oldToNew);
  }
  llvm::SmallVector<Value> newOutputs;
  llvm::SetVector<KGEN::ParamDeclAttr> outputParams;
  for (const Subgraph &subgraph : subgraphs) {
    for (auto op : subgraph.outputs) {
      for (auto result : op->getResults()) {
        Value newOutput = oldToNew.lookup<Value>(result);
        if (llvm::isa<MOSH::ShapeType>(newOutput.getType())) {
          // Shapes can't be outputs; emit a rank-1 tensor of unknown size.
          newOutput = Shape::ToTensorOp::create(
              builder, loc,
              TensorType::get(
                  MOSH::ShapeAttr::get(
                      SmallVector<TypedAttr>(
                          {KGEN::UnknownAttr::get(builder.getIndexType())}),
                      MOSH::ShapeType::get(ctx)),
                  DType::si64),
              newOutput);
        }
        newOutput.getType().walk([&](KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr ref) {
          outputParams.insert(KGEN::ParamDeclAttr::get(ref));
        });
        newOutputs.push_back(newOutput);
      }
    }
  }

  // Expose each subgraph parameter as a rank-0 int tensor output.
  Type dimTy = MOSH::ShapeAttr::getDimType(ctx);
  for (const Subgraph &subgraph : subgraphs) {
    for (auto param : subgraph.paramDeclarations()) {
      Value dimVal = MOSH::ParamToValueOp::create(
          builder, loc, KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr::get(ctx, param, dimTy));
      newOutputs.push_back(IndexToTensorOp::create(
          builder, loc,
          TensorType::get(ArrayRef<int64_t>({}),
                          IntegerType::get(ctx, 64, IntegerType::Unsigned)),
          dimVal));
    }
  }
  // No output parameters because we bind them all locally.
  auto out = OutputOp::create(builder, loc, newOutputs,
                              KGEN::ParameterExprArrayAttr{});
  auto functionType =
      mlir::FunctionType::get(ctx, argTypes, out.getOperandTypes());
  graphop.setSignature(
      FuncTypeGeneratorType::get(/*inputParamTypes=*/{}, functionType));
  graphop.setFunctionType(functionType);

  // Rewrite all device attrs to target CPU.
  mlir::AttrTypeReplacer replacer;
  replacer.addReplacement(
      [&](DeviceRefAttr ref) { return DeviceRefAttr::get(ctx, kCPULabel, 0); });
  replacer.recursivelyReplaceElementsIn(graphop, /*replaceAttrs=*/true,
                                        /*replaceLocs=*/true,
                                        /*replaceTypes=*/true);

  return {orig, std::string(graphop.getName()), subgraphs};
}

static Value runtimeTensorToConstant(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                     RuntimeTensor tensor, Type type) {
  auto [constant, shape] = std::move(tensor);
  return ConstantOp::create(builder, loc, type, constant);
}

/// Replaces subgraph outputs with the executed constants, erases internal ops,
/// and declares the parameters the subgraph defined.
static void replaceConstantOps(GraphOp graph, OpBuilder &builder,
                               const ModelResult &modelResult,
                               const SubgraphsInfo &subgraphsInfo) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = graph.getContext();
  // Collect ops unused outside the subgraph before anything is erased.
  SmallVector<Operation *> allOps;
  for (const Subgraph &subgraph : subgraphsInfo.subgraphs)
    for (auto op : subgraph.ops)
      allOps.push_back(op);
  auto filtered = llvm::make_filter_range(allOps, [&](Operation *op) {
    return llvm::all_of(op->getResults(), [&](OpResult r) {
      return llvm::all_of(
          subgraphsInfo.subgraphs,
          [&](const Subgraph &subgraph) { return subgraph.fullyContains(r); });
    });
  });
  llvm::SmallVector<Operation *> internalOps(filtered.begin(), filtered.end());
  mlir::computeTopologicalSorting(internalOps);

  for (auto constant : modelResult.constants) {
    auto &op = constant.first;
    auto &tensors = constant.second;
    builder.setInsertionPoint(op);
    llvm::SmallVector<Value> newResults;
    for (auto [opResult, constantTensor] :
         llvm::zip(op->getResults(), tensors)) {
      Type type = opResult.getType();
      if (llvm::isa<TensorType>(type)) {
        newResults.push_back(runtimeTensorToConstant(builder, op->getLoc(),
                                                     constantTensor, type));
      } else if (llvm::isa<ShapeType>(type)) {
        auto intElems = dyn_cast<IntArrayElementsAttr>(constantTensor.first);
        newResults.push_back(MOSH::ParamToValueOp::create(
            builder, op->getLoc(),
            ShapeAttr::get(intElems.asArrayRef<int64_t>(),
                           MOSH::ShapeType::get(ctx))));
      } else {
        ASSERT_STREAM(false,
                      << "constants must be tensors or shapes but one is a "
                      << opResult.getType());
      }
    }
    op->replaceAllUsesWith(newResults);
    op->erase();
  }
  // Erase users before their operands.
  for (auto op : llvm::reverse(internalOps))
    op->erase();

  Type dimTy = MOSH::ShapeAttr::getDimType(ctx);
  builder.setInsertionPointToStart(graph.getBodyBlock());
  for (auto [name, val] : modelResult.parameters) {
    KGEN::ParamDeclareOp::create(builder, graph.getLoc(),
                                 KGEN::ParamDeclAttr::get(ctx, name, dimTy),
                                 MOSH::ShapeAttr::getDim(ctx, val));
  }
}

namespace M::MO {

struct ConstantFoldPass
    : public M::MO::impl::ConstantFoldBase<ConstantFoldPass> {
  using ConstantFoldBase::ConstantFoldBase;

  void runOnOperation() override;

  ConstantFoldPass()
      : ConstantFoldBase(), policy(new FactorMemIncrease(2, 100)) {}

  ConstantFoldPass(std::string_view label,
                   std::optional<std::string> cacheDirArg,
                   llvm::ArrayRef<std::string> kernelLibraryPathsArg)
      : ConstantFoldBase(), policy(new FactorMemIncrease(2, 100)),
        compiledFrameworkLabel(label), cacheDir(std::move(cacheDirArg)),
        kernelLibraryPaths(kernelLibraryPathsArg.vec()) {}

private:
  // Lowers `module` to MGP and MEF, then loads its models along with the
  // buffer that must outlive them. A member so it can call runPipeline.
  ErrorOr<ModelsWithBuffer> lowerSubgraphs(ModuleOp module);

  std::shared_ptr<const ConstantFoldPolicy> policy;
  // Label used to load and handle buffers created by the framework.
  std::string compiledFrameworkLabel;
  std::optional<std::string> cacheDir;
  std::optional<std::vector<std::string>> kernelLibraryPaths;
};

ErrorOr<ModelsWithBuffer> ConstantFoldPass::lowerSubgraphs(ModuleOp module) {
  // Seed the sub-module with the parent's kernel decls so the sub-pipeline
  // skips re-importing the `kernels` / `primitives` packages. A standalone
  // `mo-opt` run has no decls, so the sub-pipeline imports them itself.
  bool parentHasDecls =
      (*getOperation()).hasAttr(MOGG::kOpaqueTypeMappingAttrName);
  if (parentHasDecls)
    MOGG::copyKernelDecls(getOperation(), module);

  mlir::PassManager pm = mlir::PassManager::on<ModuleOp>(
      module.getContext(), mlir::OpPassManager::Nesting::Implicit);
  MO::GCPipelineOptions moOpts;
  if (cacheDir)
    moOpts.cacheDir = cacheDir.value();
  if (kernelLibraryPaths)
    moOpts.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths.value();
  // `copyKernelDecls` already provided the decls and opaque-type mapping.
  moOpts.kernelDeclsPrePopulated = parentHasDecls;
  // Avoid infinite recursion.
  moOpts.constantFold = false;
  // Reduce Memory overhead by not fusing compiled-regions primitives.
  moOpts.enableCompiledRegionsFusion = false;
  // Use MOF executor so we don't depend on a framework.
  moOpts.compiledFrameworkLabel = "mof";
  // This will fold sequence of trivial kernels not on host, leading to huge
  // kernels (in terms of code size).
  moOpts.performTrivialKernelOpt = false;
  // Assign ops to CPU so we can constant fold there.
  moOpts.defaultDeviceLabel = kCPULabel;
  // The folded model runs in this process, so compile for the host even when
  // a virtual CPU target retargets the outer compile (e.g. a Windows-ABI
  // object fails JIT-linking `__chkstk`).
  moOpts.compileForHostExecution = true;
  // Force all kernels to be synchronous. This prevents higher memory usage.
  moOpts.forceSync = true;
  // Constant subgraphs are mostly isolated, so post-ABI fusion only costs
  // compile time.
  moOpts.enablePostABIRegionFusion = false;
  MO::buildGCPipeline(pm, moOpts);
  if (failed(runPipeline(pm, module)))
    return Error("Failed to run MOToMGP pipeline");

  // `convertMGPToMEF` destroys `dense_resource`s; this is safe only because
  // folded subgraphs take them as operands, not attributes.
  auto bufOr = MO::convertMGPToMEF(module, false);
  if (bufOr)
    return bufOr.takeError();
  BufferRef buf = bufOr.takeValue();

  auto mefFileOr = MEFFile::open(buf->getBuffer());
  if (mefFileOr.isError())
    return mefFileOr.takeError();
  auto modelsOr = M::loadMGPMEFFile(std::move(*mefFileOr));
  if (modelsOr.isError())
    return modelsOr.takeError();
  return {ModelsWithBuffer{modelsOr.takeValue(), std::move(buf)}};
}

void ConstantFoldPass::runOnOperation() {
  MLIRContext *ctx = &getContext();

  for (auto _ : llvm::seq(iterations.getValue())) {
    OpBuilder builder(ctx);
    builder.setInsertionPointToStart(getOperation().getBody());
    // Passes can't create ops outside their operation, so subgraph copies
    // live in a temporary nested module.
    OwningOpRef<ModuleOp> module = ModuleOp::create(
        builder, getOperation().getLoc(), "constant_fold_subgraphs");

    // Alternative: merge all subgraphs into one graph and execute it once.
    SmallVector<SubgraphsInfo> subgraphReplacements;
    int64_t nameCounter = 0;

    for (auto graph : getOperation().getOps<GraphOp>()) {
      auto subgraphs = M::MO::constantSubgraphs(
          graph, getAnalysis<KGEN::ParameterCollector::Analysis>());
      if (subgraphs.empty())
        continue;

      subgraphs = policy->shouldFold(subgraphs);
      if (subgraphs.empty())
        continue;

      builder.setInsertionPointToEnd(module->getBody());
      subgraphReplacements.push_back(
          cloneSubgraphs(builder, graph, *module, subgraphs, nameCounter));
    }

    if (module->getBody()->getOperations().empty()) {
      // Remove module to not clutter the output.
      continue;
    }

    ErrorOr<ModelsWithBuffer> modelsOr = lowerSubgraphs(*module);
    if (failed(modelsOr)) {
      mlir::emitError(module->getLoc(),
                      "[ConstantFold] Unable to load models: " +
                          Twine(modelsOr.getError()));
      return signalPassFailure();
    }

    // We have to consolidate rewrites to the same graphop as the rewrites of
    // one subgraph may invalidate ops in another subgraph (due to fold
    // hooks).
    llvm::DenseMap<GraphOp,
                   llvm::SmallVector<std::pair<ModelResult, SubgraphsInfo>>>
        executionResults;
    for (const SubgraphsInfo &subgraphsInfo : subgraphReplacements) {
      const Model *model = findModelByName(modelsOr.get().models,
                                           subgraphsInfo.constantSubgraphName);
      ASSERT_STREAM(model != nullptr,
                    << "Model should exist, make sure names above match.");
      AsyncRT::ErrorDiagnosticOr<ModelResult> valuesToTensorsOr =
          executeModel(ctx, model, subgraphsInfo);
      if (valuesToTensorsOr.isError()) {
        AsyncRT::EncodedDiagnostic err = valuesToTensorsOr.takeError();
        auto decoded = err.decodeLocation();
        auto loc =
            mlir::FileLineColLoc::get(module->getContext(), decoded.filename,
                                      decoded.line, decoded.column);
        mlir::emitError(loc, "[ConstantFold] " + Twine(err.getMessage().get()));
        return signalPassFailure();
      }

      ModelResult valuesToTensors = valuesToTensorsOr.takeValue();

      auto [it, _] = executionResults.try_emplace(
          subgraphsInfo.orig,
          SmallVector<std::pair<ModelResult, SubgraphsInfo>>());

      it->second.push_back({std::move(valuesToTensors), subgraphsInfo});
    }

    // Replace output expressions with constants. Also handles DCE.
    for (auto [graph, results] : executionResults) {
      for (const auto &r : results) {
        const ModelResult &modelResult = r.first;
        const SubgraphsInfo &subgraphsInfo = r.second;
        replaceConstantOps(graph, builder, modelResult, subgraphsInfo);
      }
    }

    // Remove module to not clutter the output.
    module = nullptr;

    // Run canonicalization to uncover more constant folding.
    mlir::PassManager pm = mlir::PassManager::on<ModuleOp>(
        ctx, mlir::OpPassManager::Nesting::Implicit);
    pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
    if (failed(pm.run(getOperation()))) {
      mlir::emitError(getOperation().getLoc(),
                      "[ConstantFold] Failed to run canonicalization pass");
      return signalPassFailure();
    }
  }
}

} // namespace M::MO

std::unique_ptr<mlir::Pass>
M::MO::createConstantFoldPass(std::string_view compiledFrameworkLabel,
                              std::optional<std::string> cacheDir,
                              llvm::ArrayRef<std::string> kernelLibraryPaths) {
  return std::make_unique<ConstantFoldPass>(
      compiledFrameworkLabel, std::move(cacheDir), kernelLibraryPaths);
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
//
// mo-create-parallel-from-unbundle
//
// When each of a `mo.tensor.unbundle`'s N results has exactly one user and
// those users are distinct and structurally identical, wraps them in a fresh
// `mo.parallel` after the unbundle.
//
// The new parallel's primary input is a transient
// `bundle(unbundle(X)#0..N-1)`, which the post-pass canonicalize folds back to
// `X` so `mo-merge-adjacent-parallels` can merge it into the producer.
//
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/Transforms/MOTransforms.h"
#include "Support/AssertStream.h"
#include "mlir/IR/IRMapping.h"
#include "mlir/Interfaces/SideEffectInterfaces.h"
#include "mlir/Pass/Pass.h"
#include "llvm/ADT/DenseSet.h"
#include "llvm/ADT/SmallVector.h"
#include "llvm/Support/Debug.h"

#define DEBUG_TYPE "create-parallel-from-unbundle"

namespace M::MO {

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_CREATEPARALLELFROMUNBUNDLE
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/Transforms/MOTransforms.h.inc"

} // namespace M::MO

using namespace M;
using namespace M::MO;

namespace {

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Data structures
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

struct WrapCandidate {
  TensorUnbundleOp unbundleOp;
  /// One consumer op per launch, in launch-index order.
  SmallVector<Operation *> consumerOps;
  /// Operand position of `unbundleOp.getResult(i)` in `consumerOps[i]`,
  /// identical across launches.
  size_t drivingOperandIdx;
};

struct InputPlan {
  /// Outer values per bundle input. Entry 0 is the driving unbundle's results;
  /// the rest cover non-driving operand positions.
  SmallVector<SmallVector<Value>> bundles;
  /// For each operand of the representative consumer, the index into
  /// `bundles` whose corresponding block argument supplies it.
  SmallVector<size_t> operandToBlockArg;
};

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Predicates
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Returns true if \p op can be cloned into a parallel body.
static bool isAbsorbableConsumer(Operation *op) {
  if (op->getNumResults() == 0)
    return false;
  for (Value result : op->getResults())
    if (!isa<TensorType>(result.getType()))
      return false;
  for (Value operand : op->getOperands())
    if (isa<BufferType, ChainType>(operand.getType()))
      return false;
  if (op->hasTrait<OpTrait::HasRecursiveMemoryEffects>())
    return false;
  if (auto iface = dyn_cast<mlir::MemoryEffectOpInterface>(op))
    return iface.hasNoEffect();
  // MO elementwise / custom ops are pure but may not implement
  // MemoryEffectOpInterface; the buffer/chain check guards chain-bearing ops.
  return true;
}

/// Returns true if \p a and \p b match structurally, ignoring the per-launch
/// `device` attribute.
static bool opsMatch(Operation *a, Operation *b) {
  if (a->getName() != b->getName() ||
      a->getNumOperands() != b->getNumOperands() ||
      a->getNumResults() != b->getNumResults())
    return false;

  auto stripDevice = [](DictionaryAttr attrs) {
    SmallVector<NamedAttribute> filtered;
    filtered.reserve(attrs.size());
    for (NamedAttribute attr : attrs)
      if (attr.getName() != kOperationDeviceRefAttrName)
        filtered.push_back(attr);
    return DictionaryAttr::get(attrs.getContext(), filtered);
  };
  return stripDevice(a->getAttrDictionary()) ==
         stripDevice(b->getAttrDictionary());
}

/// Returns true if \p perLaunchValues can be one bundle input: shape and dtype
/// agree across launches, and each device matches \p launchDevices (the
/// driving unbundle's source bundle devices).
static bool canBundlePerLaunch(ArrayRef<Value> perLaunchValues,
                               ArrayRef<DeviceRefAttr> launchDevices) {
  auto firstTy = dyn_cast<TensorType>(perLaunchValues[0].getType());
  if (!firstTy)
    return false;

  for (Value v : perLaunchValues.drop_front()) {
    auto ty = dyn_cast<TensorType>(v.getType());
    if (!ty || firstTy.getShape() != ty.getShape() ||
        firstTy.getDtype() != ty.getDtype())
      return false;
  }

  for (auto [i, v] : llvm::enumerate(perLaunchValues))
    if (cast<TensorType>(v.getType()).getDeviceRef() != launchDevices[i])
      return false;
  return true;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Candidate discovery
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Returns a wrap candidate seeded by \p unbundleOp, or std::nullopt if its
/// consumers don't qualify.
static std::optional<WrapCandidate> findCandidate(TensorUnbundleOp unbundleOp) {
  if (unbundleOp.getNumResults() == 0)
    return std::nullopt;
  if (!llvm::all_of(unbundleOp.getResults(),
                    [](Value v) { return v.hasOneUse(); }))
    return std::nullopt;
  auto consumers = llvm::map_to_vector(unbundleOp.getResults(), [](Value v) {
    return v.getUses().begin()->getOwner();
  });

  // A binary op consuming two unbundled elements (e.g. `mo.add(u#0, u#1)`)
  // would otherwise be cloned/erased twice.
  llvm::SmallDenseSet<Operation *> unique;
  for (Operation *c : consumers)
    if (!unique.insert(c).second)
      return std::nullopt;

  Operation *rep = consumers[0];
  if (!isAbsorbableConsumer(rep))
    return std::nullopt;
  for (Operation *op : llvm::drop_begin(consumers))
    if (!opsMatch(rep, op))
      return std::nullopt;

  // unbundle#0 has one use, so it appears at exactly one operand of `rep`.
  OperandRange repOperands = rep->getOperands();
  auto it = llvm::find(repOperands, unbundleOp.getResult(0));
  ASSERT_STREAM(it != repOperands.end(),
                << "rep " << *rep << " is the unique user of "
                << unbundleOp.getResult(0) << " but does not reference it");
  size_t drivingOperandIdx = std::distance(repOperands.begin(), it);

  // Peers must share the driving operand index, or substituting block args by
  // position mis-routes operands (e.g. a commutative op in swapped order).
  for (auto [i, peer] : llvm::enumerate(llvm::drop_begin(consumers)))
    if (peer->getOperand(drivingOperandIdx) != unbundleOp.getResult(i + 1))
      return std::nullopt;

  return WrapCandidate{unbundleOp, std::move(consumers), drivingOperandIdx};
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Input planning
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Gives each non-driving operand position its own per-launch bundle. Returns
/// std::nullopt if such an operand is shared across all launches (would need
/// an outer capture) or can't be bundled.
static std::optional<InputPlan>
planInputs(WrapCandidate &candidate, ArrayRef<DeviceRefAttr> launchDevices) {
  size_t numLaunches = candidate.unbundleOp.getNumResults();
  size_t numOperands = candidate.consumerOps[0]->getNumOperands();

  InputPlan plan;
  plan.operandToBlockArg.assign(numOperands, 0);
  plan.bundles.emplace_back(candidate.unbundleOp.getResults().begin(),
                            candidate.unbundleOp.getResults().end());

  for (size_t idx = 0; idx < numOperands; ++idx) {
    if (idx == candidate.drivingOperandIdx)
      continue;

    SmallVector<Value> outerValues;
    outerValues.reserve(numLaunches);
    for (size_t launch = 0; launch < numLaunches; ++launch)
      outerValues.push_back(candidate.consumerOps[launch]->getOperand(idx));

    // TODO: Allow captured value from outside the parallel's body.
    if (llvm::all_equal(outerValues))
      return std::nullopt;
    if (!canBundlePerLaunch(outerValues, launchDevices))
      return std::nullopt;
    plan.bundles.push_back(std::move(outerValues));
    plan.operandToBlockArg[idx] = plan.bundles.size() - 1;
  }
  return plan;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Construction
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Replaces the consumers with a mo.parallel after \p candidate.unbundleOp
/// whose body is one clone of the representative consumer.
static void wrapCandidate(WrapCandidate &candidate, const InputPlan &plan,
                          OpBuilder &builder) {
  Location loc = candidate.unbundleOp.getLoc();
  builder.setInsertionPointAfter(candidate.unbundleOp);
  Operation *representative = candidate.consumerOps[0];

  SmallVector<Value> inputs;
  for (ArrayRef<Value> values : plan.bundles) {
    SmallVector<Type> elemTypes =
        llvm::map_to_vector(values, [](Value v) { return v.getType(); });
    auto bundleTy = BundleType::get(builder.getContext(), elemTypes);
    inputs.push_back(
        TensorBundleOp::create(builder, loc, bundleTy, values).getResult());
  }

  SmallVector<Type> outputElemTypes =
      llvm::map_to_vector(candidate.consumerOps, [](Operation *op) {
        return op->getResult(0).getType();
      });
  auto outputBundleTy = BundleType::get(builder.getContext(), outputElemTypes);

  auto parallel =
      ParallelOp::create(builder, loc, inputs, TypeRange{outputBundleTy});

  Block &body = parallel.getBodyRegion().front();
  IRMapping mapping;
  for (auto [i, blockArgIdx] : llvm::enumerate(plan.operandToBlockArg))
    mapping.map(representative->getOperand(i), body.getArgument(blockArgIdx));
  auto bodyBuilder = OpBuilder::atBlockBegin(&body);
  Operation *cloned = bodyBuilder.clone(*representative, mapping);
  YieldOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, ValueRange{cloned->getResult(0)});

  builder.setInsertionPointAfter(parallel);
  auto newUnbundle = TensorUnbundleOp::create(builder, loc, outputElemTypes,
                                              parallel.getResult(0));
  for (auto [i, op] : llvm::enumerate(candidate.consumerOps)) {
    op->getResult(0).replaceAllUsesWith(newUnbundle.getResult(i));
    op->erase();
  }

  // Keep the original unbundle: bundle #0 reads from it until the post-pass
  // canonicalize folds the pair away.
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Pass driver
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Visits every `TensorUnbundleOp` reachable from \p root and tries to wrap
/// its consumer set.  Returns true if at least one wrap fired.
static bool runOneIteration(Operation *root, OpBuilder &builder) {
  SmallVector<TensorUnbundleOp> unbundles;
  root->walk([&](TensorUnbundleOp op) { unbundles.push_back(op); });

  bool changed = false;
  for (TensorUnbundleOp unbundleOp : unbundles) {
    // Skip ops erased by an earlier wrap this iteration.
    if (!unbundleOp.getOperation()->getParentOp())
      continue;
    auto candidate = findCandidate(unbundleOp);
    if (!candidate)
      continue;
    auto inputBundleTy =
        cast<BundleType>(candidate->unbundleOp.getInput().getType());
    auto launchDevices = llvm::map_to_vector(
        inputBundleTy.getElementTypes(), [](Type t) -> DeviceRefAttr {
          return cast<TensorType>(t).getDeviceRef();
        });
    auto plan = planInputs(*candidate, launchDevices);
    if (!plan)
      continue;

    LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "create-parallel-from-unbundle: wrapping "
                            << candidate->consumerOps.size() << " peer(s) of "
                            << candidate->unbundleOp << "\n");
    wrapCandidate(*candidate, *plan, builder);
    changed = true;
  }
  return changed;
}

struct CreateParallelFromUnbundlePass
    : public impl::CreateParallelFromUnbundleBase<
          CreateParallelFromUnbundlePass> {
  using CreateParallelFromUnbundleBase::CreateParallelFromUnbundleBase;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    OpBuilder builder{&getContext()};
    // Each wrap's new output unbundle may seed a downstream wrap.
    while (runOneIteration(getOperation(), builder)) {
    }
  }
};

} // namespace
