#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MODevices.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOInterfaces.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/Transforms/MOTransforms.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MOGGDialect/MOGGPasses.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MOSHDialect/MOSHAttrs.h"
#include "mlir/Dialect/LLVMIR/NVVMDialect.h"
#include "mlir/Dialect/LLVMIR/ROCDLDialect.h"
#include "mlir/IR/PatternMatch.h"
#include "mlir/Transforms/GreedyPatternRewriteDriver.h"
#include "llvm/ADT/STLExtras.h"
#include <numeric>

#define DEBUG_TYPE "elide-redundant-store-load-pairs"

namespace M::MO {

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_ELIDEREDUNDANTMUTABLEOPS
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/Transforms/MOTransforms.h.inc"

namespace {

struct EliminateRedundantLoads
    : public DeviceAwareRewritePattern<OpRewritePattern, MO::MutableLoadOp> {

  EliminateRedundantLoads(MLIRContext *ctx)
      : DeviceAwareRewritePattern(ctx, 1) {}

  LogicalResult
  deviceAwareMatchAndRewrite(MO::MutableLoadOp loadOp,
                             DeviceAwareRewriter &rewriter) const override {
    auto loc = loadOp.getLoc();

    auto inChain = loadOp.getInChain();

    auto storeOp = dyn_cast_if_present<MutableStoreOp>(inChain.getDefiningOp());

    if (!inChain.hasOneUse()) {
      return rewriter.notifyMatchFailure(
          loc, "load elision is possible only when it has exclusive access to "
               "its input chain");
    }

    if (!storeOp)
      return rewriter.notifyMatchFailure(
          loc, "input chain not produced by a mo.mutable.store op");

    if (storeOp.getInBuffer() != loadOp.getInBuffer())
      return rewriter.notifyMatchFailure(
          loc, "preceding store op does not operate on the same mo.buffer");

    rewriter.replaceAllUsesWith(loadOp.getOutTensor(), storeOp.getInTensor());
    rewriter.replaceAllUsesWith(loadOp.getOutChain(), storeOp.getOutChain());

    rewriter.eraseOp(loadOp);

    return success();
  }
};

struct EliminateRedundantStores
    : public DeviceAwareRewritePattern<OpRewritePattern, MO::MutableStoreOp> {

  EliminateRedundantStores(MLIRContext *ctx)
      : DeviceAwareRewritePattern(ctx, 1) {}

  LogicalResult
  deviceAwareMatchAndRewrite(MO::MutableStoreOp currStoreOp,
                             DeviceAwareRewriter &rewriter) const override {
    auto loc = currStoreOp.getLoc();

    auto outChain = currStoreOp.getOutChain();

    if (outChain.use_empty())
      return rewriter.notifyMatchFailure(loc, "no proceeding store op");

    if (!outChain.hasOneUse()) {
      return rewriter.notifyMatchFailure(
          loc, "store elision is supported only when the output chain has "
               "exactly one use");
    }

    auto nextStoreOp = dyn_cast<MutableStoreOp>(*outChain.user_begin());

    if (!nextStoreOp)
      return rewriter.notifyMatchFailure(
          loc, "consumer of output chain is not another store op");

    if (currStoreOp.getInBuffer() != nextStoreOp.getInBuffer())
      return rewriter.notifyMatchFailure(
          loc, "following store op does not operate on same mo.buffer");

    rewriter.replaceAllUsesWith(currStoreOp.getOutChain(),
                                currStoreOp.getInChain());

    rewriter.eraseOp(currStoreOp);

    return success();
  }
};

} // namespace

struct ElideRedundantMutableOps
    : public impl::ElideRedundantMutableOpsBase<ElideRedundantMutableOps> {
  using ElideRedundantMutableOpsBase::ElideRedundantMutableOpsBase;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    auto graphOp = getOperation();
    MLIRContext *ctx = graphOp->getContext();
    OpBuilder builder{ctx};

    RewritePatternSet patterns{ctx};

    patterns.add<EliminateRedundantLoads, EliminateRedundantStores>(ctx);

    if (failed(applyPatternsGreedily(getOperation(), std::move(patterns))))
      return signalPassFailure();
  }
};

} // namespace M::MO

#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/Analysis/ParametricTopologyAnalysis.h"

#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOInterfaces.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOTypes.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/Transforms/MOTransforms.h"

#include "Mojo/KGENDialect/KGENOps.h"

#include "mlir/IR/SymbolTable.h"
#include "llvm/ADT/SetVector.h"
#include "llvm/Support/Debug.h"
#include "llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h"

#define DEBUG_TYPE "hoist-constant-subgraphs-into-parent"

using namespace mlir;

namespace M::MO {
#define GEN_PASS_DEF_HOISTCONSTANTSUBGRAPHSINTOPARENT
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/Transforms/MOTransforms.h.inc"
} // namespace M::MO

using namespace M;
using namespace M::MO;

namespace {

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// HoistConstantSubgraphsIntoParent Pass
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
//
// Hoists ops out of subgraphs into each call site so passes like
// ExecInvariantCodeMotion can move them to the init block. An argument is
// callsite-invariant when every call site passes the same SSA value; ops that
// depend only on such arguments are hoisted, and the values they feed to the
// rest of the subgraph become new subgraph arguments.
//
// Subgraphs are processed callees first. Only the acyclic portion of the call
// graph is handled; cycles and disconnected components are ignored.
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

enum class ConstLattice {
  NonConst, // Not constant-derived
  Const     // Constant-derived
};

struct LatticeState {

  // A block argument (graph input constness) or an op (constness of all its
  // results).
  using ProgramPoint = llvm::PointerUnion<BlockArgument, Operation *>;

  ProgramPoint getKey(Value v) const {
    if (auto arg = dyn_cast<BlockArgument>(v))
      return arg;
    return v.getDefiningOp();
  }

  ConstLattice query(Value v) const {
    return state.lookup_or(getKey(v), ConstLattice::NonConst);
  }

  ConstLattice query(Operation *v) const {
    return state.lookup_or(v, ConstLattice::NonConst);
  }

  void set(Value v, ConstLattice l) { state[getKey(v)] = l; }

  void set(Operation *v, ConstLattice l) { state[v] = l; }

  bool update(Operation *v, ConstLattice l) {
    auto oldValue = query(v);
    if (oldValue != l) {
      set(v, l);
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  llvm::DenseMap<ProgramPoint, ConstLattice> state;
};

struct HoistConstantSubgraphsIntoParentPass
    : public M::MO::impl::HoistConstantSubgraphsIntoParentBase<
          HoistConstantSubgraphsIntoParentPass> {
  using HoistConstantSubgraphsIntoParentBase::
      HoistConstantSubgraphsIntoParentBase;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    ModuleOp moduleOp = getOperation();
    LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "Starting pass\n");

    llvm::DenseMap<GraphOp, SmallVector<CallOp>> graphToCallsites;
    SmallVector<GraphOp> sortedGraphs;

    buildCallGraphAndSortGraphs(moduleOp, graphToCallsites, sortedGraphs);

    for (GraphOp graphOp : sortedGraphs) {
      auto &callsites = graphToCallsites[graphOp];
      [[maybe_unused]] StringRef graphName = graphOp.getName();

      if (callsites.empty()) {
        LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "Skipping graph with no callsites: "
                                << graphName << "\n");
        continue;
      }

      LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "Processing graph: " << graphName << " with "
                              << callsites.size() << " callsites\n");

      processGraph(graphOp, callsites);
    }
  }

private:
  void buildCallGraphAndSortGraphs(
      ModuleOp module,
      llvm::DenseMap<GraphOp, SmallVector<CallOp>> &graphToCallsites,
      SmallVector<GraphOp> &sortedGraphs) {

    llvm::DenseMap<StringRef, GraphOp> symbolToGraphOp;
    // Caller -> callees.
    llvm::DenseMap<GraphOp, llvm::SetVector<GraphOp>> callGraph;

    SmallVector<GraphOp> graphs;
    SmallVector<GraphOp> entryPoints;

    for (GraphOp graphOp : module.getOps<GraphOp>()) {
      StringRef name = graphOp.getName();
      symbolToGraphOp[name] = graphOp;
      graphs.push_back(graphOp);

      if (!graphOp.getIsSubgraph())
        entryPoints.push_back(graphOp);

      LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "Found graph: " << name << "\n");
    }

    module.walk([&](CallOp callOp) {
      StringRef calleeName = callOp.getCallee();
      auto it = symbolToGraphOp.find(calleeName);
      if (it == symbolToGraphOp.end()) {
        callOp.emitError() << "Could not find callee graph named '"
                           << calleeName << "'";
        signalPassFailure();
        return;
      }

      GraphOp callee = it->second;
      graphToCallsites[callee].push_back(callOp);

      GraphOp parentGraph = callOp->getParentOfType<GraphOp>();
      if (!parentGraph) {
        callOp.emitError() << "Call op must be contained within a GraphOp";
        signalPassFailure();
        return;
      }

      callGraph[parentGraph].insert(callee);

      LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "Found callsite for graph: " << calleeName
                              << " at " << callOp.getLoc() << "\n");
    });

    LLVM_DEBUG({
      llvm::dbgs() << "Entry points in call graph:\n";
      for (GraphOp entry : entryPoints)
        llvm::dbgs() << "  " << entry.getName() << "\n";
    });

    llvm::DenseSet<GraphOp> visited;

    std::function<void(GraphOp)> dfs = [&](GraphOp node) {
      if (!visited.insert(node).second)
        return;

      if (auto it = callGraph.find(node); it != callGraph.end())
        llvm::for_each(it->second, dfs);

      sortedGraphs.push_back(node);
    };

    for (GraphOp entry : entryPoints)
      dfs(entry);

    std::reverse(sortedGraphs.begin(), sortedGraphs.end());

    LLVM_DEBUG({
      llvm::dbgs() << "Processing graphs in order:\n";
      for (GraphOp g : sortedGraphs)
        llvm::dbgs() << "  " << g.getName() << "\n";
    });
  }

  void processGraph(GraphOp graphOp, ArrayRef<CallOp> callsites) {
    unsigned numArgs = graphOp.getBody().getArguments().size();
    if (numArgs == 0) {
      LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "Graph has no arguments, skipping\n");
      return;
    }

    llvm::BitVector effectiveInvariantArgMask =
        computeEffectiveInvariantArgMask(graphOp, callsites);

    if (!effectiveInvariantArgMask.any()) {
      LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "No effectively invariant arguments found for "
                              << graphOp.getName() << "\n");
      return;
    }

    LatticeState lattice;
    performDataflowAnalysis(graphOp, effectiveInvariantArgMask, lattice);

    llvm::SmallSetVector<Operation *, 16> constantOps;
    SetVector<Value> boundaryValues;
    llvm::BitVector preservedArgs = effectiveInvariantArgMask;
    preservedArgs.flip(); // Non-invariant args are always preserved.
    SmallVector<Operation *> sortedConstantOps;

    findConstantOpsAndBoundaryValues(
        graphOp, lattice, effectiveInvariantArgMask, constantOps,
        boundaryValues, preservedArgs, sortedConstantOps);

    if (boundaryValues.empty()) {
      LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "No boundary values to hoist for "
                              << graphOp.getName() << "\n");
      return;
    }

    auto newCallsites = hoistConstantOperations(
        graphOp, callsites, preservedArgs, effectiveInvariantArgMask,
        constantOps, boundaryValues, sortedConstantOps);

    updateSubgraphDefinition(graphOp, preservedArgs, boundaryValues,
                             sortedConstantOps);

    moveChainsToTheEnd(graphOp, newCallsites);
  }

  void moveChainsToTheEnd(GraphOp subgraphGraphOp, ArrayRef<CallOp> callsites) {
    SmallVector<uint64_t> argumentsToErase;
    auto block = subgraphGraphOp.getBodyBlock();
    // Collect first: inserting an argument can reallocate the block's argument
    // list, which would leave an iterator over it dangling.
    SmallVector<BlockArgument> chainArgs;
    for (BlockArgument arg : block->getArguments())
      if (isa<ChainType>(arg.getType()))
        chainArgs.push_back(arg);

    for (BlockArgument arg : chainArgs) {
      auto newArg = block->insertArgument(block->getNumArguments(),
                                          arg.getType(), arg.getLoc());
      arg.replaceAllUsesWith(newArg);
      argumentsToErase.push_back(arg.getArgNumber());
    }

    for (uint64_t idx : llvm::reverse(argumentsToErase))
      block->eraseArgument(idx);

    synchronizeMetadataUpdates(subgraphGraphOp);

    for (CallOp callOp : callsites) {
      OpBuilder builder(callOp);
      SmallVector<Value> newOperands;
      SmallVector<Value> chains;
      for (auto &&operand : callOp->getOperands()) {
        if (isa<ChainType>(operand.getType()))
          chains.push_back(operand);
        else
          newOperands.push_back(operand);
      }
      newOperands.insert(newOperands.end(), chains.begin(), chains.end());

      auto newCallOp = CallOp::create(
          builder, callOp->getLoc(), callOp->getResultTypes(), newOperands,
          callOp.getCalleeAttr(), callOp.getPrefixAttr(),
          /*outputParamDecls=*/{},
          /*arg_attrs=*/{},
          /*res_attrs=*/{});
      callOp->replaceAllUsesWith(newCallOp.getResults());
      callOp->erase();
    }
  }

  llvm::BitVector computeEffectiveInvariantArgMask(GraphOp graphOp,
                                                   ArrayRef<CallOp> callsites) {
    unsigned numArgs = graphOp.getBody().getArguments().size();
    if (numArgs == 0)
      return llvm::BitVector();

    llvm::BitVector effectiveInvariantMask(numArgs, false);

    assert(!callsites.empty() && "Callsites should not be empty here.");

    for (unsigned i = 0; i < numArgs; ++i) {
      Value firstOperandValue = callsites[0]->getOperand(i);
      bool allSameValue = true;
      for (size_t cIdx = 1; cIdx < callsites.size(); ++cIdx) {
        if (callsites[cIdx]->getOperand(i) != firstOperandValue) {
          allSameValue = false;
          break;
        }
      }

      if (allSameValue && callsites.size() > 1) {
        effectiveInvariantMask[i] = true;
        LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs()
                   << "Arg " << i
                   << " is callsite-invariant (all same parent value: "
                   << firstOperandValue << ").\n");
      } else {
        effectiveInvariantMask[i] = false;
        LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs()
                   << "Arg " << i << " is NOT callsite-invariant.\n");
      }
    }

    LLVM_DEBUG({
      llvm::dbgs() << "Callsite-invariant arguments mask for graph "
                   << graphOp.getName() << ": ";
      for (unsigned i : effectiveInvariantMask.set_bits())
        llvm::dbgs() << i << " ";
      llvm::dbgs() << "\n";
    });

    return effectiveInvariantMask;
  }

  void performDataflowAnalysis(GraphOp graphOp,
                               const llvm::BitVector &effectiveInvariantArgMask,
                               LatticeState &lattice) {
    ParametricTopologyAnalysis topological(graphOp);

    auto allInputsConstant = [&](Operation *op) {
      return topological.forEachProvider(op, [&](Operation *input) {
        if (input == graphOp)
          return true;
        return lattice.query(input) == ConstLattice::Const;
      }) && llvm::all_of(op->getOperands(), [&](Value v) {
               return lattice.query(v) == ConstLattice::Const;
             });
    };

    Block *body = graphOp.getBodyBlock();
    SmallVector<Operation *> worklist;

    for (auto [idx, arg] : llvm::enumerate(body->getArguments())) {
      lattice.set(arg, effectiveInvariantArgMask[idx] ? ConstLattice::Const
                                                      : ConstLattice::NonConst);
    }

    for (Operation &op : body->without_terminator())
      worklist.push_back(&op);

    while (!worklist.empty()) {
      Operation *op = worklist.back();
      worklist.pop_back();

      bool allOperandsConst =
          (op->getNumOperands() > 0 || isa<KGEN::ParamDeclareOp>(op)) &&
          allInputsConstant(op);

      ConstLattice newState =
          allOperandsConst ? ConstLattice::Const : ConstLattice::NonConst;

      if (lattice.update(op, newState)) {
        topological.forEachUser(op, [&](Operation *user) {
          if (!user->hasTrait<OpTrait::IsTerminator>() &&
              !llvm::is_contained(worklist, user))
            worklist.push_back(user);

          return true;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // Boundary values are invariant-derived values used by non-hoisted ops.
  void findConstantOpsAndBoundaryValues(
      GraphOp graphOp, const LatticeState &lattice,
      const llvm::BitVector &effectiveInvariantArgMask,
      llvm::SmallSetVector<Operation *, 16> &constantOps,
      SetVector<Value> &boundaryValues, llvm::BitVector &preservedArgs,
      SmallVector<Operation *> &sortedConstantOps) {

    Block *body = graphOp.getBodyBlock();

    for (Operation &op : body->without_terminator()) {
      if (lattice.query(&op) == ConstLattice::Const)
        constantOps.insert(&op);
    }

    // An invariant argument used by a non-hoisted op must be preserved.
    for (unsigned i : effectiveInvariantArgMask.set_bits()) {
      BlockArgument arg = body->getArgument(i);

      for (Operation *user : arg.getUsers()) {
        if (!constantOps.contains(user)) {
          preservedArgs[i] = true;
          LLVM_DEBUG(
              llvm::dbgs()
              << "Arg " << i
              << " is callsite-invariant but used by non-invariant-derived op: "
              << *user << ", keeping it\n");
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    LLVM_DEBUG({
      llvm::dbgs() << "Arguments to preserve: ";
      for (unsigned i : preservedArgs.set_bits())
        llvm::dbgs() << i << " ";
      llvm::dbgs() << "\n";
    });

    sortedConstantOps.reserve(constantOps.size());
    llvm::DenseSet<Operation *> visited;

    std::function<void(Operation *)> visitOp = [&](Operation *op) {
      if (visited.contains(op))
        return;

      for (Value operand : op->getOperands()) {
        if (Operation *defOp = operand.getDefiningOp()) {
          if (constantOps.contains(defOp))
            visitOp(defOp);
        }
      }

      visited.insert(op);
      sortedConstantOps.push_back(op);
    };

    for (Operation *op : constantOps) {
      if (!visited.contains(op))
        visitOp(op);
    }

    LLVM_DEBUG({
      llvm::dbgs() << "Invariant-derived ops in topological order:\n";
      for (Operation *op : sortedConstantOps)
        llvm::dbgs() << "  " << *op << "\n";
    });

    for (Operation *op : constantOps) {
      for (Value result : op->getResults()) {
        for (Operation *user : result.getUsers()) {
          if (!constantOps.contains(user) &&
              !user->hasTrait<OpTrait::IsTerminator>()) {
            boundaryValues.insert(result);
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    LLVM_DEBUG({
      llvm::dbgs() << "Found " << constantOps.size()
                   << " invariant-derived ops and " << boundaryValues.size()
                   << " boundary values\n";

      llvm::dbgs() << "Boundary values: ";
      for (Value boundaryVal : boundaryValues)
        llvm::dbgs() << boundaryVal << "\n";

      llvm::dbgs() << "\n";
    });
  }

  SmallVector<CallOp> hoistConstantOperations(
      GraphOp subgraphGraphOp, ArrayRef<CallOp> callsites,
      const llvm::BitVector &preservedArgs,
      const llvm::BitVector &effectiveInvariantArgMask,
      const llvm::SmallSetVector<Operation *, 16> &constantOps,
      const SetVector<Value> &boundaryValues,
      const SmallVector<Operation *> &sortedConstantOps) {

    Block *body = subgraphGraphOp.getBodyBlock();
    KGEN::ParameterUseDefGraph subgraphParamUseDefGraph(
        subgraphGraphOp.getBody());
    KGEN::ParameterCollector::Analysis analysisCache;
    subgraphParamUseDefGraph.calculate(analysisCache);
    DenseMap<StringAttr, KGEN::ParamDeclaration> &subgraphDecls =
        subgraphParamUseDefGraph.decls;
    llvm::SetVector<StringAttr> subgraphDeclNames;
    subgraphDeclNames.insert_range(
        llvm::make_first_range(llvm::make_filter_range(
            subgraphDecls,
            [&](const std::pair<StringAttr, KGEN::ParamDeclaration> &decl) {
              return decl.second.declOp != subgraphGraphOp;
            })));

    SmallVector<CallOp> newCallSites;
    for (CallOp callOp : callsites) {
      OpBuilder builder(callOp);
      IRMapping valueMapping;
      GraphOp parentGraphOp = callOp->getParentOfType<MO::GraphOp>();
      Region &parentGraphRegion = parentGraphOp.getBody();
      KGEN::AttrTypeMangler::Cache manglerCache;
      KGEN::AttrTypeMangler mangler(manglerCache);
      KGEN::ParameterUseDefGraph paramGraph(parentGraphRegion);
      paramGraph.calculate(analysisCache);
      KGEN::NameUniquer uniquer(paramGraph, paramGraph);
      mangler.populate(builder, uniquer, subgraphDeclNames, paramGraph);

      assert(parentGraphOp && "expected parent graph op");

      for (unsigned i : effectiveInvariantArgMask.set_bits())
        valueMapping.map(body->getArgument(i), callOp.getOperand(i));

      for (Operation *op : sortedConstantOps) {
        LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs()
                   << "Cloning invariant-derived operation: " << *op << "\n");
        Operation *clonedOp = builder.clone(*op, valueMapping);

        if (auto itf = dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamOpInterface>(*clonedOp)) {
          LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs()
                     << "Processing ParamOpInterface for operation: "
                     << *clonedOp << "\n");
          SmallVector<KGEN::ParamDeclAttr> newDecls;
          itf.walkDeclarations([&](KGEN::ParamDeclAttr decl) {
            LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs()
                       << "Walking declaration: " << decl.getName() << "\n");
            newDecls.push_back(
                mangler.mangleDecl(decl, /*needsMangling=*/true));
          });
          cast<KGEN::ParamOpInterface>(clonedOp).renameDeclarations(newDecls);
          // Register the new declarations in the call scope's param graph.
          for (KGEN::ParamDeclAttr decl : newDecls) {
            LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "Adding declaration to param graph: "
                                    << decl.getName() << "\n");
            paramGraph.decls.try_emplace(
                decl.getName(), KGEN::ParamDeclaration{decl.getType(), clonedOp,
                                                       &parentGraphRegion});
          }
          parentGraphOp.setCounter(parentGraphOp.getCounter() +
                                   newDecls.size());
        }
        LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs()
                   << "Mangling elements in operation: " << *clonedOp << "\n");
        mangler.mangleElementsIn(clonedOp);

        for (unsigned i = 0; i < op->getNumResults(); ++i)
          valueMapping.map(op->getResult(i), clonedOp->getResult(i));
      }

      SmallVector<Value> newCallOperands;

      for (unsigned i : preservedArgs.set_bits())
        newCallOperands.push_back(callOp.getOperand(i));

      for (Value boundaryVal : boundaryValues) {
        Value mappedVal = valueMapping.lookup(boundaryVal);
        newCallOperands.push_back(mappedVal);
      }

      auto newCallOp = CallOp::create(
          builder, callOp.getLoc(), callOp.getResultTypes(), newCallOperands,
          callOp.getCalleeAttr(), callOp.getPrefixAttr(),
          /*outputParamDecls=*/{},
          /*arg_attrs=*/{},
          /*res_attrs=*/{});

      callOp.replaceAllUsesWith(newCallOp.getResults());

      LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "Replaced call at " << callOp.getLoc()
                              << " with new call\n");

      newCallSites.push_back(newCallOp);
      callOp.erase();
    }

    return newCallSites;
  }

  void
  updateSubgraphDefinition(GraphOp graphOp,
                           const llvm::BitVector &preservedArgs,
                           const SetVector<Value> &boundaryValues,
                           const SmallVector<Operation *> &sortedConstantOps) {

    Block *body = graphOp.getBodyBlock();
    unsigned numArgs = body->getArguments().size();

    // Reverse order for safe erasure; BitVector has no reverse set_bits().
    SmallVector<unsigned> argsToDelete;
    for (int i = numArgs - 1; i >= 0; --i)
      if (!preservedArgs[i])
        argsToDelete.push_back(i);

    unsigned insertionIndex = numArgs;
    for (Value boundaryVal : boundaryValues) {
      BlockArgument newArg = body->insertArgument(
          insertionIndex++, boundaryVal.getType(), graphOp.getLoc());
      boundaryVal.replaceAllUsesWith(newArg);
      LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs()
                 << "Replaced boundary value with new arg " << newArg << "\n");
    }

    for (auto it = sortedConstantOps.rbegin(); it != sortedConstantOps.rend();
         ++it) {
      LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "Erasing constant op: " << **it << "\n");
      (*it)->erase();
    }

    for (unsigned idx : argsToDelete) {
      LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "Erasing non-preserved arg: " << idx << "\n");
      body->eraseArgument(idx);
    }

    synchronizeMetadataUpdates(graphOp);
  }
};

#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/Transforms/MOTransforms.h"

using namespace M;

namespace M::MO {

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_HOISTPARAMETEREXPRESSIONS

#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/Transforms/MOTransforms.h.inc"

namespace {

struct RewriteParamExprTypes : public RewritePattern {
  RewriteParamExprTypes(
      MLIRContext *context,
      llvm::DenseMap<Region *,
                     llvm::DenseMap<KGEN::ParamOperatorAttr, std::string>>
          &&regionToExprToParam)
      : RewritePattern(mlir::Pattern::MatchAnyOpTypeTag(), 1, context),
        regionToExprToParam(regionToExprToParam) {}
  mutable llvm::DenseMap<Region *,
                         llvm::DenseMap<KGEN::ParamOperatorAttr, std::string>>
      regionToExprToParam;

  /// Declares a new parameter for each parameter expression in `ty`'s shape
  /// not yet in `regionToExprToParam`, and records it there. Returns true if
  /// `ty` contains any parameter expression (unknown `?` dims are ignored).
  bool collectComplexParams(DeviceAwareRewriter &rewriter, Operation *op,
                            Type ty) const {
    // Bundle element shapes can carry param-expression dims too.
    if (auto bundleTy = dyn_cast<MO::BundleType>(ty)) {
      bool found = false;
      for (Type elemTy : bundleTy.getElementTypes())
        if (collectComplexParams(rewriter, op, elemTy))
          found = true;
      return found;
    }

    auto graphOp = op->getParentOfType<GraphOp>();

    bool found = false;
    auto tensorTy = dyn_cast<MO::TensorType>(ty);
    if (!tensorTy)
      return false;
    auto shapeAttr = tensorTy.getShape();
    for (TypedAttr dimValue : shapeAttr.getValues()) {
      auto paramOp = dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamOperatorAttr>(dimValue);
      if (!paramOp)
        continue;
      found = true;
      Region *parentRegion = op->getParentRegion();
      auto &map = regionToExprToParam[parentRegion];
      if (auto [it, inserted] = map.insert({paramOp, {}}); inserted) {
        std::string exprName = graphOp.getNewParamName("param_expr_");
        it->second = exprName;
        auto dimType = ShapeAttr::getDimType(op->getContext());
        rewriter.create<KGEN::ParamDeclareOp>(
            op->getLoc(), KGEN::ParamDeclAttr::get(exprName, dimType), paramOp);
      }
    }
    return found;
  }

  LogicalResult matchAndRewrite(Operation *op,
                                PatternRewriter &origRewriter) const override {
    if (isa<KGEN::ParamDeclareOp>(op))
      return origRewriter.notifyMatchFailure(op, "skip parameter declarations");
    // Skip control-flow ops whose types are pinned by the graph signature or
    // whose regions carry non-tensor block arguments. Exceptions:
    //  - mo.call result types can be freely rewritten (consumers pick them up
    //    via the output rebinds).
    //  - mo.if has no region arguments and its results aren't the signature,
    //    so it is aliased like any op. Otherwise an un-aliased `ParamExpr`
    //    reaches MOGG lowering and asserts in `getTensorDynamicDimensions`.
    // TODO(GEX-3580): Revisit whether mo.call should implement
    // MOControlOpInterface at all; dropping it would remove that exception.
    if (isa<MO::MOControlOpInterface>(op) && !isa<MO::CallOp, MO::IfOp>(op))
      return origRewriter.notifyMatchFailure(op, "skip control flow");

    // mo.parallel bodies must stay kernel-only (no rebinds). The parallel op
    // is rewritten as a whole, and `recursivelyReplaceElementsIn` updates its
    // body types.
    if (op->getParentOfType<MO::ParallelOp>())
      return origRewriter.notifyMatchFailure(op, "skip parallel body ops");

    DeviceAwareRewriter rewriter(op, origRewriter);

    llvm::DenseSet<Value> rewriteInputs;
    bool containsComplexExprs = false;
    for (auto [operand, ty] :
         llvm::zip(op->getOperands(), op->getOperandTypes())) {
      bool foundComplex = collectComplexParams(rewriter, op, ty);
      // Bundle operands get no input rebind (`MO::RebindOp` is tensor-only);
      // `AttrTypeReplacer` rewrites their element types in place.
      if (foundComplex && isa<MO::TensorType>(ty)) {
        containsComplexExprs = true;
        rewriteInputs.insert(operand);
      }
    }
    for (Type resType : op->getResultTypes())
      if (collectComplexParams(rewriter, op, resType))
        containsComplexExprs = true;

    // Also scan region block-arg and nested result types, for e.g. a
    // `mo.parallel` whose outer types are alias-clean but whose body still
    // references the un-aliased form.
    op->walk([&](Block *block) {
      for (BlockArgument arg : block->getArguments())
        if (collectComplexParams(rewriter, op, arg.getType()))
          containsComplexExprs = true;
    });
    op->walk([&](Operation *nested) {
      if (nested == op)
        return;
      for (Type ty : nested->getResultTypes())
        if (collectComplexParams(rewriter, op, ty))
          containsComplexExprs = true;
    });

    if (!containsComplexExprs)
      return rewriter.notifyMatchFailure(op, "no complex expressions");

    mlir::AttrTypeReplacer replacer;
    replacer.addReplacement([&](KGEN::ParamOperatorAttr paramOp) -> Attribute {
      Region *parentRegion = op->getParentRegion();
      if (auto it = regionToExprToParam[parentRegion].find(paramOp);
          it != regionToExprToParam[parentRegion].end()) {
        auto dimType = ShapeAttr::getDimType(op->getContext());
        return KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr::get(it->second, dimType);
      }
      return paramOp;
    });

    llvm::SmallVector<Type> resTypes(op->getResultTypes());

    rewriter.setInsertionPoint(op);

    llvm::DenseMap<Value, Value> inputRemap;
    for (Value inp : rewriteInputs) {
      inputRemap[inp] = rewriter.create<MO::RebindOp>(
          op->getLoc(), replacer.replace(inp.getType()), inp);
    }

    replacer.recursivelyReplaceElementsIn(op, /*replaceAttrs=*/true,
                                          /*replaceLocs=*/true,
                                          /*replaceTypes=*/true);

    // Rebind outputs to original types.
    rewriter.setInsertionPointAfter(op);
    for (auto [res, ty] : llvm::zip(op->getResults(), resTypes)) {
      if (isa<MO::TensorType>(ty)) {
        auto rebind = rewriter.create<MO::RebindOp>(op->getLoc(), ty, res);
        rewriter.replaceAllUsesExcept(res, rebind, rebind);
      }
    }

    // `mo.yield` operand types must equal the rewritten `mo.if` result types,
    // but `recursivelyReplaceElementsIn` only rewrites values produced inside
    // the regions. Rebind yields of outer values (or differently canonicalized
    // expressions) to the result type.
    if (auto ifOp = dyn_cast<MO::IfOp>(op)) {
      TypeRange resultTys = ifOp.getResultTypes();
      for (Region *region : {&ifOp.getThenRegion(), &ifOp.getElseRegion()}) {
        auto yieldOp = cast<MO::YieldOp>(region->front().getTerminator());
        rewriter.setInsertionPoint(yieldOp);
        llvm::SmallVector<Value> newYields(yieldOp.getOperands().begin(),
                                           yieldOp.getOperands().end());
        bool changed = false;
        for (auto [i, ty] : llvm::enumerate(resultTys)) {
          if (isa<MO::TensorType>(ty) && newYields[i].getType() != ty) {
            newYields[i] = rewriter.create<MO::RebindOp>(yieldOp.getLoc(), ty,
                                                         newYields[i]);
            changed = true;
          }
        }
        if (changed)
          rewriter.modifyOpInPlace(yieldOp,
                                   [&] { yieldOp->setOperands(newYields); });
      }
    }

    llvm::SmallVector<Value> inputs;
    for (Value inp : op->getOperands()) {
      if (auto it = inputRemap.find(inp); it != inputRemap.end())
        inputs.push_back(it->second);
      else
        inputs.push_back(inp);
    }
    rewriter.modifyOpInPlace(op, [&] { op->setOperands(inputs); });

    return LogicalResult::success();
  }
};

struct HoistParameterExpressionsPass
    : public M::MO::impl::HoistParameterExpressionsBase<
          HoistParameterExpressionsPass> {
  using HoistParameterExpressionsBase::HoistParameterExpressionsBase;

  /// Maps each `<expr>` in `kgen.param.declare name = <expr>` to `name`, per
  /// region.
  static llvm::DenseMap<Region *,
                        llvm::DenseMap<KGEN::ParamOperatorAttr, std::string>>
  collectExistingExprToParamMap(GraphOp graphOp) {
    llvm::DenseMap<Region *,
                   llvm::DenseMap<KGEN::ParamOperatorAttr, std::string>>
        regionToExprToParam;
    graphOp.walk([&](KGEN::ParamDeclareOp paramDeclOp) {
      Region *parentRegion = paramDeclOp->getParentRegion();
      auto &map = regionToExprToParam[parentRegion];
      if (auto paramExpr =
              dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamOperatorAttr>(paramDeclOp.getValue())) {
        map.insert({paramExpr, paramDeclOp.getName().str()});
      }
    });
    return regionToExprToParam;
  }

  void runOnOperation() override {
    // Replaces each KGEN::ParamOperatorAttr in tensor types with a reference to
    // a new alias parameter declared to it, rebinding inputs and outputs.
    auto *ctx = &getContext();

    RewritePatternSet patterns{ctx};
    patterns.add<RewriteParamExprTypes>(
        ctx, collectExistingExprToParamMap(getOperation()));
    patterns.add<FoldConsecutiveRebinds>(ctx);
    // Folds the identity rebinds introduced here without a separate
    // canonicalization pass.
    RebindOp::getCanonicalizationPatterns(patterns, ctx);
    if (failed(applyPatternsGreedily(getOperation(), std::move(patterns))))
      return signalPassFailure();
  }
};

#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOAttrs.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOInterfaces.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/Transforms/MOTransforms.h"

namespace M::MO {

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_INFERLAYOUTS
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/Transforms/MOTransforms.h.inc"

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// InferLayouts pass.
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

struct InferLayoutPass : public impl::InferLayoutsBase<InferLayoutPass> {
  /// Maps `value` to `layout`, emitting an error on `op` (the constraint's
  /// source) if `value` is already mapped to a different layout. A no-op when
  /// `value`'s type already has a layout, so the pass is idempotent.
  LogicalResult addLayoutConstraint(Operation *op, TensorValue value,
                                    LayoutAttr layout) {
    if (value.getType().getLayoutAttr())
      return success();

    auto [iter, inserted] = valueToInferredLayout.insert({value, layout});
    if (!inserted && iter->getSecond() != layout) {
      return op->emitError()
             << "attempting to constrain value to layout: " << layout
             << " when it's already constrained to layout: "
             << iter->getSecond();
    }

    return success();
  }

  llvm::StringRef getConvFilterLayout(size_t rank) {
    switch (rank) {
    case 4:
      return "FCRS";
    case 5:
      return "FCQRS";
    default:
      llvm_unreachable("Only able to handle convs up to conv1-3d");
    }
  }

  llvm::StringRef getConvInputLayout(size_t rank) {
    switch (rank) {
    case 4:
      return "NHWC";
    case 5:
      return "NDHWC";
    default:
      llvm_unreachable("Only able to handle convs up to conv1-3d");
    }
  }

  llvm::StringRef getConvTransposeFilterLayout(size_t rank) {
    switch (rank) {
    case 4:
      return "RSFC";
    case 5:
      return "QRSFC";
    default:
      llvm_unreachable("Only able to handle convTranspose 2-3d");
    }
  }

  bool isSupportedConv(size_t inputRank, size_t filterRank) {
    return (inputRank == 4 && filterRank == 4) ||
           (inputRank == 5 && filterRank == 5);
  }

  /// Seeds `valueToInferredLayout` from ops with direct layout constraints
  /// (e.g. `mo.conv` requires an `NHWC` input). Fails on conflicting
  /// constraints.
  LogicalResult addSeedingConstraints() {
    LayoutAttr matmulWeightsLayout = LayoutAttr::get(ctx, "KN");

    WalkResult walkResult =
        graphOp.walk([&](Operation *op) {
          if (auto convOp = dyn_cast<ConvOp>(op)) {
            TensorValue input = convOp.getInput();
            TensorValue filter = convOp.getFilter();
            auto inputRank = input.getType().getRank();
            auto filterRank = filter.getType().getRank();

            if (isSupportedConv(inputRank, filterRank)) {
              auto convInputLayout = LayoutAttr::get(
                  ctx, getConvInputLayout(input.getType().getRank()));
              auto convFilterLayout = LayoutAttr::get(
                  ctx, getConvFilterLayout(filter.getType().getRank()));

              if (failed(addLayoutConstraint(op, input, convInputLayout)) ||
                  failed(addLayoutConstraint(op, filter, convFilterLayout)))
                return WalkResult::interrupt();
            } else {
              op->emitError() << "Only support 2D and 3D layout for ConvOp.\n";
              return WalkResult::interrupt();
            }
          } else if (auto convTransposeOp = dyn_cast<ConvTransposeOp>(op)) {
            TensorValue input = convTransposeOp.getInput();
            TensorValue filter = convTransposeOp.getFilter();
            auto inputRank = input.getType().getRank();
            auto filterRank = filter.getType().getRank();

            if (isSupportedConv(inputRank, filterRank)) {
              // ConvTranspose input uses the same layouts as conv.
              auto convTransposeInputLayout = LayoutAttr::get(
                  ctx, getConvInputLayout(input.getType().getRank()));
              auto convTransposeFilterLayout = LayoutAttr::get(
                  ctx,
                  getConvTransposeFilterLayout(filter.getType().getRank()));

              if (failed(addLayoutConstraint(op, input,
                                             convTransposeInputLayout)) ||
                  failed(addLayoutConstraint(op, filter,
                                             convTransposeFilterLayout)))
                return WalkResult::interrupt();
            } else {
              op->emitError()
                  << "Only support 2D and 3D layout for ConvTransposeOp.\n";
              return WalkResult::interrupt();
            }
          } else if (auto matmulOp = dyn_cast<MatmulOp>(op)) {
            TensorValue weights = matmulOp.getTensorB();
            if (failed(addLayoutConstraint(op, weights, matmulWeightsLayout)))
              return WalkResult::interrupt();
          }

          return WalkResult::advance();
        });
    return failure(walkResult.wasInterrupted());
  }

  /// Propagate layout through ops (e.g., from input to output or vice-versa for
  /// elementwise ops, which requires same layouts for all inputs and outputs).
  LogicalResult propagateLayoutThroughOps() {
    SmallVector<TensorValue> worklist;
    DenseSet<TensorValue> worklistHistory;

    auto tryPushOntoWorklist = [&](TensorValue value) {
      if (auto [_, inserted] = worklistHistory.insert(value); inserted)
        worklist.push_back(value);
    };
    for (auto [value, _] : valueToInferredLayout)
      tryPushOntoWorklist(value);

    while (!worklist.empty()) {
      TensorValue value = worklist.pop_back_val();
      LayoutAttr layout = valueToInferredLayout.at(value);

      SmallVector<Operation *> affectedOps(value.getUsers());
      if (Operation *definingOp = value.getDefiningOp(); definingOp)
        affectedOps.push_back(definingOp);

      for (Operation *op : affectedOps) {
        // Could also propagate through ops like transpose.
        SmallVector<Value> valsToPropagate = [](Operation *op) {
          SmallVector<Value> results;
          if (isa<MO::GuardOp>(op)) {
            llvm::append_range(results, op->getOperands().drop_front());
            llvm::append_range(results, op->getResults());
          } else if (isa<MO::TransferOp>(op) ||
                     op->hasTrait<mlir::OpTrait::SameOperandsAndResultType>()) {
            llvm::append_range(results, op->getOperands());
            llvm::append_range(results, op->getResults());
          }
          return results;
        }(op);

        for (Value val : valsToPropagate) {
          if (auto tensorVal = dyn_cast<TensorValue>(val)) {
            if (failed(addLayoutConstraint(op, tensorVal, layout)))
              return failure();
            tryPushOntoWorklist(tensorVal);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return success();
  }

  void assignInferredLayoutsToTypes() {
    for (auto [value, layout] : valueToInferredLayout)
      value.setType(value.getType().cloneWith(layout));

    // Graph inputs or outputs may have new layouts.
    synchronizeMetadataUpdates(graphOp);
  }

  void runOnOperation() override {
    this->ctx = &getContext();
    this->graphOp = getOperation();

    if (failed(addSeedingConstraints()))
      return signalPassFailure();

    // This is needed to tame the MO type system.
    if (failed(propagateLayoutThroughOps()))
      return signalPassFailure();

    assignInferredLayoutsToTypes();

    valueToInferredLayout.clear();
    this->graphOp = {};
  }

  MLIRContext *ctx;
  GraphOp graphOp;
  // Only values reached by inference; most tensors are absent.
  DenseMap<TensorValue, LayoutAttr> valueToInferredLayout;
};

} // namespace M::MO

#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/PackingShapeFunctions.h"

#include "mlir/Pass/PassManager.h"

#define DEBUG_TYPE "invoke-shape-packing-funcs"

namespace M::MO {

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_INVOKESHAPEPACKINGFUNCTIONS
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/Transforms/MOTransforms.h.inc"

using ShapeInferenceFunction =
    llvm::function_ref<std::optional<SmallVector<int64_t>>(InvokeShapeFuncOp,
                                                           TargetInfoAttr)>;

static ShapeInferenceFunction
getShapeInferencePackingFunction(InvokeShapeFuncOp invoke) {
  if (invoke.getShapeFuncName() == "pack_matmul_b_shape_func")
    return materializePackMatmulShapeFunc;
  if (invoke.getShapeFuncName() == "pack_conv_filter_shape")
    return materializePackConvFilterShape;
  if (invoke.getShapeFuncName() == "pack_conv_transpose_filter_shape")
    return materializePackConvTransposeFilterShape;
  return nullptr;
}

static void initLLVM() {
  static std::once_flag flag;

  std::call_once(flag, []() { llvm::InitializeNativeTarget(); });
}

// Reads target info from the graph's `target` attribute (so tests are
// host-independent), or from the current host when `useHostSystem` is set.
static ErrorOr<TargetInfoAttr> getTargetInfoForHost(GraphOp graph,
                                                    bool useHostSystem) {
  if (!useHostSystem) {
    if (auto target = graph->getAttrOfType<TargetInfoAttr>("target"))
      return target;
    return Error("unable to extract target information from graph");
  }

  MLIRContext *ctx = graph.getContext();

  initLLVM();
  return M::getTargetInfoFor(ctx, llvm::sys::getDefaultTargetTriple(),
                             llvm::sys::getHostCPUName(),
                             M::getHostCPUFeatures());
}

// Adds runtime assertions that the C++-computed shapes match the Mojo shape
// functions, by renaming each mo.invoke_shape_func output parameter and
// asserting it equals the computed one.
//
// clang-format off
//
//    // Newly computed dim
//    kgen.param.declare F = <1>
//
//    // Original shape function call
//    mo.invoke_shape_func['foo']<() -> F>()
//
//    ==>
//
//    kgen.param.declare F = <1>
//
//    // Shape function with updated output parameter
//    mo.invoke_shape_func['foo']<() -> F1>()
//
//    // Assert the new parameter equals the newly computed dim
//    kgen.param.declare var_eq: i1 = <eq(F, F1)>
//    kgen.param.declare assert3: !mo.chain = <apply(:(i1) -> !mo.chain "mo.assert"{message = "..." : !kgen.string}, var_eq)>
//
// clang-format on
static void addSanityChecks(GraphOp graph, InvokeShapeFuncOp invoke,
                            MutableArrayRef<KGEN::ParamDeclareOp> newDecls) {
  SmallVector<ParamBinding> bindings;
  ParamExprBuilder exprBuilder{graph, invoke.getLoc(), &bindings};

  SmallVector<ParamDeclAttr> newOutputParams;
  for (auto [newDecl, oldParam] :
       llvm::zip(newDecls, invoke.getOutputParamDecls())) {

    KGEN::ParamDeclAttr newOutputParam = graph.getNewParamOfType(
        oldParam.getName().strref(), oldParam.getType());
    newOutputParams.push_back(newOutputParam);

    auto outputParamRef = KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr::get(newOutputParam);
    auto newDeclParamRef =
        KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr::get(newDecl.getParamDeclAttr());

    auto outputParamVar = exprBuilder.createVar(outputParamRef);
    auto newDeclParamVar = exprBuilder.createVar(newDeclParamRef);
    exprBuilder.createAssert(
        outputParamVar == newDeclParamVar,
        "shape generated by C++ shape function does not match the Mojo "
        "implementation");
  }

  invoke.setOutputParamDecls(newOutputParams);

  OpBuilder builder(invoke.getContext());
  builder.setInsertionPointAfter(invoke);

  for (auto binding : bindings)
    binding.toOp(invoke.getLoc(), builder);
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// InvokeShapePackingFunctions pass.
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

struct InvokeShapePackingFunctions
    : public impl::InvokeShapePackingFunctionsBase<
          InvokeShapePackingFunctions> {
  using Base::Base;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    GraphOp graph = getOperation();

    ErrorOr<TargetInfoAttr> targetOr =
        getTargetInfoForHost(graph, useHostSystem);

    if (failed(targetOr)) {
      signalPassFailure();
      return;
    }

    TargetInfoAttr targetInfo = targetOr.takeValue();

    graph.walk([&](InvokeShapeFuncOp invoke) {
      ShapeInferenceFunction infer = getShapeInferencePackingFunction(invoke);
      if (!infer)
        return WalkResult::advance();

      std::optional<llvm::SmallVector<int64_t>> maybeInferredShapes =
          infer(invoke, targetInfo);

      if (!maybeInferredShapes) {
        invoke.emitRemark("unable to infer shapes for operation");
        return WalkResult::advance();
      }

      SmallVector<int64_t> inferredShapes = std::move(*maybeInferredShapes);

      ArrayRef<ParamDeclAttr> outputDecls = invoke.getOutputParamDecls();
      if (outputDecls.size() != inferredShapes.size()) {
        invoke.emitError("number of inferred parameters does not match number "
                         "of output parameters");
        return WalkResult::interrupt();
      }

      SmallVector<KGEN::ParamDeclareOp> newDecls;
      newDecls.reserve(outputDecls.size());

      OpBuilder rewriter(invoke);
      for (auto [decl, value] : llvm::zip(outputDecls, inferredShapes)) {
        auto valueAttr = ShapeAttr::getDim(&getContext(), value);
        auto newDecl = KGEN::ParamDeclareOp::create(rewriter, invoke.getLoc(),
                                                    decl, valueAttr);
        newDecls.push_back(newDecl);
      }

      if (sanityCheckShapeFuncs)
        addSanityChecks(graph, invoke, newDecls);
      else
        invoke.erase();

      return WalkResult::advance();
    });
  }
};

} // namespace M::MO

//
// mo-merge-adjacent-parallels
//
// Fuses a producer and consumer `mo.parallel` when the consumer takes one or
// more producer bundle results directly as inputs (strict SSA equality, made
// possible by the upstream `bundle(unbundle(X)...) -> X` fold).
//
// With several parallel producers (e.g. a residual `mo.add` fed by two
// allreduce parallels), the first one in consumer-input order that passes the
// dependence check is merged; the rest may merge in a later iteration.
//
// Mechanics:
//
//   * A shared input's consumer block arg is remapped to the producer's
//     yield operand, skipping the bundle round-trip.
//   * Non-shared consumer inputs get a fresh merged block arg each.
//   * Producer then consumer body ops are cloned into the merged block, and a
//     new `mo.yield` joins the surviving producer yields with the consumer's.
//
// Producer results used only by the consumer are dropped from the merged
// results; otherwise MOGG epilogue fusion stalls on a spurious live output.
//
// Buffer + chain policy (strict, matching allreduce signal buffers):
//
//   * Both chained: buffer lists must be identical and the consumer's in-chain
//     must be the producer's out-chain with no other users. The merged op
//     reuses the producer's buffers and in-chain.
//   * Only one side chained: the merged op inherits that side.
//   * Neither: the merged op is chainless.
//   * Buffer mismatch: leave the pair unmerged.
//
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/Transforms/MOTransforms.h"
#include "mlir/IR/IRMapping.h"
#include "mlir/Pass/Pass.h"
#include "llvm/ADT/DenseSet.h"
#include "llvm/ADT/SmallVector.h"

#define DEBUG_TYPE "merge-adjacent-parallels"

namespace M::MO {

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_MERGEADJACENTPARALLELS
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/Transforms/MOTransforms.h.inc"

} // namespace M::MO

using namespace M;
using namespace M::MO;

namespace {

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Small utilities
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Returns the number of bundle outputs (excluding the trailing chain, if
/// present).
static size_t numBundleResults(ParallelOp op) {
  return op.getNumResults() - (op.hasChain() ? 1 : 0);
}

/// Returns true if \p producer and \p consumer have the same buffer operands
/// in the same order.
static bool buffersMatch(ParallelOp producer, ParallelOp consumer) {
  auto producerBuffers = producer.getBuffers();
  auto consumerBuffers = consumer.getBuffers();
  if (producerBuffers.size() != consumerBuffers.size())
    return false;
  for (auto [producerBuffer, consumerBuffer] :
       llvm::zip(producerBuffers, consumerBuffers))
    if (producerBuffer != consumerBuffer)
      return false;
  return true;
}

/// Returns true if \p root transitively depends on a result of \p target.
static bool dependsOn(Value root, Operation *target) {
  llvm::DenseSet<Value> visited;
  llvm::SmallVector<Value> stack;
  stack.push_back(root);

  while (!stack.empty()) {
    Value value = stack.pop_back_val();
    if (!visited.insert(value).second)
      continue;
    Operation *def = value.getDefiningOp();
    if (!def)
      continue;
    if (def == target)
      return true;
    llvm::append_range(stack, def->getOperands());
  }
  return false;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Candidate discovery
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// `sharedInputs[i] = producerIdx` means consumer input #i is producer result
/// #producerIdx; nullopt means it is carried into the merged op.
struct MergeCandidate {
  ParallelOp producer;
  ParallelOp consumer;
  SmallVector<std::optional<size_t>> sharedInputs;
};

/// Returns true if a non-shared consumer input transitively depends on
/// \p producer, so merging would create a cycle. This rejects an upstream
/// producer when a downstream producer also feeds the consumer.
static bool
nonSharedInputDependsOnProducer(ParallelOp consumer, ParallelOp producer,
                                ArrayRef<std::optional<size_t>> sharedInputs) {
  for (auto [i, input] : llvm::enumerate(consumer.getInputs())) {
    if (sharedInputs[i].has_value())
      continue;
    if (dependsOn(input, producer.getOperation()))
      return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/// Returns the first producer, in consumer-input order, in the same block as
/// \p consumer and with no dependence cycle through it.
static std::optional<MergeCandidate> findMergeCandidate(ParallelOp consumer) {
  // First-seen input order keeps selection deterministic.
  SmallVector<ParallelOp> candidatesInOrder;
  llvm::SmallDenseSet<Operation *> seen;
  for (Value input : consumer.getInputs()) {
    auto prod = dyn_cast_or_null<ParallelOp>(input.getDefiningOp());
    if (!prod || prod.getOperation() == consumer.getOperation())
      continue;
    if (seen.insert(prod.getOperation()).second)
      candidatesInOrder.push_back(prod);
  }

  for (ParallelOp producer : candidatesInOrder) {
    if (producer->getBlock() != consumer->getBlock())
      continue;

    SmallVector<std::optional<size_t>> sharedInputs(
        consumer.getInputs().size());
    for (auto [i, input] : llvm::enumerate(consumer.getInputs()))
      if (input.getDefiningOp() == producer.getOperation())
        sharedInputs[i] = cast<OpResult>(input).getResultNumber();

    if (nonSharedInputDependsOnProducer(consumer, producer, sharedInputs))
      continue;

    return MergeCandidate{producer, consumer, std::move(sharedInputs)};
  }
  return std::nullopt;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Buffer + chain resolution
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

struct BufferChainPlan {
  /// Ordered buffer operand list for the merged op.
  SmallVector<Value> buffers;
  /// In-chain for the merged op (empty = chainless).
  Value inChain;
};

/// Applies the buffer+chain rules from the file header, or returns
/// std::nullopt to reject the candidate. mo.buffer handling can go once
/// GEX-3527 lands.
static std::optional<BufferChainPlan>
resolveBufferChain(const MergeCandidate &candidate) {
  ParallelOp producer = candidate.producer;
  ParallelOp consumer = candidate.consumer;
  BufferChainPlan plan;

  if (producer.hasChain() && consumer.hasChain()) {
    if (!buffersMatch(producer, consumer))
      return std::nullopt;
    if (consumer.getInChain() != producer.getOutChain())
      return std::nullopt;
    if (!producer.getOutChain().hasOneUse())
      return std::nullopt;
    plan.buffers.assign(producer.getBuffers().begin(),
                        producer.getBuffers().end());
    plan.inChain = producer.getInChain();
    return plan;
  }

  if (producer.hasChain()) {
    plan.buffers.assign(producer.getBuffers().begin(),
                        producer.getBuffers().end());
    plan.inChain = producer.getInChain();
    return plan;
  }
  if (consumer.hasChain()) {
    plan.buffers.assign(consumer.getBuffers().begin(),
                        consumer.getBuffers().end());
    plan.inChain = consumer.getInChain();
    return plan;
  }

  return plan; // neither has a chain
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Merge plan
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

struct MergePlan {
  /// Producer inputs, then consumer non-shared inputs.
  SmallVector<Value> mergedInputs;
  /// Per shared consumer input, the producer yield operand to substitute; null
  /// for non-shared inputs.
  SmallVector<Value> consumerSharedYieldOperand;
  /// Per non-shared consumer input, its merged block-arg index.
  SmallVector<size_t> consumerAppendedArgIdx;
  /// Producer bundle results used only by the consumer.
  llvm::BitVector dropProducerYield;
  /// Kept producer bundles, consumer bundles, then optional trailing chain.
  SmallVector<Type> mergedResultTypes;
  /// Per producer bundle, its merged result index, or nullopt if dropped.
  SmallVector<std::optional<size_t>> producerMergedIdx;
  size_t consumerMergedStart = 0;
};

static MergePlan planMerge(const MergeCandidate &candidate,
                           const BufferChainPlan &bufferChain) {
  ParallelOp producer = candidate.producer;
  ParallelOp consumer = candidate.consumer;
  Block &producerBody = producer.getBodyRegion().front();
  auto producerYield = cast<YieldOp>(producerBody.getTerminator());
  size_t producerNumBundles = numBundleResults(producer);
  size_t consumerNumBundles = numBundleResults(consumer);

  MergePlan plan;
  plan.mergedInputs.assign(producer.getInputs().begin(),
                           producer.getInputs().end());

  plan.dropProducerYield.resize(producerNumBundles);
  for (size_t i = 0; i < producerNumBundles; ++i) {
    bool hasExternalUser = false;
    for (Operation *user : producer.getResult(i).getUsers())
      if (user != consumer.getOperation()) {
        hasExternalUser = true;
        break;
      }
    plan.dropProducerYield[i] = !hasExternalUser;
  }

  plan.consumerSharedYieldOperand.assign(consumer.getInputs().size(), Value{});
  plan.consumerAppendedArgIdx.assign(consumer.getInputs().size(), 0);
  // Non-shared inputs follow the producer's bundle args and precede the
  // trailing chain arg, so don't index from producerBody.getNumArguments().
  size_t appendedIdx = producer.getInputs().size();
  for (auto [bi, input] : llvm::enumerate(consumer.getInputs())) {
    if (candidate.sharedInputs[bi].has_value()) {
      plan.consumerSharedYieldOperand[bi] =
          producerYield.getOperand(*candidate.sharedInputs[bi]);
      continue;
    }
    plan.mergedInputs.push_back(input);
    plan.consumerAppendedArgIdx[bi] = appendedIdx++;
  }

  plan.producerMergedIdx.assign(producerNumBundles, std::nullopt);
  for (size_t i = 0; i < producerNumBundles; ++i) {
    if (plan.dropProducerYield[i])
      continue;
    plan.producerMergedIdx[i] = plan.mergedResultTypes.size();
    plan.mergedResultTypes.push_back(producer.getResult(i).getType());
  }
  plan.consumerMergedStart = plan.mergedResultTypes.size();
  for (size_t i = 0; i < consumerNumBundles; ++i)
    plan.mergedResultTypes.push_back(consumer.getResult(i).getType());
  if (bufferChain.inChain)
    plan.mergedResultTypes.push_back(ChainType::get(producer.getContext()));

  return plan;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Merge
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Clones the producer's then the consumer's body ops into \p merged's block
/// and emits the combined yield.
static void spliceBodies(ParallelOp producer, ParallelOp consumer,
                         ParallelOp merged, const MergeCandidate &candidate,
                         const MergePlan &plan) {
  Block &producerBody = producer.getBodyRegion().front();
  Block &consumerBody = consumer.getBodyRegion().front();
  Block *mergedBlock = &merged.getBodyRegion().front();
  auto producerYield = cast<YieldOp>(producerBody.getTerminator());
  auto consumerYield = cast<YieldOp>(consumerBody.getTerminator());

  size_t producerNumInputs = producer.getInputs().size();
  size_t consumerNumInputs = consumer.getInputs().size();
  size_t producerNumBundles = numBundleResults(producer);
  size_t consumerNumBundles = numBundleResults(consumer);

  // Body args are
  //   [producer bundle args..., consumer non-shared bundle args..., chain?]
  // so the chain arg is mapped explicitly, not by position.
  Value mergedChainArg =
      merged.hasChain() ? mergedBlock->getArguments().back() : Value{};

  IRMapping mapping;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < producerNumInputs; ++i)
    mapping.map(producerBody.getArgument(i), mergedBlock->getArgument(i));
  // The producer's collective threads from the merged in-chain.
  if (producer.hasChain())
    mapping.map(producerBody.getArguments().back(), mergedChainArg);

  OpBuilder bodyBuilder(merged.getContext());
  bodyBuilder.setInsertionPointToEnd(mergedBlock);
  for (Operation &op : producerBody.without_terminator())
    bodyBuilder.clone(op, mapping);

  // Shared-input args map to the *cloned* producer yield operand, so this must
  // run after the producer body is cloned.
  for (size_t bi = 0; bi < consumerNumInputs; ++bi) {
    Value consumerArg = consumerBody.getArgument(bi);
    if (candidate.sharedInputs[bi].has_value())
      mapping.map(consumerArg,
                  mapping.lookupOrDefault(plan.consumerSharedYieldOperand[bi]));
    else
      mapping.map(consumerArg,
                  mergedBlock->getArgument(plan.consumerAppendedArgIdx[bi]));
  }
  // When both are chained, resolveBufferChain guarantees the consumer's
  // in-chain is the producer's out-chain, i.e. its cloned yielded chain.
  if (consumer.hasChain()) {
    Value consumerChainArg = consumerBody.getArguments().back();
    if (producer.hasChain())
      mapping.map(consumerChainArg,
                  mapping.lookupOrDefault(producerYield.getOperands().back()));
    else
      mapping.map(consumerChainArg, mergedChainArg);
  }
  for (Operation &op : consumerBody.without_terminator())
    bodyBuilder.clone(op, mapping);

  // The merged out-chain is the downstream side's yielded chain; when both are
  // chained, the producer's is an internal edge and is not re-yielded.
  SmallVector<Value> yieldValues;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < producerNumBundles; ++i)
    if (!plan.dropProducerYield[i])
      yieldValues.push_back(
          mapping.lookupOrDefault(producerYield.getOperand(i)));
  for (size_t i = 0; i < consumerNumBundles; ++i)
    yieldValues.push_back(mapping.lookupOrDefault(consumerYield.getOperand(i)));
  if (merged.hasChain()) {
    YieldOp chainSource = consumer.hasChain() ? consumerYield : producerYield;
    yieldValues.push_back(
        mapping.lookupOrDefault(chainSource.getOperands().back()));
  }
  YieldOp::create(bodyBuilder, merged.getLoc(), yieldValues);
}

/// Routes all uses of \p producer's and \p consumer's results to the
/// corresponding merged results.
static void replaceUses(ParallelOp producer, ParallelOp consumer,
                        ParallelOp merged, const MergePlan &plan,
                        const BufferChainPlan &bufferChain) {
  size_t producerNumBundles = numBundleResults(producer);
  size_t consumerNumBundles = numBundleResults(consumer);

  for (size_t i = 0; i < producerNumBundles; ++i)
    if (plan.producerMergedIdx[i])
      producer.getResult(i).replaceAllUsesWith(
          merged.getResult(*plan.producerMergedIdx[i]));
  for (size_t i = 0; i < consumerNumBundles; ++i)
    consumer.getResult(i).replaceAllUsesWith(
        merged.getResult(plan.consumerMergedStart + i));
  if (bufferChain.inChain) {
    Value mergedOutChain = merged.getResult(merged.getNumResults() - 1);
    if (producer.hasChain())
      producer.getOutChain().replaceAllUsesWith(mergedOutChain);
    if (consumer.hasChain())
      consumer.getOutChain().replaceAllUsesWith(mergedOutChain);
  }
}

/// Merges \p candidate.consumer into \p candidate.producer.
static void mergeCandidate(MergeCandidate &candidate,
                           const BufferChainPlan &bufferChain,
                           OpBuilder &builder) {
  MergePlan plan = planMerge(candidate, bufferChain);

  builder.setInsertionPoint(candidate.producer);
  ParallelOp merged = ParallelOp::create(
      builder, candidate.producer.getLoc(), plan.mergedInputs,
      bufferChain.buffers, bufferChain.inChain, plan.mergedResultTypes);
  spliceBodies(candidate.producer, candidate.consumer, merged, candidate, plan);
  replaceUses(candidate.producer, candidate.consumer, merged, plan,
              bufferChain);
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Pass driver
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Performs at most one merge and returns whether it fired.
///
/// Continuing the walk after a merge is unsafe (GEX-3756): a producer whose
/// only yield was absorbed still has the not-yet-erased consumer as a user, so
/// it can be visited and merged again, double-erasing it. One merge per walk
/// also guarantees no op is cloned twice.
static bool runOneIteration(Operation *root, OpBuilder &builder) {
  bool changed = false;
  root->walk([&](ParallelOp parallelOp) {
    auto candidate = findMergeCandidate(parallelOp);
    if (!candidate)
      return WalkResult::advance();

    auto bufferChain = resolveBufferChain(*candidate);
    if (!bufferChain)
      return WalkResult::advance();

    mergeCandidate(*candidate, *bufferChain, builder);
    candidate->consumer.erase();
    candidate->producer.erase();
    changed = true;
    return WalkResult::interrupt();
  });
  return changed;
}

struct MergeAdjacentParallelsPass
    : public impl::MergeAdjacentParallelsBase<MergeAdjacentParallelsPass> {
  using MergeAdjacentParallelsBase::MergeAdjacentParallelsBase;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    OpBuilder builder{&getContext()};
    while (runOneIteration(getOperation(), builder)) {
    }
  }
};

namespace std {
template <>
struct hash<::mlir::ValueRange> {
  std::size_t operator()(const ::mlir::ValueRange &s) const noexcept {
    return ::llvm::hash_combine_range(s.begin(), s.end());
  }
};

template <>
struct hash<std::pair<::llvm::StringRef, ::mlir::ValueRange>> {
  std::size_t operator()(const std::pair<::llvm::StringRef, ::mlir::ValueRange>
                             &s) const noexcept {
    return ::llvm::hash_combine(::llvm::hash_value(s.first),
                                std::hash<::mlir::ValueRange>{}(s.second));
  }
};

namespace {
/// Maps (op name, operands) to the primary op and the parameters it defines,
/// so duplicates' parameters can be remapped onto the primary's.
using OpCacheTy = std::unordered_map<
    std::pair<llvm::StringRef, ValueRange>,
    std::pair<Operation *, SmallVector<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr>>>;

bool isOpDefiningOpForAllParams(Operation *op,
                                ArrayRef<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr> references,
                                const KGEN::ParameterUseDefGraph &useDefGraph) {

  SmallVector<KGEN::ParamDefinition> definitions;
  for (const auto &reference : references) {
    if (auto it = useDefGraph.defs.find(reference.getName());
        it != useDefGraph.defs.end() && it->second.defOp == op)
      definitions.emplace_back(it->second);
    else
      return false;
  }
  return llvm::all_of(definitions, [&](const KGEN::ParamDefinition &def) {
    return isOpDefiningOpForAllParams(op, def.uses, useDefGraph);
  });
}
} // namespace

/// Erases all but the first of each set of shape materialization ops with the
/// same name and operands that define all their parameters, remapping the
/// erased ops' parameters to the first's. CSE can't merge these itself because
/// their parameter references differ.
struct MergeDuplicateShapeMaterializationsPass
    : public MO::impl::MergeDuplicateShapeMaterializationsBase<
          MergeDuplicateShapeMaterializationsPass> {
  using Base::Base;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    MO::GraphOp graph = getOperation();
    auto context = &getContext();
    IRRewriter rewriter(context);

    OpCacheTy opCache;

    auto paramCache = KGEN::ParameterCollector::Analysis(graph);
    KGEN::ParameterUseDefGraph useDefGraph(graph.getRegion());
    useDefGraph.calculate(paramCache);

    llvm::DenseMap<StringAttr, TypedAttr> paramMappings;
    llvm::SmallVector<Operation *> toErase;
    for (const auto &opUse : useDefGraph.opUses) {
      Operation *op = opUse.first;
      const SmallVector<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr> &references = opUse.second;

      if (!isa<ShapeMaterialization>(op))
        continue;

      auto definesAllParams =
          isOpDefiningOpForAllParams(op, references, useDefGraph);

      if (!definesAllParams)
        continue;

      auto [it, inserted] = opCache.try_emplace(
          {op->getName().getStringRef(), ValueRange(op->getOperands())}, opUse);

      if (inserted)
        continue;

      for (auto [thisOpReference, primaryOpReference] :
           llvm::zip(references, it->second.second)) {
        paramMappings[thisOpReference.getName()] = primaryOpReference;
      }

      op->replaceAllUsesWith(it->second.first);
      toErase.emplace_back(op);
    }

    MOGG::remapTypesAndAttrs(graph, paramMappings);

    for (auto op : toErase)
      op->erase();
  }
};

struct PatternFusionPass : public impl::PatternFusionBase<PatternFusionPass> {
  using PatternFusionBase::PatternFusionBase;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    MLIRContext *ctx = &getContext();

    M::DeviceRefAttr targetDeviceRef =
        targetDevice == "" ? nullptr
                           : M::DeviceRefAttr::get(ctx, targetDevice.getValue(),
                                                   targetDeviceId.getValue());

    llvm::SmallVector<MO::AllReduceSumOp> allReduceOps;
    getOperation()->walk([&](MO::AllReduceSumOp allReduceSumOp) {
      allReduceOps.push_back(allReduceSumOp);
    });
    for (auto allReduceOp : allReduceOps)
      MO::applyFuseAllReduceAddRMSNormQuantFP8(allReduceOp, targetDeviceRef);

    // Parallel-region analog: fuse `mo.parallel { mo.bundled.allreduce.sum }`
    // and the per-device add + rms_norm + quantize_fp8 chains after it.
    llvm::SmallVector<MO::BundledAllReduceSumOp> bundledAllReduceOps;
    getOperation()->walk([&](MO::BundledAllReduceSumOp op) {
      bundledAllReduceOps.push_back(op);
    });
    for (auto bundledAllReduceOp : bundledAllReduceOps) {
      // An earlier rewrite may have erased this op's parent parallel.
      if (!bundledAllReduceOp.getOperation()->getBlock())
        continue;
      MO::applyFuseParallelBundledAllReduceAddRMSNormQuantFP8(
          bundledAllReduceOp);
    }

    MO::GraphOp graphOp = getOperation();

    // RoPE fusion matches splits built from adjacent slice pairs.
    {
      RewritePatternSet sliceToSplitPatterns{ctx};
      sliceToSplitPatterns.add<SliceToSplitPattern</*AllowDynamicStop=*/true>>(
          ctx);
      if (failed(
              applyPatternsGreedily(graphOp, std::move(sliceToSplitPatterns))))
        return signalPassFailure();
    }

    MO::PackParamCache cache;
    MO::MHAOptions mhaOpts{
        enableMHAPattern.getValue(),
        mhaAllowUnsafeBCast.getValue(),
        mhaAllowInternalReshape.getValue(),
        debugMHAPattern.getValue(),
    };

    RewritePatternSet patterns{ctx};
    MO::populateFusionPatterns(patterns, cache, targetDeviceRef, mhaOpts);

    if (failed(applyPatternsGreedily(graphOp, std::move(patterns))))
      return signalPassFailure();

    // Lower splits that survived fusion back to slices.
    {
      MO::DeviceInfoMapping deviceInfoMapping(
          graphOp->getParentOfType<mlir::ModuleOp>());
      RewritePatternSet splitToSlicePatterns{ctx};
      splitToSlicePatterns.add<SplitToSlicePattern<>>(ctx);
      MO::populateFusionMatmulAddPatterns(deviceInfoMapping,
                                          splitToSlicePatterns);
      // The mega_ffn_nvfp4 kernel is MAX-only, so OSS builds (where it is
      // unregistered) disable this; the pattern arch-gates SM100 itself.
      if (enableMegaFFNPattern.getValue())
        MO::populateFusionMegaFFNPatterns(deviceInfoMapping,
                                          splitToSlicePatterns);
      if (failed(
              applyPatternsGreedily(graphOp, std::move(splitToSlicePatterns))))
        return signalPassFailure();
    }

    MO::synchronizeMetadataUpdates(graphOp);
  }
};

} // namespace
